import React, { useEffect } from 'react';
import { Award, Lock, X } from 'lucide-react';
import { useAppTheme } from '../context/ThemeContext';
import { AchievementCategory, AchievementDef, AchievementStatus } from '../engine/achievements';

const CATEGORIES: AchievementCategory[] = ['Games', 'Puzzles', 'Training'];

/** Achievement grid for the Stats page. */
export const AchievementsPanel: React.FC<{ statuses: AchievementStatus[] }> = ({ statuses }) => {
  const { theme } = useAppTheme();
  const unlockedCount = statuses.filter(s => s.unlocked).length;

  return (
    <div className="rounded-xl p-5" style={{ backgroundColor: theme.cardHex, border: `1px solid ${theme.cardBorderHex}` }}>
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <Award className="w-4 h-4" style={{ color: theme.accentHex }} />
          <h2 className="font-display text-base font-bold" style={{ color: theme.textPrimary }}>
            Achievements
          </h2>
        </div>
        <span className="text-xs font-mono tabular-nums" style={{ color: theme.textMutedHex }}>
          {unlockedCount}/{statuses.length} unlocked
        </span>
      </div>

      <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
        {CATEGORIES.map(category => (
          <div key={category}>
            <div className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider mb-2" style={{ color: theme.textMutedHex }}>
              {category}
            </div>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4 gap-2.5">
              {statuses
                .filter(s => s.def.category === category)
                .map(s => {
                  const pct = Math.round((s.current / s.target) * 100);
                  return (
                    <div
                      key={s.def.id}
                      className="flex items-center gap-3 p-3 rounded-xl"
                      style={{
                        backgroundColor: s.unlocked ? `${theme.accentHex}12` : theme.cardSecondaryHex,
                        border: `1px solid ${s.unlocked ? `${theme.accentHex}55` : theme.cardBorderHex}`
                      }}
                      title={s.unlocked && s.unlockedOn ? `Unlocked ${s.unlockedOn}` : undefined}
                    >
                      <div
                        className="w-10 h-10 shrink-0 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center text-xl"
                        style={{
                          backgroundColor: s.unlocked ? `${theme.accentHex}22` : theme.cardHex,
                          filter: s.unlocked ? undefined : 'grayscale(1)',
                          opacity: s.unlocked ? 1 : 0.45
                        }}
                        aria-hidden="true"
                      >
                        {s.def.icon}
                      </div>
                      <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                          <span className="text-xs font-bold truncate" style={{ color: s.unlocked ? theme.textPrimary : theme.textSecondary }}>
                            {s.def.name}
                          </span>
                          {!s.unlocked && <Lock className="w-3 h-3 shrink-0" style={{ color: theme.textMutedHex }} />}
                        </div>
                        <div className="text-[11px] leading-snug" style={{ color: theme.textMutedHex }}>
                          {s.def.description}
                        </div>
                        {!s.unlocked && s.target > 1 && (
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mt-1.5">
                            <div className="flex-1 h-1 rounded-full overflow-hidden" style={{ backgroundColor: theme.cardHex }}>
                              <div className="h-full rounded-full" style={{ width: `${pct}%`, backgroundColor: theme.accentHex }} />
                            </div>
                            <span className="text-[10px] font-mono tabular-nums" style={{ color: theme.textMutedHex }}>
                              {s.current}/{s.target}
                            </span>
                          </div>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  );
                })}
            </div>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

/** Bottom-corner toast shown when an achievement unlocks. */
export const AchievementToast: React.FC<{
  achievement: AchievementDef | null;
  onDismiss: () => void;
  onOpen: () => void;
}> = ({ achievement, onDismiss, onOpen }) => {
  const { theme } = useAppTheme();

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!achievement) return;
    const id = window.setTimeout(onDismiss, 5000);
    return () => window.clearTimeout(id);
  }, [achievement, onDismiss]);

  if (!achievement) return null;

  return (
    <div className="fixed z-50 right-3 bottom-20 md:bottom-6 animate-modal-reveal" role="status" aria-live="polite">
      <div
        className="flex items-center gap-3 pl-3 pr-2 py-2.5 rounded-xl shadow-2xl max-w-xs"
        style={{ backgroundColor: theme.cardHex, border: `1px solid ${theme.accentHex}66` }}
      >
        <button type="button" onClick={onOpen} className="flex items-center gap-3 text-left min-w-0">
          <span
            className="w-10 h-10 shrink-0 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center text-xl"
            style={{ backgroundColor: `${theme.accentHex}22` }}
            aria-hidden="true"
          >
            {achievement.icon}
          </span>
          <span className="min-w-0">
            <span className="block text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider" style={{ color: theme.accentHex }}>
              Achievement unlocked
            </span>
            <span className="block text-sm font-bold truncate" style={{ color: theme.textPrimary }}>
              {achievement.name}
            </span>
            <span className="block text-[11px] truncate" style={{ color: theme.textMutedHex }}>
              {achievement.description}
            </span>
          </span>
        </button>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={onDismiss}
          aria-label="Dismiss"
          className="p-1 rounded-md self-start hover:opacity-80"
          style={{ color: theme.textMutedHex }}
        >
          <X className="w-4 h-4" />
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

<file path="src/components/AnalysisBoard.tsx">
import React, { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Chess, Square } from 'chess.js';
import {
  ArrowUpDown,
  Check,
  ChevronLeft,
  ChevronRight,
  Copy,
  Cpu,
  FolderInput,
  Loader2,
  RotateCcw,
  SkipBack,
  SkipForward,
  Zap
} from 'lucide-react';
import { ChessBoard, getBoardMaxWidthPx } from './ChessBoard';
import { EvalBar } from './EvalBar';
import { useAppTheme } from '../context/ThemeContext';
import { sounds } from '../utils/sound';
import { EngineLine, formatEvaluation } from '../engine/chessEngine';
import { engineTopLines } from '../engine/engineClient';
import { detectOpening } from '../engine/openings';

interface PlayedMove {
  from: string;
  to: string;
  promotion?: string;
  san: string;
}

const START_FEN = new Chess().fen();
const ANALYSIS_TIME_MS = 900;

const PRESETS: { label: string; fen: string }[] = [
  { label: 'Start', fen: START_FEN },
  { label: 'Italian', fen: 'r1bqk1nr/pppp1ppp/2n5/2b1p3/2B1P3/5N2/PPPP1PPP/RNBQK2R w KQkq - 4 4' },
  { label: 'Sicilian', fen: 'rnbqkbnr/pp1ppppp/8/2p5/4P3/8/PPPP1PPP/RNBQKBNR w KQkq c6 0 2' },
  { label: 'Lucena', fen: '1K1k4/1P6/8/8/8/8/r7/2R5 w - - 0 1' }
];

function replay(startFen: string, moves: PlayedMove[]): Chess {
  const board = new Chess(startFen);
  for (const m of moves) board.move({ from: m.from, to: m.to, promotion: m.promotion });
  return board;
}

function playSound(san: string) {
  if (san.includes('#') || san.includes('+')) sounds.playCheck();
  else if (san.startsWith('O-O')) sounds.playCastle();
  else if (san.includes('=')) sounds.playPromote();
  else if (san.includes('x')) sounds.playCapture();
  else sounds.playMove();
}

function gameOverText(board: Chess): string | null {
  if (board.isCheckmate()) return `Checkmate — ${board.turn() === 'w' ? 'Black' : 'White'} wins`;
  if (board.isStalemate()) return 'Stalemate';
  if (board.isInsufficientMaterial()) return 'Draw — insufficient material';
  if (board.isThreefoldRepetition()) return 'Draw — threefold repetition';
  if (board.isDraw()) return 'Draw';
  return null;
}

/** Free analysis board: play both sides, step through moves, and see live engine lines + eval. */
export const AnalysisBoard: React.FC = () => {
  const { theme, settings } = useAppTheme();
  const [startFen, setStartFen] = useState(START_FEN);
  const [moves, setMoves] = useState<PlayedMove[]>([]);
  const [cursor, setCursor] = useState(0);
  const [isFlipped, setIsFlipped] = useState(false);
  const [lines, setLines] = useState<EngineLine[]>([]);
  const [isAnalyzing, setIsAnalyzing] = useState(false);
  const [selectedLine, setSelectedLine] = useState(0);
  const [importText, setImportText] = useState('');
  const [importError, setImportError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState<'fen' | 'pgn' | null>(null);
  const requestRef = useRef(0);

  const board = useMemo(() => replay(startFen, moves.slice(0, cursor)), [startFen, moves, cursor]);
  const fen = board.fen();
  const overText = gameOverText(board);
  const opening = useMemo(
    () => (startFen === START_FEN ? detectOpening(moves.slice(0, cursor).map(m => m.san)) : null),
    [startFen, moves, cursor]
  );

  // Analyse every new position in the engine worker (debounced so stepping through moves stays snappy)
  useEffect(() => {
    requestRef.current += 1;
    const requestId = requestRef.current;
    setSelectedLine(0);
    if (overText) {
      setLines([]);
      setIsAnalyzing(false);
      return;
    }
    setIsAnalyzing(true);
    const timer = window.setTimeout(() => {
      engineTopLines(fen, 3, 3, ANALYSIS_TIME_MS)
        .then(result => {
          if (requestId === requestRef.current) setLines(result);
        })
        .catch(() => {
          if (requestId === requestRef.current) setLines([]);
        })
        .finally(() => {
          if (requestId === requestRef.current) setIsAnalyzing(false);
        });
    }, 150);
    return () => window.clearTimeout(timer);
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [fen]);

  // Arrow keys step through the move list
  useEffect(() => {
    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      const target = e.target as HTMLElement | null;
      if (target && (target.tagName === 'INPUT' || target.tagName === 'TEXTAREA' || target.tagName === 'SELECT')) return;
      if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') setCursor(c => Math.max(0, c - 1));
      else if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') setCursor(c => Math.min(moves.length, c + 1));
      else return;
      e.preventDefault();
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey);
  }, [moves.length]);

  const applyMove = (move: { from: string; to: string; promotion?: string }) => {
    let played: PlayedMove;
    try {
      const m = new Chess(fen).move({ from: move.from, to: move.to, promotion: move.promotion || 'q' });
      played = { from: m.from, to: m.to, promotion: m.promotion, san: m.san };
    } catch {
      return false;
    }
    playSound(played.san);
    // Same as the next move in the list: just step forward and keep the continuation
    const next = moves[cursor];
    if (next && next.from === played.from && next.to === played.to && next.promotion === played.promotion) {
      setCursor(cursor + 1);
      return true;
    }
    setMoves([...moves.slice(0, cursor), played]);
    setCursor(cursor + 1);
    return true;
  };

  const loadPosition = (fenToLoad: string) => {
    setStartFen(fenToLoad);
    setMoves([]);
    setCursor(0);
    setImportError(null);
  };

  const handleImport = () => {
    const text = importText.trim();
    if (!text) return;
    // FEN first
    try {
      const probe = new Chess(text);
      loadPosition(probe.fen());
      setImportText('');
      return;
    } catch {
      // not a FEN — try PGN
    }
    try {
      const game = new Chess();
      game.loadPgn(text);
      const history = game.history({ verbose: true });
      const start = history[0]?.before ?? game.fen();
      setStartFen(start);
      const loaded = history.map(m => ({ from: m.from, to: m.to, promotion: m.promotion, san: m.san }));
      setMoves(loaded);
      setCursor(loaded.length);
      setImportError(null);
      setImportText('');
    } catch {
      setImportError('That isn’t a valid FEN or PGN.');
    }
  };

  const copy = async (kind: 'fen' | 'pgn') => {
    const text =
      kind === 'fen'
        ? fen
        : (() => {
            const g = replay(startFen, moves);
            return g.pgn();
          })();
    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
      setCopied(kind);
      window.setTimeout(() => setCopied(null), 1500);
    } catch {
      setImportText(text);
    }
  };

  const activeLine = lines[selectedLine] ?? lines[0];
  const arrow = activeLine ? { from: activeLine.from as Square, to: activeLine.to as Square } : null;
  const evalCp = lines[0]?.scoreCp ?? 0;
  const plateMaxWidth = `${getBoardMaxWidthPx(settings.boardSize) + 44}px`;

  const navButton = (label: string, icon: React.ReactNode, onClick: () => void, disabled: boolean) => (
    <button
      type="button"
      aria-label={label}
      title={label}
      onClick={onClick}
      disabled={disabled}
      className="flex-1 flex items-center justify-center py-2 rounded-lg border transition hover:opacity-80 disabled:opacity-30"
      style={{ borderColor: theme.cardBorderHex, color: theme.textPrimary }}
    >
      {icon}
    </button>
  );

  // Move list rows
  const firstMoveNumber = new Chess(startFen).moveNumber();
  const blackStarts = new Chess(startFen).turn() === 'b';
  const rows: { num: number; white?: { san: string; ply: number }; black?: { san: string; ply: number } }[] = [];
  moves.forEach((m, i) => {
    const absolute = i + (blackStarts ? 1 : 0);
    const num = firstMoveNumber + Math.floor(absolute / 2);
    const entry = { san: m.san, ply: i + 1 };
    if (absolute % 2 === 0) rows.push({ num, white: entry });
    else if (rows.length === 0 || rows[rows.length - 1].black) rows.push({ num, black: entry });
    else rows[rows.length - 1].black = entry;
  });

  const moveButton = (entry?: { san: string; ply: number }) =>
    entry ? (
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => setCursor(entry.ply)}
        className="text-left px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded font-bold transition"
        style={{
          backgroundColor: cursor === entry.ply ? `${theme.accentHex}25` : 'transparent',
          color: cursor === entry.ply ? theme.accentHex : theme.textPrimary
        }}
      >
        {entry.san}
      </button>
    ) : (
      <span className="px-1.5" style={{ color: theme.textMutedHex }}>
        …
      </span>
    );

  return (
    <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-5 items-start">
      {/* Board + eval */}
      <div className="lg:col-span-7 flex flex-col items-center gap-2.5">
        <div
          className="w-full flex items-center justify-between gap-2 px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl border text-xs font-semibold"
          style={{ maxWidth: plateMaxWidth, backgroundColor: theme.cardHex, borderColor: theme.cardBorderHex }}
        >
          <span className="truncate" style={{ color: theme.textPrimary }}>
            {overText ?? `${board.turn() === 'w' ? 'White' : 'Black'} to move`}
            {opening && (
              <span className="font-normal" style={{ color: theme.textMutedHex }}>
                {' '}· {opening.eco} {opening.name}
              </span>
            )}
          </span>
          <span className="font-mono font-bold tabular-nums shrink-0" style={{ color: theme.accentHex }}>
            {lines.length > 0 ? formatEvaluation(evalCp) : '—'}
          </span>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-3 w-full">
          <EvalBar scoreCp={evalCp} isFlipped={isFlipped} isEvaluating={isAnalyzing} engineDepth={3} />
          <ChessBoard chess={board} isFlipped={isFlipped} premoveMode="off" bestMoveArrow={arrow} onMakeMove={applyMove} />
        </div>
        <div className="w-full flex gap-2" style={{ maxWidth: plateMaxWidth }}>
          {navButton('First move', <SkipBack className="w-4 h-4" />, () => setCursor(0), cursor === 0)}
          {navButton('Previous move (←)', <ChevronLeft className="w-4 h-4" />, () => setCursor(c => Math.max(0, c - 1)), cursor === 0)}
          {navButton('Next move (→)', <ChevronRight className="w-4 h-4" />, () => setCursor(c => Math.min(moves.length, c + 1)), cursor >= moves.length)}
          {navButton('Last move', <SkipForward className="w-4 h-4" />, () => setCursor(moves.length), cursor >= moves.length)}
          {navButton('Flip board', <ArrowUpDown className="w-4 h-4" />, () => setIsFlipped(f => !f), false)}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Panel */}
      <div className="lg:col-span-5 flex flex-col gap-4">
        {/* Engine lines */}
        <div className="rounded-xl p-4 flex flex-col gap-2.5" style={{ backgroundColor: theme.cardHex, border: `1px solid ${theme.cardBorderHex}` }}>
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider" style={{ color: theme.textSecondary }}>
              <Cpu className="w-4 h-4" style={{ color: theme.accentHex }} />
              Engine lines
            </span>
            {isAnalyzing && <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" style={{ color: theme.accentHex }} />}
          </div>

          {overText ? (
            <div className="text-xs py-3" style={{ color: theme.textSecondary }}>
              {overText}.
            </div>
          ) : lines.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="text-xs py-3" style={{ color: theme.textMutedHex }}>
              Analyzing position…
            </div>
          ) : (
            lines.map((line, idx) => {
              const active = idx === selectedLine;
              return (
                <button
                  key={`${line.san}-${idx}`}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setSelectedLine(idx)}
                  className="text-left rounded-lg px-3 py-2 border transition"
                  style={{
                    backgroundColor: active ? `${theme.accentHex}14` : theme.cardSecondaryHex,
                    borderColor: active ? `${theme.accentHex}66` : theme.cardBorderHex,
                    opacity: isAnalyzing ? 0.6 : 1
                  }}
                >
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                    <span className="flex items-center gap-2 min-w-0">
                      <span className="font-mono text-[10px] font-bold" style={{ color: theme.textMutedHex }}>
                        #{idx + 1}
                      </span>
                      <span className="font-bold text-sm" style={{ color: theme.textPrimary }}>
                        {line.san}
                      </span>
                      <span className="font-mono text-[11px] truncate" style={{ color: theme.textMutedHex }}>
                        {line.pvSan.slice(1).join(' ')}
                      </span>
                    </span>
                    <span className="font-mono text-xs font-bold shrink-0" style={{ color: theme.accentHex }}>
                      {line.formattedEval}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  {active && line.reasons[0] && (
                    <div className="text-[11px] mt-1" style={{ color: theme.textSecondary }}>
                      {line.reasons[0]}
                    </div>
                  )}
                </button>
              );
            })
          )}

          <button
            type="button"
            disabled={!activeLine || isAnalyzing}
            onClick={() => activeLine && applyMove({ from: activeLine.from, to: activeLine.to, promotion: activeLine.promotion })}
            className="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold transition hover:opacity-90 disabled:opacity-40"
            style={{ backgroundColor: theme.accentHex, color: theme.accentTextHex }}
          >
            <Zap className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            Play {activeLine ? activeLine.san : 'engine move'}
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Moves */}
        <div className="rounded-xl p-4 flex flex-col gap-2" style={{ backgroundColor: theme.cardHex, border: `1px solid ${theme.cardBorderHex}` }}>
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <span className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider" style={{ color: theme.textSecondary }}>
              Moves ({moves.length})
            </span>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
              {(['fen', 'pgn'] as const).map(kind => (
                <button
                  key={kind}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => copy(kind)}
                  className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-1 rounded-md text-[11px] font-bold transition hover:opacity-80"
                  style={{ color: theme.textSecondary }}
                >
                  {copied === kind ? <Check className="w-3 h-3" /> : <Copy className="w-3 h-3" />}
                  {kind.toUpperCase()}
                </button>
              ))}
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => loadPosition(START_FEN)}
                className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-1 rounded-md text-[11px] font-bold transition hover:opacity-80"
                style={{ color: theme.textSecondary }}
              >
                <RotateCcw className="w-3 h-3" />
                Reset
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="max-h-40 overflow-y-auto font-mono text-xs flex flex-col gap-0.5">
            {rows.length === 0 ? (
              <span className="py-2" style={{ color: theme.textMutedHex }}>
                Move pieces for either side to explore.
              </span>
            ) : (
              rows.map(r => (
                <div key={`${r.num}-${r.white?.ply ?? r.black?.ply}`} className="grid grid-cols-[2.5rem_1fr_1fr] items-center">
                  <span style={{ color: theme.textMutedHex }}>{r.num}.</span>
                  {moveButton(r.white)}
                  {moveButton(r.black)}
                </div>
              ))
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Load */}
        <div className="rounded-xl p-4 flex flex-col gap-2" style={{ backgroundColor: theme.cardHex, border: `1px solid ${theme.cardBorderHex}` }}>
          <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider" style={{ color: theme.textSecondary }}>
            <FolderInput className="w-4 h-4" style={{ color: theme.accentHex }} />
            Set up a position
          </span>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
            {PRESETS.map(p => (
              <button
                key={p.label}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => loadPosition(p.fen)}
                className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-md text-[11px] font-bold border transition hover:opacity-80"
                style={{ borderColor: theme.cardBorderHex, color: theme.textSecondary }}
              >
                {p.label}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
          <div className="flex gap-1.5">
            <input
              type="text"
              value={importText}
              onChange={e => setImportText(e.target.value)}
              onKeyDown={e => {
                if (e.key === 'Enter') handleImport();
              }}
              aria-label="FEN or PGN"
              placeholder="Paste a FEN or PGN…"
              className="flex-1 min-w-0 px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg border text-[11px] font-mono focus:outline-none"
              style={{
                backgroundColor: theme.cardSecondaryHex,
                borderColor: importError ? '#f43f5e' : theme.cardBorderHex,
                color: theme.textPrimary
              }}
            />
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleImport}
              className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold transition hover:opacity-90"
              style={{ backgroundColor: theme.accentHex, color: theme.accentTextHex }}
            >
              Load
            </button>
          </div>
          {importError && (
            <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold" style={{ color: '#f43f5e' }} role="alert">
              {importError}
            </span>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

<file path="src/components/BoardEditor.tsx">
import React, { useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { ArrowLeft, Check, Pencil, Plus, RotateCcw, Save, Trash2, Wand2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { CustomBoardId, CustomBoardRecipe, PieceColor, PieceType, UserSettings } from '../types/chess';
import {
  ALL_15_BOARD_THEMES,
  ALL_15_PIECE_SETS,
  BoardThemeConfig,
  ORNAMENT_OPTIONS,
  PLATING_PRESETS,
  SIGNATURE_BOARDS,
  TEXTURE_PRESETS,
  buildCustomBoard,
  getBoardTheme,
  recipeFromBoard,
  resolveBoardTheme
} from '../theme/themes';
import { BoardFrame } from './BoardFrame';
import { ChessPieceIcon } from './ChessPieces';

/** Mini board preview: frame plating around a 4x2 strip of squares. */
export const BoardSwatch: React.FC<{ board: BoardThemeConfig }> = ({ board }) => {
  const cells = [true, false, true, false, false, true, false, true];
  const framed = Boolean(board.frame);
  return (
    <div
      className="w-full h-9 rounded-lg overflow-hidden shadow-inner"
      style={{
        padding: framed ? 3 : 0,
        background: board.frame?.plating,
        boxShadow: framed ? `inset 0 0 0 1px ${board.frame!.rim}` : undefined
      }}
    >
      <div
        className="w-full h-full grid grid-cols-4 grid-rows-2 rounded-[3px] overflow-hidden"
        style={{ boxShadow: framed ? `0 0 0 1px ${board.frame!.innerLine}` : undefined }}
      >
        {cells.map((dark, i) => (
          <div
            key={i}
            style={{
              backgroundColor: dark ? board.darkHex : board.lightHex,
              backgroundImage: dark ? board.squareTexture?.dark : board.squareTexture?.light
            }}
          />
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/*  Live preview board                                                 */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

const PREVIEW_POSITION: Array<Array<[PieceType, PieceColor] | null>> = [
  [['r', 'b'], ['n', 'b'], ['b', 'b'], ['q', 'b'], ['k', 'b'], ['b', 'b'], ['n', 'b'], ['r', 'b']],
  [['p', 'b'], ['p', 'b'], ['p', 'b'], ['p', 'b'], null, ['p', 'b'], ['p', 'b'], ['p', 'b']],
  [null, null, null, null, null, null, null, null],
  [null, null, null, null, ['p', 'b'], null, null, null],
  [null, null, null, null, ['p', 'w'], null, null, null],
  [null, null, null, null, null, null, null, null],
  [['p', 'w'], ['p', 'w'], ['p', 'w'], ['p', 'w'], null, ['p', 'w'], ['p', 'w'], ['p', 'w']],
  [['r', 'w'], ['n', 'w'], ['b', 'w'], ['q', 'w'], ['k', 'w'], ['b', 'w'], ['n', 'w'], ['r', 'w']]
];

const BoardPreview: React.FC<{ board: BoardThemeConfig; settings: UserSettings }> = ({ board, settings }) => (
  <BoardFrame frame={board.frame} still={settings.batterySaver}>
    <div
      className={`grid grid-cols-8 grid-rows-8 aspect-square w-full overflow-hidden ${board.frame ? 'rounded-[3px]' : 'rounded-lg'}`}
      style={{ backgroundColor: board.darkHex }}
    >
      {PREVIEW_POSITION.map((row, r) =>
        row.map((piece, c) => {
          const isDark = (r + c) % 2 === 1;
          const isLast = (r === 3 && c === 4) || (r === 1 && c === 4);
          const isSelected = r === 7 && c === 6;
          const bg = isSelected ? board.selectedHex : isLast ? board.lastMoveHex : isDark ? board.darkHex : board.lightHex;
          return (
            <div
              key={`${r}-${c}`}
              className="relative flex items-center justify-center p-[6%]"
              style={{
                backgroundColor: bg,
                backgroundImage: isSelected || isLast ? undefined : isDark ? board.squareTexture?.dark : board.squareTexture?.light
              }}
            >
              {c === 0 && (
                <span className="absolute top-0 left-0.5 text-[7px] font-mono font-bold opacity-80" style={{ color: isDark ? board.coordDark : board.coordLight }}>
                  {8 - r}
                </span>
              )}
              {piece && <ChessPieceIcon type={piece[0]} color={piece[1]} set={settings.pieceSet} kingFinial={settings.kingFinial} />}
            </div>
          );
        })
      )}
    </div>
  </BoardFrame>
);

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/*  Editor                                                             */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

/* Field helpers live outside the editor so inputs keep focus between renders. */
const ColorField: React.FC<{ label: string; value: string; onChange: (v: string) => void; disabled?: boolean }> = ({
  label,
  value,
  onChange,
  disabled
}) => {
  const { theme } = useAppTheme();
  return (
  <label className="flex items-center gap-2 text-[11px] font-semibold" style={{ color: theme.textSecondary, opacity: disabled ? 0.45 : 1 }}>
    <input
      type="color"
      value={value}
      disabled={disabled}
      onChange={e => onChange(e.target.value)}
      className="w-7 h-7 rounded-md cursor-pointer border-0 p-0 bg-transparent shrink-0"
      aria-label={label}
    />
    <span className="flex flex-col leading-tight min-w-0">
      <span className="truncate">{label}</span>
      <span className="font-mono text-[10px]" style={{ color: theme.textMutedHex }}>{value}</span>
    </span>
  </label>
);
};

const Toggle: React.FC<{ label: string; on: boolean; onChange: (v: boolean) => void; disabled?: boolean }> = ({ label, on, onChange, disabled }) => {
  const { theme } = useAppTheme();
  return (
  <button
    type="button"
    role="switch"
    aria-checked={on}
    disabled={disabled}
    onClick={() => onChange(!on)}
    className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-[11px] font-semibold"
    style={{ backgroundColor: theme.cardSecondaryHex, border: `1px solid ${theme.cardBorderHex}`, color: theme.textSecondary, opacity: disabled ? 0.45 : 1 }}
  >
    <span>{label}</span>
    <span className="relative w-7 h-4 rounded-full shrink-0" style={{ backgroundColor: on ? theme.accentHex : theme.cardBorderHex }}>
      <span className="absolute top-0.5 w-3 h-3 rounded-full bg-white shadow transition-all" style={{ left: on ? 'calc(100% - 14px)' : '2px' }} />
    </span>
  </button>
);
};

const Slider: React.FC<{ label: string; value: number; min: number; max: number; step: number; suffix: string; onChange: (v: number) => void; disabled?: boolean }> = ({
  label,
  value,
  min,
  max,
  step,
  suffix,
  onChange,
  disabled
}) => {
  const { theme } = useAppTheme();
  return (
  <label className="flex flex-col gap-1 text-[11px] font-semibold" style={{ color: theme.textSecondary, opacity: disabled ? 0.45 : 1 }}>
    <span className="flex justify-between">
      <span>{label}</span>
      <span className="font-mono" style={{ color: theme.textMutedHex }}>{value}{suffix}</span>
    </span>
    <input
      type="range"
      min={min}
      max={max}
      step={step}
      value={value}
      disabled={disabled}
      onChange={e => onChange(Number(e.target.value))}
      style={{ accentColor: theme.accentHex }}
    />
  </label>
);
};

interface BoardEditorProps {
  settings: UserSettings;
  onUpdate: (patch: Partial<UserSettings>) => void;
  onBack: () => void;
}

const newCustomId = (): CustomBoardId => `custom_${Date.now().toString(36)}${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 5)}`;

export const BoardEditor: React.FC<BoardEditorProps> = ({ settings, onUpdate, onBack }) => {
  const { theme } = useAppTheme();
  const customBoards = settings.customBoards || [];
  const activeBoard = resolveBoardTheme(settings);
  const matchBoard = settings.matchBoardToPieces !== false;

  const [draft, setDraft] = useState<CustomBoardRecipe>(() => {
    const existing = customBoards.find(c => c.id === activeBoard.id);
    if (existing) return { ...existing };
    return recipeFromBoard(activeBoard, newCustomId(), `${activeBoard.name} Remix`);
  });
  const isSaved = customBoards.some(c => c.id === draft.id);
  const previewBoard = useMemo(() => buildCustomBoard(draft), [draft]);
  const hasFrame = draft.plating !== 'none';
  const hasOrnaments = hasFrame && draft.ornament !== 'none';

  const set = <K extends keyof CustomBoardRecipe>(key: K, value: CustomBoardRecipe[K]) =>
    setDraft(prev => ({ ...prev, [key]: value }));

  const loadFrom = (board: BoardThemeConfig) => {
    const recipe = recipeFromBoard(board, draft.id, board.id.startsWith('custom_') ? board.name : `${board.name} Remix`);
    setDraft(isSaved ? { ...recipe, id: newCustomId() } : recipe);
  };

  const applyBoard = (id: UserSettings['boardTheme']) => onUpdate({ boardTheme: id, matchBoardToPieces: false });

  const saveDraft = (asNew: boolean) => {
    const recipe: CustomBoardRecipe = { ...draft, id: asNew ? newCustomId() : draft.id, name: draft.name.trim() || 'Custom board' };
    const exists = customBoards.some(c => c.id === recipe.id);
    const next = exists ? customBoards.map(c => (c.id === recipe.id ? recipe : c)) : [...customBoards, recipe];
    setDraft(recipe);
    onUpdate({ customBoards: next, boardTheme: recipe.id, matchBoardToPieces: false });
  };

  const deleteBoard = (id: CustomBoardId) => {
    const target = customBoards.find(c => c.id === id);
    if (!target || !window.confirm(`Delete "${target.name}"? This can't be undone.`)) return;
    const next = customBoards.filter(c => c.id !== id);
    const patch: Partial<UserSettings> = { customBoards: next };
    if (settings.boardTheme === id) {
      patch.boardTheme = `sig_${settings.pieceSet}`;
      patch.matchBoardToPieces = true;
    }
    onUpdate(patch);
    if (draft.id === id) setDraft(prev => ({ ...prev, id: newCustomId() }));
  };

  /* --- small styled building blocks --- */
  const sectionLabel = (text: string, right?: React.ReactNode) => (
    <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider mb-2" style={{ color: theme.textMutedHex }}>
      <span>{text}</span>
      {right}
    </div>
  );

  const card = (selected: boolean): React.CSSProperties => ({
    backgroundColor: selected ? `${theme.accentHex}20` : theme.cardSecondaryHex,
    border: `2px solid ${selected ? theme.accentHex : theme.cardBorderHex}`,
    color: theme.textPrimary
  });

  const chip = (selected: boolean, disabled = false): React.CSSProperties => ({
    backgroundColor: selected ? theme.accentHex : theme.cardSecondaryHex,
    color: selected ? theme.accentTextHex : theme.textSecondary,
    border: `1px solid ${selected ? theme.accentHex : theme.cardBorderHex}`,
    opacity: disabled ? 0.45 : 1
  });

  const group = (title: string, children: React.ReactNode, note?: string) => (
    <div className="rounded-xl p-3 space-y-2.5" style={{ backgroundColor: theme.cardHex, border: `1px solid ${theme.cardBorderHex}` }}>
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <span className="text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider" style={{ color: theme.textPrimary }}>{title}</span>
        {note && <span className="text-[10px]" style={{ color: theme.textMutedHex }}>{note}</span>}
      </div>
      {children}
    </div>
  );

  return (
    <div className="space-y-5">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={onBack}
          className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-bold px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg transition hover:opacity-80"
          style={{ backgroundColor: theme.cardSecondaryHex, border: `1px solid ${theme.cardBorderHex}`, color: theme.textSecondary }}
        >
          <ArrowLeft className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
          Signature boards
        </button>
        <span className="font-display font-bold text-sm flex items-center gap-1.5" style={{ color: theme.textPrimary }}>
          <Wand2 className="w-4 h-4" style={{ color: theme.accentHex }} />
          Board Editor
        </span>
      </div>

      {/* Pairing + piece styles */}
      <div>
        <button
          type="button"
          role="switch"
          aria-checked={matchBoard}
          onClick={() => onUpdate({ matchBoardToPieces: !matchBoard })}
          className="w-full mb-3 px-3 py-2.5 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-between gap-3 text-left transition"
          style={{
            backgroundColor: theme.cardSecondaryHex,
            border: `1px solid ${matchBoard ? theme.accentHex : theme.cardBorderHex}`
          }}
        >
          <span className="flex flex-col">
            <span className="text-xs font-bold" style={{ color: theme.textPrimary }}>
              Match board to piece style
            </span>
            <span className="text-[11px]" style={{ color: theme.textMutedHex }}>
              {matchBoard
                ? 'On: picking a piece style also switches to its signature board'
                : 'Off: pieces and board are chosen independently'}
            </span>
          </span>
          <span
            className="relative w-10 h-6 rounded-full shrink-0 transition-colors"
            style={{ backgroundColor: matchBoard ? theme.accentHex : theme.cardBorderHex }}
          >
            <span
              className="absolute top-1 w-4 h-4 rounded-full bg-white shadow transition-all"
              style={{ left: matchBoard ? 'calc(100% - 20px)' : '4px' }}
            />
          </span>
        </button>

        {sectionLabel(
          'Piece styles · 15',
          <span className="normal-case tracking-normal font-semibold" style={{ color: theme.accentHex }}>
            {ALL_15_PIECE_SETS.find(p => p.id === settings.pieceSet)?.name}
          </span>
        )}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 md:grid-cols-5 gap-2">
          {ALL_15_PIECE_SETS.map(piece => {
            const isSelected = settings.pieceSet === piece.id;
            const sig = SIGNATURE_BOARDS.find(b => b.pieceSet === piece.id);
            return (
              <button
                key={piece.id}
                type="button"
                title={piece.tagline}
                onClick={() => onUpdate({ pieceSet: piece.id })}
                className="p-2 rounded-xl flex flex-col gap-1.5 text-left transition"
                style={card(isSelected)}
              >
                <div
                  className="w-full h-10 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-around px-1.5"
                  style={{
                    backgroundColor: sig ? sig.lightHex : '#ebecd0',
                    backgroundImage: sig ? `linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 50%, ${sig.darkHex} 50%)` : undefined,
                    border: `1px solid ${theme.cardBorderHex}`
                  }}
                >
                  <div className="w-6 h-6">
                    <ChessPieceIcon type="k" color="w" set={piece.id} kingFinial={settings.kingFinial || 'crescent'} />
                  </div>
                  <div className="w-6 h-6">
                    <ChessPieceIcon type="q" color="b" set={piece.id} kingFinial={settings.kingFinial || 'crescent'} />
                  </div>
                  <div className="w-6 h-6">
                    <ChessPieceIcon type="n" color="w" set={piece.id} kingFinial={settings.kingFinial || 'crescent'} />
                  </div>
                </div>
                <span className="flex items-center justify-between gap-1">
                  <span className="font-bold text-[11px] truncate">{piece.name}</span>
                  {isSelected && <Check className="w-3 h-3 shrink-0" style={{ color: theme.accentHex }} />}
                </span>
                <span className="text-[9px] truncate" style={{ color: theme.textMutedHex }}>{piece.tagline}</span>
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Classic boards */}
      <div>
        {sectionLabel('Classic boards · 15')}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 md:grid-cols-5 gap-2">
          {ALL_15_BOARD_THEMES.map(board => {
            const isSelected = activeBoard.id === board.id;
            return (
              <button key={board.id} type="button" onClick={() => applyBoard(board.id)} className="p-2 rounded-xl flex flex-col gap-1.5 text-left transition" style={card(isSelected)}>
                <BoardSwatch board={board} />
                <span className="flex items-center justify-between gap-1">
                  <span className="font-bold text-[11px] truncate">{board.name}</span>
                  {isSelected && <Check className="w-3 h-3 shrink-0" style={{ color: theme.accentHex }} />}
                </span>
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* My boards */}
      <div>
        {sectionLabel(`My boards · ${customBoards.length}`)}
        {customBoards.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="rounded-xl px-3 py-3 text-xs" style={{ backgroundColor: theme.cardSecondaryHex, border: `1px dashed ${theme.cardBorderHex}`, color: theme.textMutedHex }}>
            No custom boards yet. Build one below and save it.
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 md:grid-cols-5 gap-2">
            {customBoards.map(recipe => {
              const board = buildCustomBoard(recipe);
              const isSelected = activeBoard.id === recipe.id;
              return (
                <div key={recipe.id} className="p-2 rounded-xl flex flex-col gap-1.5" style={card(isSelected)}>
                  <button type="button" onClick={() => applyBoard(recipe.id)} className="flex flex-col gap-1.5 text-left" title="Use this board">
                    <BoardSwatch board={board} />
                    <span className="flex items-center justify-between gap-1">
                      <span className="font-bold text-[11px] truncate">{recipe.name}</span>
                      {isSelected && <Check className="w-3 h-3 shrink-0" style={{ color: theme.accentHex }} />}
                    </span>
                  </button>
                  <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => setDraft({ ...recipe })}
                      className="flex-1 flex items-center justify-center gap-1 text-[10px] font-bold py-1 rounded-md"
                      style={chip(draft.id === recipe.id)}
                      aria-label={`Edit ${recipe.name}`}
                    >
                      <Pencil className="w-3 h-3" /> Edit
                    </button>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => deleteBoard(recipe.id)}
                      className="flex items-center justify-center px-1.5 py-1 rounded-md"
                      style={{ ...chip(false), color: '#f43f5e' }}
                      aria-label={`Delete ${recipe.name}`}
                    >
                      <Trash2 className="w-3 h-3" />
                    </button>
                  </span>
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Builder */}
      <div>
        {sectionLabel(
          isSaved ? `Editing · ${draft.name}` : 'Create your own board',
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setDraft(recipeFromBoard(activeBoard, newCustomId(), `${activeBoard.name} Remix`))}
            className="flex items-center gap-1 normal-case tracking-normal font-semibold hover:opacity-80"
            style={{ color: theme.accentHex }}
          >
            <Plus className="w-3 h-3" /> New from current board
          </button>
        )}

        <div className="grid md:grid-cols-[1fr_250px] gap-3 items-start">
          {/* Controls */}
          <div className="space-y-3 order-2 md:order-1">
            {group(
              'Theme',
              <div className="grid sm:grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                <label className="flex flex-col gap-1 text-[11px] font-semibold" style={{ color: theme.textSecondary }}>
                  Name
                  <input
                    value={draft.name}
                    maxLength={32}
                    onChange={e => set('name', e.target.value)}
                    className="px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold focus:outline-none"
                    style={{ backgroundColor: theme.cardSecondaryHex, border: `1px solid ${theme.cardBorderHex}`, color: theme.textPrimary }}
                  />
                </label>
                <label className="flex flex-col gap-1 text-[11px] font-semibold" style={{ color: theme.textSecondary }}>
                  Start from a theme
                  <select
                    value=""
                    onChange={e => {
                      if (e.target.value) loadFrom(getBoardTheme(e.target.value as UserSettings['boardTheme'], customBoards));
                    }}
                    className="px-2 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold focus:outline-none cursor-pointer"
                    style={{ backgroundColor: theme.cardSecondaryHex, border: `1px solid ${theme.cardBorderHex}`, color: theme.textPrimary }}
                  >
                    <option value="">Pick a board to remix…</option>
                    <optgroup label="Signature">
                      {SIGNATURE_BOARDS.map(b => <option key={b.id} value={b.id}>{b.name}</option>)}
                    </optgroup>
                    <optgroup label="Classic">
                      {ALL_15_BOARD_THEMES.map(b => <option key={b.id} value={b.id}>{b.name}</option>)}
                    </optgroup>
                    {customBoards.length > 0 && (
                      <optgroup label="My boards">
                        {customBoards.map(b => <option key={b.id} value={b.id}>{b.name}</option>)}
                      </optgroup>
                    )}
                  </select>
                </label>
              </div>
            )}

            {group(
              'Squares',
              <>
                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-2">
                  <ColorField label="Light" value={draft.lightHex} onChange={v => set('lightHex', v)} />
                  <ColorField label="Dark" value={draft.darkHex} onChange={v => set('darkHex', v)} />
                  <ColorField label="Selected" value={draft.selectedHex} onChange={v => set('selectedHex', v)} />
                  <ColorField label="Last move" value={draft.lastMoveHex} onChange={v => set('lastMoveHex', v)} />
                </div>
                <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
                  {TEXTURE_PRESETS.map(t => (
                    <button key={t.id} type="button" onClick={() => set('texture', t.id)} className="px-2 py-1 rounded-md text-[10px] font-bold" style={chip(draft.texture === t.id)}>
                      {t.name}
                    </button>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </>
            )}

            {group(
              'Plating',
              <>
                <div className="grid grid-cols-3 sm:grid-cols-6 gap-1.5">
                  {[
                    { id: 'none', name: 'No frame', plating: 'transparent' },
                    { id: 'custom', name: 'Custom', plating: `linear-gradient(135deg, ${draft.plateA}, ${draft.plateB}, ${draft.plateA})` },
                    ...PLATING_PRESETS
                  ].map(p => {
                    const selected = draft.plating === p.id;
                    return (
                      <button
                        key={p.id}
                        type="button"
                        title={p.name}
                        onClick={() => {
                          const preset = PLATING_PRESETS.find(x => x.id === p.id);
                          setDraft(prev => ({
                            ...prev,
                            plating: p.id,
                            ...(preset ? { rim: preset.rim.startsWith('#') ? preset.rim : prev.rim, innerLine: preset.innerLine.startsWith('#') ? preset.innerLine : prev.innerLine } : {})
                          }));
                        }}
                        className="flex flex-col items-center gap-1 p-1 rounded-lg text-[9px] font-bold"
                        style={card(selected)}
                      >
                        <span
                          className="w-full h-5 rounded"
                          style={{
                            background: p.plating,
                            border: p.id === 'none' ? `1px dashed ${theme.cardBorderHex}` : undefined
                          }}
                        />
                        <span className="truncate w-full text-center">{p.name}</span>
                      </button>
                    );
                  })}
                </div>
                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-2">
                  {draft.plating === 'custom' && (
                    <>
                      <ColorField label="Plate A" value={draft.plateA} onChange={v => set('plateA', v)} />
                      <ColorField label="Plate B" value={draft.plateB} onChange={v => set('plateB', v)} />
                    </>
                  )}
                  <ColorField label="Rim" value={draft.rim} onChange={v => set('rim', v)} disabled={!hasFrame} />
                  <ColorField label="Inner line" value={draft.innerLine} onChange={v => set('innerLine', v)} disabled={!hasFrame} />
                </div>
                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                  <Slider label="Frame width" value={draft.thickness} min={3} max={8} step={0.2} suffix="%" onChange={v => set('thickness', v)} disabled={!hasFrame} />
                  <Slider label="Corner radius" value={draft.radius} min={0} max={24} step={1} suffix="px" onChange={v => set('radius', v)} disabled={!hasFrame} />
                </div>
              </>,
              hasFrame ? undefined : 'Pick a plating to add a frame'
            )}

            {group(
              'Objects',
              <>
                <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
                  {ORNAMENT_OPTIONS.map(o => (
                    <button
                      key={o.id}
                      type="button"
                      disabled={!hasFrame}
                      onClick={() => set('ornament', o.id)}
                      className="px-2 py-1 rounded-md text-[10px] font-bold"
                      style={chip(draft.ornament === o.id, !hasFrame)}
                    >
                      {o.name}
                    </button>
                  ))}
                </div>
                <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2">
                  <ColorField label="Primary" value={draft.primary} onChange={v => set('primary', v)} disabled={!hasOrnaments} />
                  <ColorField label="Secondary" value={draft.secondary} onChange={v => set('secondary', v)} disabled={!hasOrnaments} />
                  <ColorField label="Accent" value={draft.accent} onChange={v => set('accent', v)} disabled={!hasOrnaments} />
                </div>
                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-1.5">
                  <Toggle label="Corners" on={draft.showCorners} onChange={v => set('showCorners', v)} disabled={!hasOrnaments} />
                  <Toggle label="Top & bottom" on={draft.showEdges} onChange={v => set('showEdges', v)} disabled={!hasOrnaments} />
                  <Toggle label="Sides" on={draft.showSides} onChange={v => set('showSides', v)} disabled={!hasOrnaments} />
                  <Toggle label="Studs" on={draft.showStuds} onChange={v => set('showStuds', v)} disabled={!hasOrnaments} />
                </div>
              </>
            )}

            {group(
              'Add-ons',
              <>
                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-2 items-center">
                  <Toggle label="Outer glow" on={draft.glow} onChange={v => set('glow', v)} disabled={!hasFrame} />
                  <ColorField label="Glow colour" value={draft.glowColor} onChange={v => set('glowColor', v)} disabled={!hasFrame || !draft.glow} />
                  <Toggle label="Filigree line" on={draft.bandLine} onChange={v => set('bandLine', v)} disabled={!hasFrame} />
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-wrap">
                  <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold mr-1" style={{ color: theme.textSecondary }}>Animation</span>
                  {(['none', 'pulse', 'twinkle', 'shimmer', 'flicker'] as const).map(m => (
                    <button
                      key={m}
                      type="button"
                      disabled={!hasFrame}
                      onClick={() => set('motion', m)}
                      className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-md text-[10px] font-bold capitalize"
                      style={chip(draft.motion === m, !hasFrame)}
                    >
                      {m === 'none' ? 'Still' : m}
                    </button>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Live preview */}
          <div className="order-1 md:order-2 md:sticky md:top-0 space-y-2">
            <div className="rounded-xl p-2.5" style={{ backgroundColor: theme.cardHex, border: `1px solid ${theme.cardBorderHex}` }}>
              <BoardPreview board={previewBoard} settings={settings} />
            </div>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => saveDraft(false)}
              className="w-full flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition hover:opacity-90"
              style={{ backgroundColor: theme.accentHex, color: theme.accentTextHex }}
            >
              <Save className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              {isSaved ? 'Update & use board' : 'Save & use board'}
            </button>
            <div className="flex gap-1.5">
              {isSaved && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => saveDraft(true)}
                  className="flex-1 flex items-center justify-center gap-1 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-[11px] font-bold"
                  style={chip(false)}
                >
                  <Plus className="w-3 h-3" /> Save as new
                </button>
              )}
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => {
                  const saved = customBoards.find(c => c.id === draft.id);
                  setDraft(saved ? { ...saved } : recipeFromBoard(activeBoard, draft.id, `${activeBoard.name} Remix`));
                }}
                className="flex-1 flex items-center justify-center gap-1 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-[11px] font-bold"
                style={chip(false)}
              >
                <RotateCcw className="w-3 h-3" /> Reset
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};
</file>

<file path="src/components/BoardFrame.tsx">
import React, { useId } from 'react';
import { BoardFrameConfig, BoardOrnamentKind } from '../theme/themes';

/**
 * Decorative frame drawn around a board. Each signature board picks an
 * ornament set: corner pieces (rotated per corner), top/bottom/side
 * medallions and optional quarter studs, all sized relative to the band.
 */

interface OrnamentColors {
  p: string; // primary
  s: string; // secondary
  a: string; // accent
  uid: string;
}

type Draw = (c: OrnamentColors) => React.ReactNode;

interface OrnamentSet {
  corner?: Draw;
  cornerScale?: number;
  top?: Draw;
  bottom?: Draw;
  edgeScale?: number;
  side?: Draw;
  sideScale?: number;
  quarter?: Draw;
  quarterScale?: number;
  /** Extra inset line inside the band (filigree / hairline). */
  bandLine?: (f: BoardFrameConfig) => { color: string; style?: 'solid' | 'dashed' | 'dotted'; width?: number };
  /** Keep corner art upright instead of rotating it into each corner. */
  uprightCorners?: boolean;
  /** Which pieces get the ornament motion class. */
  animated?: Array<'corner' | 'edge' | 'side' | 'quarter'>;
}

/* Pixel-art helper: rows of characters mapped to palette colours. */
const pixelArt = (rows: string[], palette: Record<string, string>, size = 40) => {
  const cols = Math.max(...rows.map(r => r.length));
  const cell = Math.floor(size / Math.max(cols, rows.length));
  const ox = (size - cols * cell) / 2;
  const oy = (size - rows.length * cell) / 2;
  const rects: React.ReactNode[] = [];
  rows.forEach((row, y) =>
    row.split('').forEach((ch, x) => {
      const fill = palette[ch];
      if (fill) rects.push(<rect key={`${x}-${y}`} x={ox + x * cell} y={oy + y * cell} width={cell} height={cell} fill={fill} />);
    })
  );
  return <g shapeRendering="crispEdges">{rects}</g>;
};

const star4 = (cx: number, cy: number, r: number, inner = 0.28) => {
  const i = r * inner;
  return `M${cx} ${cy - r} Q${cx + i} ${cy - i} ${cx + r} ${cy} Q${cx + i} ${cy + i} ${cx} ${cy + r} Q${cx - i} ${cy + i} ${cx - r} ${cy} Q${cx - i} ${cy - i} ${cx} ${cy - r}Z`;
};

const hexPoints = (cx: number, cy: number, r: number) =>
  Array.from({ length: 6 }, (_, k) => {
    const ang = (Math.PI / 3) * k - Math.PI / 2;
    return `${(cx + r * Math.cos(ang)).toFixed(2)},${(cy + r * Math.sin(ang)).toFixed(2)}`;
  }).join(' ');

const goldGrad = (id: string, light: string, dark: string) => (
  <linearGradient id={id} x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
    <stop offset="0" stopColor={light} />
    <stop offset="0.45" stopColor={dark} />
    <stop offset="0.7" stopColor={light} />
    <stop offset="1" stopColor={dark} />
  </linearGradient>
);

    sideScale: 1.2,
    quarter: ({ p }) => <rect x="17" y="8" width="6" height="24" fill={p} />,
    quarterScale: 0.6,
    bandLine: () => ({ color: '#ffffff', width: 1 })
  },

  /* Celestial — sun, crescent moon and twinkling stars */
  celestial: {
    cornerScale: 1.5,
    corner: ({ p, a }) => (
      <g>
        <path d={star4(20, 20, 15)} fill={p} />
        <path d={star4(20, 20, 6)} fill={a} />
      </g>
    ),
    edgeScale: 1.95,
    top: ({ p, uid }) => (
      <g>
        <defs>
          <radialGradient id={`${uid}-sun`} cx="0.4" cy="0.4" r="0.7">
            <stop offset="0" stopColor="#fffbeb" />
            <stop offset="0.6" stopColor={p} />
            <stop offset="1" stopColor="#f59e0b" />
          </radialGradient>
        </defs>
        {Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_, k) => {
          const ang = (Math.PI / 6) * k;
          const tip = k % 2 === 0 ? 17 : 13.5;
          const w = 0.22;
          const x1 = 20 + 9 * Math.cos(ang - w);
          const y1 = 20 + 9 * Math.sin(ang - w);
          const x2 = 20 + 9 * Math.cos(ang + w);
          const y2 = 20 + 9 * Math.sin(ang + w);
          return <polygon key={k} points={`${x1},${y1} ${20 + tip * Math.cos(ang)},${20 + tip * Math.sin(ang)} ${x2},${y2}`} fill={p} />;
        })}
        <circle cx="20" cy="20" r="8.5" fill={`url(#${uid}-sun)`} />
      </g>
    ),
    bottom: ({ p, s }) => (
      <g>
        <path d="M24 5a15 15 0 1 0 11 24 12 12 0 1 1-11-24z" fill={p} />
        <path d={star4(30, 11, 4)} fill={s} />
      </g>
    ),
    side: ({ p, s }) => (
      <g>
        <path d={star4(20, 20, 13)} fill={s} />
        <circle cx="20" cy="20" r="2.4" fill={p} />
      </g>
    ),
    sideScale: 1.3,
    quarter: ({ p }) => <path d={star4(20, 20, 12)} fill={p} />,
    quarterScale: 0.65,
    bandLine: f => ({ color: f.primary, style: 'dotted', width: 1 }),
    animated: ['corner', 'side', 'quarter']
  }
};

interface BoardFrameProps {
  frame?: BoardFrameConfig;
  /** Disable ornament motion (battery saver). */
  still?: boolean;
  children: React.ReactNode;
}

export const BoardFrame: React.FC<BoardFrameProps> = ({ frame, still, children }) => {
  const uid = useId().replace(/:/g, '');
  if (!frame) return <>{children}</>;

  const baseSet: OrnamentSet = frame.ornament === 'none' ? {} : ORNAMENTS[frame.ornament];
  const parts = frame.parts || {};
  const set: OrnamentSet = {
    ...baseSet,
    corner: parts.corners === false ? undefined : baseSet.corner,
    top: parts.edges === false ? undefined : baseSet.top,
    bottom: parts.edges === false ? undefined : baseSet.bottom,
    side: parts.sides === false ? undefined : baseSet.side,
    quarter: parts.studs === false ? undefined : baseSet.quarter,
    bandLine:
      frame.bandLine === false
        ? undefined
        : baseSet.bandLine || (frame.ornament === 'none' ? f => ({ color: f.innerLine, width: 1 }) : undefined)
  };
  const t = frame.thickness ?? 4.5;
  const colors: OrnamentColors = { p: frame.primary, s: frame.secondary, a: frame.accent, uid };
  const motionClass = !still && frame.motion ? `board-orn-${frame.motion === 'shimmer' ? 'pulse' : frame.motion}` : '';
  const animated = new Set<'corner' | 'edge' | 'side' | 'quarter'>(
    frame.animateAll ? ['corner', 'edge', 'side', 'quarter'] : set.animated || []
  );

  // Ornament box size (as % of frame width) and its offset from the outer edge.
  // Large ornaments are pushed outward so they barely overlap the squares.
  const offsetFor = (size: number) => Math.min((t - size) / 2, t * 1.1 - size);

  const sizes = [
    set.corner ? t * (set.cornerScale ?? 1.4) : 0,
    set.top || set.bottom ? t * (set.edgeScale ?? 1.4) : 0,
    set.side ? t * (set.sideScale ?? 1.3) : 0,
    set.quarter ? t * (set.quarterScale ?? 0.7) : 0
  ];
  const protrusion = Math.max(0, ...sizes.filter(Boolean).map(sz => -offsetFor(sz)));

  const svg = (draw: Draw, key: string, animate: boolean) => (
    <svg
      viewBox="0 0 40 40"
      width="100%"
      height="100%"
      overflow="visible"
      aria-hidden="true"
      className={animate ? motionClass : undefined}
      style={animate && motionClass ? { animationDelay: `${(key.length * 0.37 + key.charCodeAt(key.length - 1) * 0.11) % 2.4}s` } : undefined}
    >
      {draw({ ...colors, uid: `${uid}-${key}` })}
    </svg>
  );

  const ornamentBox = (
    key: string,
    draw: Draw,
    size: number,
    place: React.CSSProperties,
    rotate = 0,
    kind: 'corner' | 'edge' | 'side' | 'quarter'
  ) => (
    <div
      key={key}
      className="absolute pointer-events-none"
      style={{
        width: `${size}%`,
        aspectRatio: '1 / 1',
        zIndex: 3,
        filter: frame.glow ? `drop-shadow(0 0 3px ${frame.glow})` : 'drop-shadow(0 1px 1.5px rgba(0,0,0,0.45))',
        ...place
      }}
    >
      <div className="w-full h-full" style={{ transform: rotate ? `rotate(${rotate}deg)` : undefined }}>
        {svg(draw, key, animated.has(kind))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );

  const ornaments: React.ReactNode[] = [];

  if (set.corner) {
    const sz = sizes[0];
    const m = `${offsetFor(sz)}%`;
    const rot = (deg: number) => (set.uprightCorners ? 0 : deg);
    ornaments.push(
      ornamentBox('c-tl', set.corner, sz, { top: 0, left: 0, marginTop: m, marginLeft: m }, rot(0), 'corner'),
      ornamentBox('c-tr', set.corner, sz, { top: 0, right: 0, marginTop: m, marginRight: m }, rot(90), 'corner'),
      ornamentBox('c-br', set.corner, sz, { bottom: 0, right: 0, marginBottom: m, marginRight: m }, rot(180), 'corner'),
      ornamentBox('c-bl', set.corner, sz, { bottom: 0, left: 0, marginBottom: m, marginLeft: m }, rot(270), 'corner')
    );
  }

  if (set.top || set.bottom) {
    const sz = sizes[1];
    const m = `${offsetFor(sz)}%`;
    const top = set.top || set.bottom!;
    const bottom = set.bottom || set.top!;
    ornaments.push(
      ornamentBox('e-t', top, sz, { top: 0, left: `${50 - sz / 2}%`, marginTop: m }, 0, 'edge'),
      ornamentBox('e-b', bottom, sz, { bottom: 0, left: `${50 - sz / 2}%`, marginBottom: m }, 0, 'edge')
    );
  }

  if (set.side) {
    const sz = sizes[2];
    const m = `${offsetFor(sz)}%`;
    ornaments.push(
      ornamentBox('s-l', set.side, sz, { left: 0, top: '50%', marginLeft: m, transform: 'translateY(-50%)' }, 0, 'side'),
      ornamentBox('s-r', set.side, sz, { right: 0, top: '50%', marginRight: m, transform: 'translateY(-50%)' }, 0, 'side')
    );
  }

  if (set.quarter) {
    const sz = sizes[3];
    const m = `${offsetFor(sz)}%`;
    const along = [25, 75];
    along.forEach(pct => {
      ornaments.push(
        ornamentBox(`q-t${pct}`, set.quarter!, sz, { top: 0, left: `calc(${pct}% - ${sz / 2}%)`, marginTop: m }, 0, 'quarter'),
        ornamentBox(`q-b${pct}`, set.quarter!, sz, { bottom: 0, left: `calc(${pct}% - ${sz / 2}%)`, marginBottom: m }, 0, 'quarter'),
        ornamentBox(`q-l${pct}`, set.quarter!, sz, { left: 0, top: `${pct}%`, marginLeft: m, transform: 'translateY(-50%)' }, 0, 'quarter'),
        ornamentBox(`q-r${pct}`, set.quarter!, sz, { right: 0, top: `${pct}%`, marginRight: m, transform: 'translateY(-50%)' }, 0, 'quarter')
      );
    });
  }

  const radius = frame.radius ?? 12;
  const line = set.bandLine?.(frame);
  const shadows = [
    `0 0 0 1.5px ${frame.rim}`,
    'inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.28)',
    'inset 0 -1.5px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.35)',
    frame.glow ? `0 0 26px 2px ${frame.glow}` : '',
    '0 22px 44px -16px rgba(0,0,0,0.6)'
  ].filter(Boolean);

  return (
    <div className="w-full" style={{ padding: `${protrusion + 0.6}%` }}>
      <div
        className="relative w-full"
        data-board-frame={frame.ornament}
        style={{
          padding: `${t}%`,
          background: frame.plating,
          borderRadius: radius,
          boxShadow: shadows.join(', '),
          backdropFilter: frame.frosted ? 'blur(14px) saturate(1.4)' : undefined,
          WebkitBackdropFilter: frame.frosted ? 'blur(14px) saturate(1.4)' : undefined
        }}
      >
        {/* Inset filigree / hairline running around the band */}
        {line && (
          <div
            className="absolute inset-0 pointer-events-none"
            style={{
              margin: `${t * 0.32}%`,
              border: `${line.width ?? 1}px ${line.style ?? 'solid'} ${line.color}`,
              borderRadius: Math.max(radius - 4, 0),
              opacity: 0.85
            }}
          />
        )}

        {/* Moving sheen across metallic / crystal bands */}
        {frame.motion === 'shimmer' && !still && (
          <div className="absolute inset-0 pointer-events-none overflow-hidden" style={{ borderRadius: radius }}>
            <div className="board-frame-sheen absolute inset-0" />
          </div>
        )}

        <div
          className="relative"
          style={{
            zIndex: 1,
            borderRadius: Math.max(radius - 6, 2),
            boxShadow: `0 0 0 1.5px ${frame.innerLine}, 0 0 0 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.35), inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.2)`
          }}
        >
          {children}
        </div>

        {ornaments}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};
</file>

      );
  }
};
