<file path="src/components/ChessBoard.tsx">
import React, { useState, useId, useRef, useEffect, useMemo } from 'react';
import { createPortal } from 'react-dom';
import { Chess, Square, Move } from 'chess.js';
import {
  BoardThemeId,
  PieceSetId,
  PieceType,
  PieceColor,
  CustomBoardSquare,
  PremoveMode,
  MoveClassification
} from '../types/chess';
import { ChessPieceIcon } from './ChessPieces';
import { MoveClassificationBadge } from './MoveClassificationBadge';
import { resolveBoardTheme } from '../theme/themes';
import { BoardFrame } from './BoardFrame';
import { useAppTheme } from '../context/ThemeContext';
import { coordsToSquare } from '../engine/customVariantEngine';

export interface CustomBoardMoveTarget {
  fromRow: number;
  fromCol: number;
  toRow: number;
  toCol: number;
}

export interface QueuedPremove {
  from: Square;
  to: Square;
  promotion?: string;
}

interface ChessBoardProps {
  chess?: Chess;
  isFlipped: boolean;
  theme?: BoardThemeId;
  pieceSet?: PieceSetId;
  showCoordinates?: 'inside' | 'outside' | 'hidden';
  bestMoveArrow?: { from: Square; to: Square } | null;
  moveClassification?: { square: Square; type: MoveClassification } | null;
  threatenedSquares?: Square[];
  duckSquare?: Square | null;
  isPlacingDuck?: boolean;
  blindfold?: boolean;
  onMakeMove?: (move: { from: Square; to: Square; promotion?: string }) => boolean | void;
  onPlaceDuck?: (square: Square) => void;
  disabled?: boolean;
  // Premove props (8x8 mode)
  playerColor?: PieceColor;
  premoveMode?: PremoveMode;
  premoves?: QueuedPremove[];
  onQueuePremove?: (move: QueuedPremove) => void;
  onCancelPremoves?: () => void;
  // Custom / Fairy Variant Engine Mode Props
  customGrid?: (CustomBoardSquare | null)[][];
  customTurn?: PieceColor;
  customLegalMoves?: CustomBoardMoveTarget[];
  customLastMove?: CustomBoardMoveTarget | null;
  customCheckSquare?: { row: number; col: number } | null;
  customDuckPos?: { row: number; col: number } | null;
  onCustomMove?: (move: CustomBoardMoveTarget) => void;
  onCustomPlaceDuck?: (pos: { row: number; col: number }) => void;
}

interface ActiveDragState {
  pieceType: PieceType;
  pieceColor: PieceColor;
  fromSquare?: Square;
  fromCustomPos?: { row: number; col: number };
  startX: number;
  startY: number;
  clientX: number;
  clientY: number;
  isDragging: boolean;
  cellSize: number;
  isPremoveDrag?: boolean;
}

interface PendingPromotion {
  from: Square;
  to: Square;
  color: PieceColor;
  isPremove: boolean;
}

const FILES = ['a', 'b', 'c', 'd', 'e', 'f', 'g', 'h'] as const;

function buildVirtualBoard(
  chess: Chess,
  premoves: QueuedPremove[]
): Record<string, { type: PieceType; color: PieceColor }> {
  const map: Record<string, { type: PieceType; color: PieceColor }> = {};
  const b = chess.board();
  for (let r = 0; r < 8; r++) {
    for (let c = 0; c < 8; c++) {
      const sqPiece = b[r][c];
      if (sqPiece) {
        const sq = `${FILES[c]}${8 - r}`;
        map[sq] = {
          type: sqPiece.type as PieceType,
          color: sqPiece.color as PieceColor
        };
      }
    }
  }

  for (const pm of premoves) {
    const moving = map[pm.from];
    if (!moving) continue;
    delete map[pm.from];

    // Handle simple castling rook translation in virtual preview
    if (moving.type === 'k') {
      const fromFile = pm.from.charCodeAt(0);
      const toFile = pm.to.charCodeAt(0);
      const rank = pm.from[1];
      if (toFile - fromFile === 2 && map[`h${rank}`]?.type === 'r') {
        map[`f${rank}`] = map[`h${rank}`];
        delete map[`h${rank}`];
      } else if (fromFile - toFile === 2 && map[`a${rank}`]?.type === 'r') {
        map[`d${rank}`] = map[`a${rank}`];
        delete map[`a${rank}`];
      }
    }

    const promoType =
      moving.type === 'p' && (pm.to[1] === '8' || pm.to[1] === '1')
        ? ((pm.promotion || 'q') as PieceType)
        : moving.type;

    map[pm.to] = { type: promoType, color: moving.color };
  }

  return map;
}

function getPseudoPremoveTargets(
  virtualBoard: Record<string, { type: PieceType; color: PieceColor }>,
  from: Square,
  color: PieceColor
): Square[] {
  const piece = virtualBoard[from];
  if (!piece || piece.color !== color) return [];

  const fileIdx = FILES.indexOf(from[0] as (typeof FILES)[number]);
  const rankNum = parseInt(from[1], 10);
  if (fileIdx < 0 || Number.isNaN(rankNum)) return [];

  const targets: Square[] = [];
  const pushIfValid = (f: number, r: number): boolean => {
    if (f < 0 || f > 7 || r < 1 || r > 8) return false;
    const sq = `${FILES[f]}${r}` as Square;
    const occ = virtualBoard[sq];
    if (occ && occ.color === color) return false;
    targets.push(sq);
    return true;
  };

  const t = piece.type;
  if (t === 'p') {
    const dir = color === 'w' ? 1 : -1;
    const startRank = color === 'w' ? 2 : 7;
    pushIfValid(fileIdx, rankNum + dir);
    if (rankNum === startRank) {
      const midSq = `${FILES[fileIdx]}${rankNum + dir}` as Square;
      if (!virtualBoard[midSq] || virtualBoard[midSq].color !== color) {
        pushIfValid(fileIdx, rankNum + dir * 2);
      }
    }
    pushIfValid(fileIdx - 1, rankNum + dir);
    pushIfValid(fileIdx + 1, rankNum + dir);
  } else if (t === 'n') {
    const jumps = [
      [1, 2], [2, 1], [-1, 2], [-2, 1],
      [1, -2], [2, -1], [-1, -2], [-2, -1]
    ];
    for (const [df, dr] of jumps) pushIfValid(fileIdx + df, rankNum + dr);
  } else if (t === 'k') {
    for (let df = -1; df <= 1; df++) {
      for (let dr = -1; dr <= 1; dr++) {
        if (df === 0 && dr === 0) continue;
        pushIfValid(fileIdx + df, rankNum + dr);
      }
    }
    // Back-rank castling premove targets
    if ((color === 'w' && from === 'e1') || (color === 'b' && from === 'e8')) {
      pushIfValid(fileIdx + 2, rankNum);
      pushIfValid(fileIdx - 2, rankNum);
    }
  } else {
    const dirs: number[][] = [];
    if (t === 'b' || t === 'q') dirs.push([1, 1], [1, -1], [-1, 1], [-1, -1]);
    if (t === 'r' || t === 'q') dirs.push([1, 0], [-1, 0], [0, 1], [0, -1]);
    for (const [df, dr] of dirs) {
      for (let step = 1; step < 8; step++) {
        const nf = fileIdx + df * step;
        const nr = rankNum + dr * step;
        if (nf < 0 || nf > 7 || nr < 1 || nr > 8) break;
        const sq = `${FILES[nf]}${nr}` as Square;
        const occ = virtualBoard[sq];
        if (occ && occ.color === color) break;
        // Chess.com premoves allow sliding across enemy pieces in anticipation of captures/evasion
        targets.push(sq);
      }
    }
  }

  return targets;
}

/** Max board width in px for the Board Size setting (60–140% of the standard 540px board). */
export function getBoardMaxWidthPx(boardSize?: number): number {
  const percent = Math.min(140, Math.max(60, boardSize || 100));
  return Math.round(540 * (percent / 100));
}

export const ChessBoard: React.FC<ChessBoardProps> = ({
  chess,
  isFlipped,
  theme,
  pieceSet,
  showCoordinates,
  bestMoveArrow = null,
  moveClassification = null,
  threatenedSquares = [],
  duckSquare = null,
  isPlacingDuck = false,
  blindfold = false,
  onMakeMove,
  onPlaceDuck,
  disabled = false,
  playerColor,
  premoveMode = 'off',
  premoves = [],
  onQueuePremove,
  onCancelPremoves,
  customGrid,
  customTurn = 'w',
  customLegalMoves = [],
  customLastMove = null,
  customCheckSquare = null,
  customDuckPos = null,
  onCustomMove,
  onCustomPlaceDuck
}) => {
  const { theme: appTheme, settings } = useAppTheme();
  const activeBoardThemeId = theme || settings.boardTheme || 'emerald';
  const activePieceSet = pieceSet || settings.pieceSet || 'neo';
  const activeCoordMode = showCoordinates || settings.showCoordinates || 'inside';
  const activeFinial = settings.kingFinial || 'crescent';
  const highlightLegal = settings.highlightLegalMoves !== false;
  const inputMethod = settings.moveInputMethod || 'both';
  const autoQueen = settings.autoQueen !== false;
  const reduceMotion = settings.batterySaver;
  const keyboardControlEnabled = Boolean(settings.keyboardControl);
  // Board size setting scales the standard 540px board (always capped by the available width)
  const boardMaxWidth = `${getBoardMaxWidthPx(settings.boardSize)}px`;

  const gridHeight = customGrid ? customGrid.length : 8;
  const gridWidth = customGrid ? customGrid[0]?.length || 8 : 8;

  const [selectedSquare, setSelectedSquare] = useState<Square | null>(null);
  const [legalMoves, setLegalMoves] = useState<Move[]>([]);
  const [premoveSelectedSq, setPremoveSelectedSq] = useState<Square | null>(null);
  const [premoveTargets, setPremoveTargets] = useState<Square[]>([]);
  const [selectedCustomPos, setSelectedCustomPos] = useState<{ row: number; col: number } | null>(null);
  const [keyboardCursor, setKeyboardCursor] = useState<{ row: number; col: number } | null>(null);

  const [dragState, setDragState] = useState<ActiveDragState | null>(null);
  const [hoverTargetKey, setHoverTargetKey] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [pendingPromotion, setPendingPromotion] = useState<PendingPromotion | null>(null);

  // Right-click square annotations & tactical arrow drawing
  const [highlightedSquares, setHighlightedSquares] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
  const [userArrows, setUserArrows] = useState<Array<{ from: string; to: string; color: string }>>([]);
  const rightDragOriginRef = useRef<string | null>(null);

  const [moveNonce, setMoveNonce] = useState<number>(0);
  const prevLastMoveSigRef = useRef<string>('');
  const boardGridRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
  const suppressNextClickRef = useRef<boolean>(false);
  const suppressClickTimerRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);
  const justSelectedOnPointerDownRef = useRef<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      if (suppressClickTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(suppressClickTimerRef.current);
    };
  }, []);

  const arrowMarkerId = useId();
  const boardTheme = resolveBoardTheme(
    { ...settings, boardTheme: activeBoardThemeId },
    activePieceSet
  );
  const isFramed = Boolean(boardTheme.frame);
  const squareTextureFor = (isDark: boolean, highlighted: boolean) =>
    highlighted ? undefined : isDark ? boardTheme.squareTexture?.dark : boardTheme.squareTexture?.light;

  const fenStr = chess?.fen() || '';
  const history = chess ? chess.history({ verbose: true }) : [];
  const lastMove = history.length > 0 ? history[history.length - 1] : null;
  const lastMoveSignature = customGrid
    ? customLastMove
      ? `c:${customLastMove.fromRow},${customLastMove.fromCol}-${customLastMove.toRow},${customLastMove.toCol}`
      : ''
    : lastMove
    ? `s:${lastMove.from}-${lastMove.to}-${history.length}`
    : fenStr;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (lastMoveSignature && lastMoveSignature !== prevLastMoveSigRef.current) {
      prevLastMoveSigRef.current = lastMoveSignature;
      setMoveNonce(n => n + 1);
    }
  }, [lastMoveSignature]);

  const canPremoveNow = Boolean(
    chess &&
      !customGrid &&
      playerColor &&
      premoveMode !== 'off' &&
      !isPlacingDuck &&
      onQueuePremove &&
      (chess.turn() !== playerColor || premoves.length > 0)
  );

  const virtualBoard = useMemo(() => {
    if (!chess) return {};
    return buildVirtualBoard(chess, premoves);
  }, [chess, fenStr, premoves]);

  const prevTurnRef = useRef<string>(chess?.turn() || 'w');

  // Clear stale selections on position updates, preserving click selection seamlessly if opponent moved mid-click
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!chess) {
      setSelectedSquare(null);
      setLegalMoves([]);
      setPremoveSelectedSq(null);
      setPremoveTargets([]);
      return;
    }

    const currentTurn = chess.turn();
    const prevTurn = prevTurnRef.current;
    prevTurnRef.current = currentTurn;

    if (
      prevTurn !== currentTurn &&
      playerColor &&
      currentTurn === playerColor &&
      premoves.length === 0 &&
      premoveSelectedSq
    ) {
      const pieceOnNewTurn = chess.get(premoveSelectedSq);
      if (pieceOnNewTurn && pieceOnNewTurn.color === playerColor) {
        const moves = chess.moves({ square: premoveSelectedSq, verbose: true });
        setSelectedSquare(premoveSelectedSq);
        setLegalMoves(duckSquare ? moves.filter(m => m.to !== duckSquare) : moves);
        setPremoveSelectedSq(null);
        setPremoveTargets([]);
        return;
      }
    }

    if (
      canPremoveNow &&
      playerColor &&
      chess.turn() !== playerColor &&
      premoveSelectedSq
    ) {
      const stillValidVirtual = virtualBoard[premoveSelectedSq];
      if (stillValidVirtual && stillValidVirtual.color === playerColor) {
        setPremoveTargets(getPseudoPremoveTargets(virtualBoard, premoveSelectedSq, playerColor));
        return;
      }
    }

    if (premoves.length > 0 && premoveSelectedSq) {
      const stillValidVirtual = virtualBoard[premoveSelectedSq];
      if (stillValidVirtual && playerColor && stillValidVirtual.color === playerColor) {
        setPremoveTargets(getPseudoPremoveTargets(virtualBoard, premoveSelectedSq, playerColor));
        return;
      }
    }

    setSelectedSquare(null);
    setLegalMoves([]);
    setPremoveSelectedSq(null);
    setPremoveTargets([]);
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [fenStr, customTurn]);

  // Clear stale premove selection immediately if premove capability ends or an invalidated queue is cleared
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!canPremoveNow && premoveSelectedSq) {
      setPremoveSelectedSq(null);
      setPremoveTargets([]);
    } else if (premoveSelectedSq && playerColor) {
      const stillValid = virtualBoard[premoveSelectedSq];
      if (!stillValid || stillValid.color !== playerColor) {
        setPremoveSelectedSq(null);
        setPremoveTargets([]);
      }
    }
  }, [canPremoveNow, premoves.length, premoveSelectedSq, playerColor, virtualBoard]);

  // Helper to resolve pointer coordinates to grid square / custom row-col
  const hitTestGrid = (clientX: number, clientY: number) => {
    const el = boardGridRef.current;
    if (!el) return null;
    const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
    if (
      clientX < rect.left ||
      clientX > rect.right ||
      clientY < rect.top ||
      clientY > rect.bottom
    ) {
      return null;
    }

    if (customGrid) {
      const height = customGrid.length;
      const width = customGrid[0]?.length || 8;
      const visCol = Math.min(width - 1, Math.max(0, Math.floor(((clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * width)));
      const visRow = Math.min(height - 1, Math.max(0, Math.floor(((clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * height)));
      const row = isFlipped ? height - 1 - visRow : visRow;
      const col = isFlipped ? width - 1 - visCol : visCol;
      return { kind: 'custom' as const, row, col, key: `${row},${col}` };
    } else {
      const visCol = Math.min(7, Math.max(0, Math.floor(((clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * 8)));
      const visRow = Math.min(7, Math.max(0, Math.floor(((clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * 8)));
      const ranks = isFlipped ? [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8] : [8, 7, 6, 5, 4, 3, 2, 1];
      const files = isFlipped ? ['h', 'g', 'f', 'e', 'd', 'c', 'b', 'a'] : ['a', 'b', 'c', 'd', 'e', 'f', 'g', 'h'];
      const sq = `${files[visCol]}${ranks[visRow]}` as Square;
      return { kind: 'standard' as const, square: sq, key: sq };
    }
  };

  const commitStandardMoveOrPromo = (
    from: Square,
    to: Square,
    isPremove: boolean
  ) => {
    if (!chess) return;
    const movingPiece = isPremove ? virtualBoard[from] : chess.get(from);
    const isPromotion =
      movingPiece?.type === 'p' && (to[1] === '8' || to[1] === '1');

    if (isPromotion && !autoQueen) {
      setPendingPromotion({
        from,
        to,
        color: (movingPiece?.color || playerColor || chess.turn()) as PieceColor,
        isPremove
      });
      return;
    }

    const promo = isPromotion ? 'q' : undefined;
    if (isPremove) {
      onQueuePremove?.({ from, to, promotion: promo });
    } else {
      onMakeMove?.({ from, to, promotion: promo });
    }
  };

  // Global pointer tracking for smooth drag-and-drop without clipping or listener thrashing
  const isDragActive = Boolean(dragState);
  const dragHandlersRef = useRef<{
    onMove: (e: PointerEvent) => void;
    onUp: (e: PointerEvent) => void;
  }>({
    onMove: () => {},
    onUp: () => {}
  });

  // The floating piece follows the pointer by writing its transform directly (once per frame),
  // so dragging never re-renders the board; React only updates when the hovered square changes.
  const dragPointRef = useRef<{ x: number; y: number }>({ x: 0, y: 0 });
  const floatingPieceRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
  const dragRafRef = useRef<number | null>(null);
  const hoverKeyRef = useRef<string | null>(null);

  const positionFloatingPiece = () => {
    dragRafRef.current = null;
    const el = floatingPieceRef.current;
    if (!el) return;
    const { x, y } = dragPointRef.current;
    el.style.transform = `translate3d(${x}px, ${y}px, 0)`;
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isDragActive) return;
    if (dragRafRef.current !== null) {
      cancelAnimationFrame(dragRafRef.current);
      dragRafRef.current = null;
    }
    hoverKeyRef.current = null;
  }, [isDragActive]);

  dragHandlersRef.current.onMove = (e: PointerEvent) => {
    if (!dragState) return;
    dragPointRef.current = { x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY };
    const dx = e.clientX - dragState.startX;
    const dy = e.clientY - dragState.startY;
    const started = dragState.isDragging || Math.hypot(dx, dy) > 5;
    if (!started) return;

    if (!dragState.isDragging) {
      setDragState(prev => (prev ? { ...prev, clientX: e.clientX, clientY: e.clientY, isDragging: true } : null));
    }
    if (dragRafRef.current === null) {
      dragRafRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(positionFloatingPiece);
    }

    const hit = hitTestGrid(e.clientX, e.clientY);
    const nextKey = hit ? hit.key : null;
    if (nextKey !== hoverKeyRef.current) {
      hoverKeyRef.current = nextKey;
      setHoverTargetKey(nextKey);
    }
  };

  dragHandlersRef.current.onUp = (e: PointerEvent) => {
    if (!dragState) return;
    const hit = hitTestGrid(e.clientX, e.clientY);
    if (dragState.isDragging) {
      suppressNextClickRef.current = true;
      if (suppressClickTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(suppressClickTimerRef.current);
      suppressClickTimerRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
        suppressNextClickRef.current = false;
        suppressClickTimerRef.current = null;
      }, 150);

      if (hit && hit.kind === 'standard' && dragState.fromSquare && chess) {
        if (hit.square !== dragState.fromSquare) {
          if (dragState.isPremoveDrag && canPremoveNow && playerColor) {
            const pseudo = getPseudoPremoveTargets(virtualBoard, dragState.fromSquare, playerColor);
            if (pseudo.includes(hit.square)) {
              commitStandardMoveOrPromo(dragState.fromSquare, hit.square, true);
            }
          } else if (
            !disabled &&
            !isPlacingDuck &&
            (!dragState.isPremoveDrag || !playerColor || chess.turn() === playerColor)
          ) {
            const moves = chess.moves({ square: dragState.fromSquare, verbose: true });
            const filtered = duckSquare ? moves.filter(m => m.to !== duckSquare) : moves;
            if (filtered.some(m => m.to === hit.square)) {
              commitStandardMoveOrPromo(dragState.fromSquare, hit.square, false);
            }
          }
          setSelectedSquare(null);
          setLegalMoves([]);
          setPremoveSelectedSq(null);
          setPremoveTargets([]);
        }
      } else if (!hit) {
        setSelectedSquare(null);
        setLegalMoves([]);
        setPremoveSelectedSq(null);
        setPremoveTargets([]);
      } else if (hit && hit.kind === 'custom' && dragState.fromCustomPos && !disabled && !isPlacingDuck) {
        const match = customLegalMoves.find(
          m =>
            m.fromRow === dragState.fromCustomPos!.row &&
            m.fromCol === dragState.fromCustomPos!.col &&
            m.toRow === hit.row &&
            m.toCol === hit.col
        );
        if (match) {
          onCustomMove?.(match);
        }
        if (hit.row !== dragState.fromCustomPos.row || hit.col !== dragState.fromCustomPos.col) {
          setSelectedCustomPos(null);
        }
      }
    }

    setDragState(null);
    setHoverTargetKey(null);
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isDragActive) return;
    const handlePointerMove = (e: PointerEvent) => dragHandlersRef.current.onMove(e);
    const handlePointerUp = (e: PointerEvent) => dragHandlersRef.current.onUp(e);

    window.addEventListener('pointermove', handlePointerMove);
    window.addEventListener('pointerup', handlePointerUp);
    window.addEventListener('pointercancel', handlePointerUp);

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('pointermove', handlePointerMove);
      window.removeEventListener('pointerup', handlePointerUp);
      window.removeEventListener('pointercancel', handlePointerUp);
    };
  }, [isDragActive]);

  // Initialize / clear keyboard cursor cleanly when setting or board dimensions change
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!keyboardControlEnabled) {
      setKeyboardCursor(null);
      return;
    }
    setKeyboardCursor(prev => {
      if (prev && prev.row >= 0 && prev.row < gridHeight && prev.col >= 0 && prev.col < gridWidth) {
        return prev;
      }
      return {
        row: isFlipped ? Math.min(gridHeight - 1, 1) : Math.max(0, gridHeight - 2),
        col: Math.min(gridWidth - 1, 4)
      };
    });
  }, [keyboardControlEnabled, gridHeight, gridWidth, isFlipped]);

  // Helper to commit a square click via either pointer or keyboard activation
  const activateGridPosition = (row: number, col: number) => {
    if (customGrid) {
      if (disabled) return;
      if (isPlacingDuck) {
        if (!customGrid[row]?.[col] && !(customDuckPos?.row === row && customDuckPos?.col === col)) {
          onCustomPlaceDuck?.({ row, col });
        }
        return;
      }
      if (selectedCustomPos) {
        if (selectedCustomPos.row === row && selectedCustomPos.col === col) {
          setSelectedCustomPos(null);
          return;
        }
        const match = customLegalMoves.find(
          m =>
            m.fromRow === selectedCustomPos.row &&
            m.fromCol === selectedCustomPos.col &&
            m.toRow === row &&
            m.toCol === col
        );
        if (match) {
          onCustomMove?.(match);
          setSelectedCustomPos(null);
          return;
        }
      }
      const piece = customGrid[row]?.[col];
      if (piece && piece.color === customTurn && piece.type !== 'd') {
        setSelectedCustomPos({ row, col });
      } else {
        setSelectedCustomPos(null);
      }
      return;
    }

    if (!chess) return;
    const sq = `${FILES[col]}${8 - row}` as Square;

    if (isPlacingDuck) {
      if (!chess.get(sq) && sq !== duckSquare) {
        onPlaceDuck?.(sq);
      }
      return;
    }

    if (canPremoveNow && playerColor) {
      if (premoveSelectedSq) {
        if (premoveSelectedSq === sq) {
          setPremoveSelectedSq(null);
          setPremoveTargets([]);
          return;
        }
        if (premoveTargets.includes(sq)) {
          commitStandardMoveOrPromo(premoveSelectedSq, sq, true);
          setPremoveSelectedSq(null);
          setPremoveTargets([]);
          return;
        }
      }
      const vPiece = virtualBoard[sq];
      if (vPiece && vPiece.color === playerColor) {
        setPremoveSelectedSq(sq);
        setPremoveTargets(getPseudoPremoveTargets(virtualBoard, sq, playerColor));
      } else {
        setPremoveSelectedSq(null);
        setPremoveTargets([]);
        if (!premoveSelectedSq && premoves.length > 0) {
          onCancelPremoves?.();
        }
      }
      return;
    }

    if (disabled) return;
    if (selectedSquare) {
      if (selectedSquare === sq) {
        setSelectedSquare(null);
        setLegalMoves([]);
        return;
      }
      const matchMove = legalMoves.find(m => m.to === sq);
      if (matchMove) {
        commitStandardMoveOrPromo(selectedSquare, sq, false);
        setSelectedSquare(null);
        setLegalMoves([]);
        return;
      }
    }

    const piece = chess.get(sq);
    if (piece && piece.color === chess.turn()) {
      setSelectedSquare(sq);
      const moves = chess.moves({ square: sq, verbose: true });
      const filtered = duckSquare ? moves.filter(m => m.to !== duckSquare) : moves;
      setLegalMoves(filtered);
    } else {
      setSelectedSquare(null);
      setLegalMoves([]);
    }
  };

  // Escape clears annotations/selection; Keyboard Control handles Arrows/WASD + Space/Enter
  useEffect(() => {
    const onKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        setHighlightedSquares({});
        setUserArrows([]);
        setSelectedSquare(null);
        setLegalMoves([]);
        setSelectedCustomPos(null);
        setPremoveSelectedSq(null);
        setPremoveTargets([]);
        setPendingPromotion(null);
        onCancelPremoves?.();
        return;
      }

      if (!keyboardControlEnabled || pendingPromotion) return;
      if (e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey || e.altKey) return;

      const target = e.target as HTMLElement | null;
      if (
        target &&
        (target.tagName === 'INPUT' ||
          target.tagName === 'TEXTAREA' ||
          target.tagName === 'SELECT' ||
          target.isContentEditable)
      ) {
        return;
      }

      const keyLower = e.key.toLowerCase();
      let dRow = 0;
      let dCol = 0;

      if (e.key === 'ArrowUp' || keyLower === 'w') dRow = isFlipped ? 1 : -1;
      else if (e.key === 'ArrowDown' || keyLower === 's') dRow = isFlipped ? -1 : 1;
      else if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || keyLower === 'a') dCol = isFlipped ? 1 : -1;
      else if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' || keyLower === 'd') dCol = isFlipped ? -1 : 1;

      if (dRow !== 0 || dCol !== 0) {
        e.preventDefault();
        setKeyboardCursor(prev => {
          const base = prev || {
            row: isFlipped ? Math.min(gridHeight - 1, 1) : Math.max(0, gridHeight - 2),
            col: Math.min(gridWidth - 1, 4)
          };
          return {
            row: Math.max(0, Math.min(gridHeight - 1, base.row + dRow)),
            col: Math.max(0, Math.min(gridWidth - 1, base.col + dCol))
          };
        });
        return;
      }

      if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
        e.preventDefault();
        const activeCursor = keyboardCursor || {
          row: isFlipped ? Math.min(gridHeight - 1, 1) : Math.max(0, gridHeight - 2),
          col: Math.min(gridWidth - 1, 4)
        };
        if (!keyboardCursor) setKeyboardCursor(activeCursor);
        activateGridPosition(activeCursor.row, activeCursor.col);
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown);
  });

  const handleRightPointerDown = (squareId: string) => {
    if (premoves.length > 0 && onCancelPremoves) {
      rightDragOriginRef.current = null;
      setPremoveSelectedSq(null);
      setPremoveTargets([]);
      onCancelPremoves();
      return;
    }
    if (premoveSelectedSq || selectedSquare || selectedCustomPos) {
      rightDragOriginRef.current = null;
      setPremoveSelectedSq(null);
      setPremoveTargets([]);
      setSelectedSquare(null);
      setLegalMoves([]);
      setSelectedCustomPos(null);
      return;
    }
    rightDragOriginRef.current = squareId;
  };

  const handleRightPointerUp = (squareId: string, e: React.PointerEvent) => {
    const origin = rightDragOriginRef.current;
    rightDragOriginRef.current = null;
    if (!origin) return;

    if (origin === squareId) {
      if (premoves.length > 0 && onCancelPremoves) {
        onCancelPremoves();
        return;
      }
      const color = e.shiftKey ? '#10b981' : e.altKey ? '#38bdf8' : '#f59e0b';
      setHighlightedSquares(prev => {
        const next = { ...prev };
        if (next[squareId] === color) delete next[squareId];
        else next[squareId] = color;
        return next;
      });
    } else {
      const color = e.shiftKey ? '#10b981' : '#f59e0b';
      setUserArrows(prev => {
        const existsIdx = prev.findIndex(a => a.from === origin && a.to === squareId);
        if (existsIdx >= 0) return prev.filter((_, idx) => idx !== existsIdx);
        return [...prev, { from: origin, to: squareId, color }];
      });
    }
  };

  // Rendered into <body> so `position: fixed` is relative to the viewport. Inside the board,
  // ancestors with transforms/filters became the containing block and offset the piece from the cursor.
  // Called as a function (not <Component/>) so it isn't remounted on every board render.
  const renderFloatingDragPiece = () => {
    if (!dragState || !dragState.isDragging || blindfold || typeof document === 'undefined') return null;
    const { x, y } = dragPointRef.current;
    return createPortal(
      <div
        ref={floatingPieceRef}
        className="fixed left-0 top-0 z-50 pointer-events-none"
        style={{ transform: `translate3d(${x}px, ${y}px, 0)`, willChange: 'transform' }}
      >
        <div
          className={reduceMotion ? '' : 'animate-piece-drag'}
          style={{
            width: dragState.cellSize * 0.94,
            height: dragState.cellSize * 0.94,
            transform: reduceMotion ? 'translate(-50%, -56%) scale(1.12)' : undefined,
            filter: 'drop-shadow(0 12px 18px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45))'
          }}
        >
          <ChessPieceIcon
            type={dragState.pieceType}
            color={dragState.pieceColor}
            set={activePieceSet}
            kingFinial={activeFinial}
          />
        </div>
      </div>,
      document.body
    );
  };

  // ========================
  // 1. CUSTOM W x H GRID MODE
  // ========================
  if (customGrid) {
    const height = customGrid.length;
    const width = customGrid[0]?.length || 8;
    const rowIndices = isFlipped
      ? Array.from({ length: height }, (_, i) => height - 1 - i)
      : Array.from({ length: height }, (_, i) => i);
    const colIndices = isFlipped
      ? Array.from({ length: width }, (_, i) => width - 1 - i)
      : Array.from({ length: width }, (_, i) => i);

    const activeCustomTargets = selectedCustomPos
      ? customLegalMoves.filter(
          m => m.fromRow === selectedCustomPos.row && m.fromCol === selectedCustomPos.col
        )
      : [];

    const handleCustomSquareClick = (r: number, c: number) => {
      if (suppressNextClickRef.current) {
        suppressNextClickRef.current = false;
        return;
      }
      if (Object.keys(highlightedSquares).length > 0 || userArrows.length > 0) {
        setHighlightedSquares({});
        setUserArrows([]);
      }
      if (disabled) return;
      if (isPlacingDuck) {
        if (!customGrid[r][c] && !(customDuckPos?.row === r && customDuckPos?.col === c)) {
          onCustomPlaceDuck?.({ row: r, col: c });
        }
        return;
      }

      if (inputMethod === 'drag') return;

      const sqKey = `${r},${c}`;
      if (justSelectedOnPointerDownRef.current === sqKey) {
        justSelectedOnPointerDownRef.current = null;
        return;
      }

      if (selectedCustomPos) {
        if (selectedCustomPos.row === r && selectedCustomPos.col === c) {
          setSelectedCustomPos(null);
          return;
        }
        const match = activeCustomTargets.find(m => m.toRow === r && m.toCol === c);
        if (match) {
          onCustomMove?.(match);
          setSelectedCustomPos(null);
          return;
        }
      }

      const piece = customGrid[r][c];
      if (piece && piece.color === customTurn && piece.type !== 'd') {
        setSelectedCustomPos({ row: r, col: c });
      } else {
        setSelectedCustomPos(null);
      }
    };

    const handleCustomPointerDown = (r: number, c: number, e: React.PointerEvent) => {
      suppressNextClickRef.current = false;
      justSelectedOnPointerDownRef.current = null;
      const sqLabel = coordsToSquare(r, c, height);
      if (e.button === 2) {
        handleRightPointerDown(sqLabel);
        return;
      }
      if (e.button !== 0 || disabled || isPlacingDuck || inputMethod === 'click') return;
      const piece = customGrid[r][c];
      if (!piece || piece.color !== customTurn || piece.type === 'd') return;
      const rect = boardGridRef.current?.getBoundingClientRect();
      const cellSize = rect ? rect.width / width : 56;

      if (!(selectedCustomPos?.row === r && selectedCustomPos?.col === c)) {
        justSelectedOnPointerDownRef.current = `${r},${c}`;
      }
      setSelectedCustomPos({ row: r, col: c });
      setDragState({
        pieceType: piece.type,
        pieceColor: piece.color,
        fromCustomPos: { row: r, col: c },
        startX: e.clientX,
        startY: e.clientY,
        clientX: e.clientX,
        clientY: e.clientY,
        isDragging: false,
        cellSize
      });
    };

    return (
      <div className="flex flex-col items-center w-full" style={{ maxWidth: boardMaxWidth }}>
        {renderFloatingDragPiece()}
        {isPlacingDuck && (
          <div
            className="mb-2 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-2 shadow-md"
            style={{
              backgroundColor: appTheme.accentHex,
              color: appTheme.accentTextHex
            }}
          >
            <span className="w-4 h-4">
              <ChessPieceIcon type="d" color="w" set={activePieceSet} />
            </span>
            <span>Place the Rubber Duck on any empty square</span>
          </div>
        )}

        <BoardFrame frame={boardTheme.frame} still={reduceMotion}>
        <div
          onContextMenu={e => e.preventDefault()}
          className={`relative w-full overflow-hidden select-none touch-none ${isFramed ? 'rounded-[3px]' : 'rounded-xl shadow-2xl'}`}
          style={{
            border: isFramed ? 'none' : `2px solid ${appTheme.cardBorderHex}`,
            backgroundColor: boardTheme.darkHex,
            aspectRatio: `${width} / ${height}`,
            padding: activeCoordMode === 'outside' ? '18px' : '0px'
          }}
        >
          <div
            ref={boardGridRef}
            className="grid w-full h-full rounded-lg overflow-hidden"
            role="grid"
            aria-label="Chess Board"
            style={{
              gridTemplateColumns: `repeat(${width}, minmax(0, 1fr))`,
              gridTemplateRows: `repeat(${height}, minmax(0, 1fr))`
            }}
          >
            {rowIndices.map((rIdx, visRowIdx) =>
              colIndices.map((cIdx, visColIdx) => {
                const sqLabel = coordsToSquare(rIdx, cIdx, height);
                const isDark = (rIdx + cIdx) % 2 === 1;
                const piece = customGrid[rIdx][cIdx];

                const isSelected = selectedCustomPos?.row === rIdx && selectedCustomPos?.col === cIdx;
                const isKeyCursor =
                  keyboardControlEnabled && keyboardCursor?.row === rIdx && keyboardCursor?.col === cIdx;
                const isLastMoveSquare =
                  customLastMove &&
                  ((customLastMove.fromRow === rIdx && customLastMove.fromCol === cIdx) ||
                    (customLastMove.toRow === rIdx && customLastMove.toCol === cIdx));
                const isSettling =
                  !reduceMotion &&
                  customLastMove?.toRow === rIdx &&
                  customLastMove?.toCol === cIdx;
                const isBeingDraggedOrigin =
                  dragState?.isDragging &&
                  dragState.fromCustomPos?.row === rIdx &&
                  dragState.fromCustomPos?.col === cIdx;
                const isHoverDropTarget = hoverTargetKey === `${rIdx},${cIdx}`;

                const isTargetLegal =
                  highlightLegal && activeCustomTargets.some(m => m.toRow === rIdx && m.toCol === cIdx);
                const isKingInCheck = customCheckSquare?.row === rIdx && customCheckSquare?.col === cIdx;
                const hasDuck = (customDuckPos?.row === rIdx && customDuckPos?.col === cIdx) || piece?.type === 'd';

                const showRankLabel = activeCoordMode === 'inside' && visColIdx === 0;
                const showFileLabel = activeCoordMode === 'inside' && visRowIdx === height - 1;

                let squareBg = isDark ? boardTheme.darkHex : boardTheme.lightHex;
                if (isSelected) {
                  squareBg = boardTheme.selectedHex;
                } else if (isLastMoveSquare) {
                  squareBg = boardTheme.lastMoveHex;
                }

                const pieceDesc = piece
                  ? `${piece.color === 'w' ? 'White' : 'Black'} ${piece.type.toUpperCase()}`
                  : 'empty';

                return (
                  <button
                    key={`${rIdx}-${cIdx}`}
                    type="button"
                    data-square={sqLabel}
                    onPointerDown={e => handleCustomPointerDown(rIdx, cIdx, e)}
                    onPointerUp={e => {
                      if (e.button === 2) handleRightPointerUp(sqLabel, e);
                    }}
                    onClick={() => {
                      if (keyboardControlEnabled) setKeyboardCursor({ row: rIdx, col: cIdx });
                      handleCustomSquareClick(rIdx, cIdx);
                    }}
                    aria-label={`Square ${sqLabel}, ${pieceDesc}${isTargetLegal ? ', legal move target' : ''}`}
                    style={{
                      backgroundColor: squareBg,
                      backgroundImage: squareTextureFor(isDark, Boolean(isSelected || isLastMoveSquare))
                    }}
                    className={`relative flex items-center justify-center p-1 sm:p-1.5 transition-colors duration-100 focus:outline-none focus:z-20 ${
                      isSelected ? 'ring-2 ring-inset ring-emerald-300 z-10' : ''
                    } ${isKeyCursor ? 'ring-2 ring-inset ring-sky-400 z-20' : ''} ${
                      isHoverDropTarget ? 'ring-2 ring-inset ring-white/80 z-10' : ''
                    } ${isKingInCheck ? 'ring-3 ring-inset ring-rose-500' : ''}`}
                  >
                    {highlightedSquares[sqLabel] && (
                      <div
                        className="absolute inset-0 pointer-events-none z-0 opacity-45"
                        style={{ backgroundColor: highlightedSquares[sqLabel] }}
                      />
                    )}
                    {showRankLabel && (
                      <span
                        style={{ color: isDark ? boardTheme.coordDark : boardTheme.coordLight }}
                        className="absolute top-0.5 left-1 text-[9px] sm:text-[10px] font-bold select-none pointer-events-none opacity-85 font-mono"
                      >
                        {height - rIdx}
                      </span>
                    )}
                    {showFileLabel && (
                      <span
                        style={{ color: isDark ? boardTheme.coordDark : boardTheme.coordLight }}
                        className="absolute bottom-0.5 right-1 text-[9px] sm:text-[10px] font-bold select-none pointer-events-none opacity-85 font-mono"
                      >
                        {String.fromCharCode(97 + cIdx)}
                      </span>
                    )}

                    {isTargetLegal && !piece && !hasDuck && (
                      <div className="w-3 h-3 sm:w-3.5 sm:h-3.5 rounded-full bg-black/25 ring-1 ring-white/30 z-10 pointer-events-none" />
                    )}
                    {isTargetLegal && piece && !hasDuck && (
                      <div className="absolute inset-1 rounded-full border-[3px] border-black/30 z-10 pointer-events-none" />
                    )}

                    {hasDuck && (
                      <div className="w-full h-full flex items-center justify-center z-20 pointer-events-none">
                        <ChessPieceIcon type="d" color="w" set={activePieceSet} />
                      </div>
                    )}

                    {piece && !hasDuck && (
                      <div
                        key={isSettling ? `settle-${moveNonce}` : 'idle'}
                        className={`w-full h-full flex items-center justify-center z-10 transition-opacity duration-100 ${
                          isBeingDraggedOrigin ? 'opacity-20' : ''
                        } ${isSettling ? 'animate-piece-settle' : ''}`}
                      >
                        {blindfold ? (
                          <div className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-current opacity-30" />
                        ) : (
                          <ChessPieceIcon
                            type={piece.type}
                            color={piece.color}
                            set={activePieceSet}
                            kingFinial={activeFinial}
                          />
                        )}
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </button>
                );
              })
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
        </BoardFrame>
        {keyboardControlEnabled && keyboardCursor && (
          <div className="mt-1.5 flex items-center justify-center gap-2 text-[11px] font-mono" style={{ color: appTheme.textMutedHex }}>
            <span>Key Cursor:</span>
            <span className="font-bold" style={{ color: appTheme.accentHex }}>
              {coordsToSquare(keyboardCursor.row, keyboardCursor.col, height)}
            </span>
            <span>· Arrows / WASD · Space / Enter</span>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    );
  }

  // ========================
  // 2. STANDARD 8x8 MODE
  // ========================
  if (!chess) return null;

  const board = chess.board();

  let kingInCheckSquare: Square | null = null;
  if (chess.inCheck()) {
    const turn = chess.turn();
    for (let r = 0; r < 8; r++) {
      for (let c = 0; c < 8; c++) {
        const piece = board[r][c];
        if (piece && piece.type === 'k' && piece.color === turn) {
          kingInCheckSquare = (String.fromCharCode(97 + c) + (8 - r)) as Square;
          break;
        }
      }
      if (kingInCheckSquare) break;
    }
  }

  const handleSquareClick = (square: Square) => {
    if (suppressNextClickRef.current) {
      suppressNextClickRef.current = false;
      return;
    }
    if (Object.keys(highlightedSquares).length > 0 || userArrows.length > 0) {
      setHighlightedSquares({});
      setUserArrows([]);
    }

    if (isPlacingDuck) {
      if (!chess.get(square) && square !== duckSquare) {
        onPlaceDuck?.(square);
      }
      return;
    }

    if (inputMethod === 'drag') return;

    if (justSelectedOnPointerDownRef.current === square) {
      justSelectedOnPointerDownRef.current = null;
      return;
    }
    justSelectedOnPointerDownRef.current = null;

    // Premove click flow while awaiting AI move (or editing queued chain)
    if (canPremoveNow && playerColor) {
      if (premoveSelectedSq) {
        if (premoveSelectedSq === square) {
          setPremoveSelectedSq(null);
          setPremoveTargets([]);
          return;
        }
        if (premoveTargets.includes(square)) {
          commitStandardMoveOrPromo(premoveSelectedSq, square, true);
          setPremoveSelectedSq(null);
          setPremoveTargets([]);
          return;
        }
      }

      const vPiece = virtualBoard[square];
      if (vPiece && vPiece.color === playerColor) {
        setPremoveSelectedSq(square);
        setPremoveTargets(getPseudoPremoveTargets(virtualBoard, square, playerColor));
      } else {
        const hadSelected = Boolean(premoveSelectedSq);
        setPremoveSelectedSq(null);
        setPremoveTargets([]);
        if (!hadSelected && premoves.length > 0) {
          onCancelPremoves?.();
        }
      }
      return;
    }

    if (disabled) return;

    if (selectedSquare) {
      if (selectedSquare === square) {
        setSelectedSquare(null);
        setLegalMoves([]);
        return;
      }

      const matchMove = legalMoves.find(m => m.to === square);
      if (matchMove) {
        commitStandardMoveOrPromo(selectedSquare, square, false);
        setSelectedSquare(null);
        setLegalMoves([]);
        return;
      }
    }

    const piece = chess.get(square);
    if (piece && piece.color === chess.turn()) {
      setSelectedSquare(square);
      const moves = chess.moves({ square, verbose: true });
      const filtered = duckSquare ? moves.filter(m => m.to !== duckSquare) : moves;
      setLegalMoves(filtered);
    } else {
      setSelectedSquare(null);
      setLegalMoves([]);
    }
  };

  const handleStandardPointerDown = (square: Square, e: React.PointerEvent) => {
    suppressNextClickRef.current = false;
    justSelectedOnPointerDownRef.current = null;

    if (e.button === 2) {
      handleRightPointerDown(square);
      return;
    }
    if (e.button !== 0 || isPlacingDuck || inputMethod === 'click') return;

    const rect = boardGridRef.current?.getBoundingClientRect();
    const cellSize = rect ? rect.width / 8 : 58;

    // Premove drag when waiting for AI reply
    if (canPremoveNow && playerColor) {
      const vPiece = virtualBoard[square];
      if (!vPiece || vPiece.color !== playerColor) return;
      if (premoveSelectedSq !== square) {
        justSelectedOnPointerDownRef.current = square;
      }
      setPremoveSelectedSq(square);
      setPremoveTargets(getPseudoPremoveTargets(virtualBoard, square, playerColor));
      setDragState({
        pieceType: vPiece.type,
        pieceColor: vPiece.color,
        fromSquare: square,
        startX: e.clientX,
        startY: e.clientY,
        clientX: e.clientX,
        clientY: e.clientY,
        isDragging: false,
        cellSize,
        isPremoveDrag: true
      });
      return;
    }

    if (disabled) return;
    const piece = chess.get(square);
    if (!piece || piece.color !== chess.turn()) return;

    const moves = chess.moves({ square, verbose: true });
    const filtered = duckSquare ? moves.filter(m => m.to !== duckSquare) : moves;
    if (selectedSquare !== square) {
      justSelectedOnPointerDownRef.current = square;
    }
    setSelectedSquare(square);
    setLegalMoves(filtered);

    setDragState({
      pieceType: piece.type as PieceType,
      pieceColor: piece.color as PieceColor,
      fromSquare: square,
      startX: e.clientX,
      startY: e.clientY,
      clientX: e.clientX,
      clientY: e.clientY,
      isDragging: false,
      cellSize,
      isPremoveDrag: false
    });
  };

  const ranks = isFlipped ? [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8] : [8, 7, 6, 5, 4, 3, 2, 1];
  const files = isFlipped ? ['h', 'g', 'f', 'e', 'd', 'c', 'b', 'a'] : ['a', 'b', 'c', 'd', 'e', 'f', 'g', 'h'];

  const getSquareGridCoords = (sq: string) => {
    const file = sq[0];
    const rank = parseInt(sq[1], 10);
    const colIdx = files.indexOf(file);
    const rowIdx = ranks.indexOf(rank);
    return { x: colIdx * 12.5 + 6.25, y: rowIdx * 12.5 + 6.25 };
  };

  const showVirtualPieces = canPremoveNow && premoves.length > 0;

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col items-center w-full" style={{ maxWidth: boardMaxWidth }}>
      {renderFloatingDragPiece()}

      {isPlacingDuck && (
        <div
          className="mb-2 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-2 shadow-md"
          style={{
            backgroundColor: appTheme.accentHex,
            color: appTheme.accentTextHex
          }}
        >
          <span className="w-4 h-4">
            <ChessPieceIcon type="d" color="w" set={activePieceSet} />
          </span>
          <span>Place the Rubber Duck on any empty square</span>
        </div>
      )}

      <BoardFrame frame={boardTheme.frame} still={reduceMotion}>
      <div
        onContextMenu={e => e.preventDefault()}
        className={`relative select-none aspect-square w-full overflow-hidden transition-colors duration-200 touch-none ${isFramed ? 'rounded-[3px]' : 'rounded-xl shadow-2xl'}`}
        style={{
          border: isFramed ? 'none' : `2px solid ${appTheme.cardBorderHex}`,
          backgroundColor: boardTheme.darkHex,
          padding: activeCoordMode === 'outside' ? '18px' : '0px'
        }}
      >
        <div
          ref={boardGridRef}
          className="grid grid-cols-8 grid-rows-8 w-full h-full rounded-lg overflow-hidden"
          role="grid"
          aria-label="Chess Board"
        >
          {ranks.map((rank, rIdx) =>
            files.map((file, fIdx) => {
              const square = `${file}${rank}` as Square;
              const isDark = (rIdx + fIdx) % 2 === 1;
              const realPiece = chess.get(square);
              const displayedPiece = showVirtualPieces ? virtualBoard[square] : realPiece;
              const isGhostVirtualPiece =
                showVirtualPieces &&
                displayedPiece &&
                (!realPiece || realPiece.type !== displayedPiece.type || realPiece.color !== displayedPiece.color);

              const premoveStepsForTo = premoves
                .map((p, idx) => (p.to === square ? idx + 1 : -1))
                .filter(n => n > 0);
              const isPremoveFrom = premoves.some(p => p.from === square);
              const isPremoveTo = premoveStepsForTo.length > 0;

              const isSelected = selectedSquare === square || premoveSelectedSq === square;
              const stdRow = 8 - rank;
              const stdCol = FILES.indexOf(file as (typeof FILES)[number]);
              const isKeyCursor =
                keyboardControlEnabled && keyboardCursor?.row === stdRow && keyboardCursor?.col === stdCol;
              const isLastMoveSquare = lastMove && (lastMove.from === square || lastMove.to === square);
              const isSettling = !reduceMotion && lastMove?.to === square;
              const isBeingDraggedOrigin = dragState?.isDragging && dragState.fromSquare === square;
              const isHoverDropTarget = hoverTargetKey === square;

              const isTargetLegal =
                highlightLegal &&
                (canPremoveNow
                  ? premoveTargets.includes(square)
                  : legalMoves.some(m => m.to === square));
              const isKingInCheck = kingInCheckSquare === square;
              const isThreatened = !isKingInCheck && threatenedSquares.includes(square);
              const hasDuck = duckSquare === square;

              const showRankLabel = activeCoordMode === 'inside' && fIdx === 0;
              const showFileLabel = activeCoordMode === 'inside' && rIdx === 7;

              const pieceDescription = displayedPiece
                ? `${displayedPiece.color === 'w' ? 'White' : 'Black'} ${displayedPiece.type.toUpperCase()}`
                : 'empty';

              let squareBg = isDark ? boardTheme.darkHex : boardTheme.lightHex;
              if (isSelected) {
                squareBg = boardTheme.selectedHex;
              } else if (isPremoveTo || isPremoveFrom) {
                squareBg = isDark ? '#7f1d1d' : '#991b1b';
              } else if (isLastMoveSquare) {
                squareBg = boardTheme.lastMoveHex;
              }

              return (
                <button
                  key={square}
                  type="button"
                  data-square={square}
                  onPointerDown={e => handleStandardPointerDown(square, e)}
                  onPointerUp={e => {
                    if (e.button === 2) handleRightPointerUp(square, e);
                  }}
                  onClick={() => {
                    if (keyboardControlEnabled) setKeyboardCursor({ row: stdRow, col: stdCol });
                    handleSquareClick(square);
                  }}
                  aria-label={`Square ${square}, ${pieceDescription}${isTargetLegal ? ', legal move target' : ''}${
                    isPremoveTo ? `, premove ${premoveStepsForTo.join(',')}` : ''
                  }${isThreatened ? ', threatened piece' : ''}`}
                  style={{
                    backgroundColor: squareBg,
                    backgroundImage: squareTextureFor(isDark, Boolean(isSelected || isPremoveTo || isPremoveFrom || isLastMoveSquare))
                  }}
                  className={`relative flex items-center justify-center p-1 sm:p-1.5 transition-colors duration-100 focus:outline-none focus:z-20 ${
                    isSelected ? 'ring-2 ring-inset ring-emerald-300 z-10' : ''
                  } ${isKeyCursor ? 'ring-2 ring-inset ring-sky-400 z-20' : ''} ${
                    isHoverDropTarget ? 'ring-2 ring-inset ring-white/80 z-10' : ''
                  } ${isThreatened ? 'ring-2 ring-inset ring-amber-400/90' : ''} ${
                    isKingInCheck ? 'ring-3 ring-inset ring-rose-500' : ''
                  }`}
                >
                  {highlightedSquares[square] && (
                    <div
                      className="absolute inset-0 pointer-events-none z-0 opacity-45"
                      style={{ backgroundColor: highlightedSquares[square] }}
                    />
                  )}

                  {showRankLabel && (
                    <span
                      style={{ color: isDark ? boardTheme.coordDark : boardTheme.coordLight }}
                      className="absolute top-0.5 left-1 text-[9px] sm:text-[10px] font-bold select-none pointer-events-none opacity-85 font-mono"
                    >
                      {rank}
                    </span>
                  )}
                  {showFileLabel && (
                    <span
                      style={{ color: isDark ? boardTheme.coordDark : boardTheme.coordLight }}
                      className="absolute bottom-0.5 right-1 text-[9px] sm:text-[10px] font-bold select-none pointer-events-none opacity-85 font-mono"
                    >
                      {file}
                    </span>
                  )}

                  {moveClassification && moveClassification.square === square && !isPremoveTo && (
                    <MoveClassificationBadge type={moveClassification.type} variant="board" />
                  )}

                  {isThreatened &&
                    !isPremoveTo &&
                    !(moveClassification && moveClassification.square === square) && (
                    <span
                      className="absolute top-0.5 right-0.5 z-30 w-[14px] h-[14px] rounded-full bg-amber-500 text-slate-950 text-[9px] font-mono font-extrabold flex items-center justify-center shadow pointer-events-none"
                      title="Piece is hanging or under attack"
                    >
                      !
                    </span>
                  )}

                  {isPremoveTo && (
                    <span
                      data-testid={`premove-badge-${square}`}
                      className="absolute top-0.5 right-0.5 z-30 min-w-[14px] h-[14px] px-0.5 rounded-full bg-rose-500 text-white text-[9px] font-mono font-bold flex items-center justify-center shadow pointer-events-none"
                    >
                      {premoveStepsForTo.join(',')}
                    </span>
                  )}

                  {isTargetLegal && !displayedPiece && (
                    <div
                      className={`w-3 h-3 sm:w-3.5 sm:h-3.5 rounded-full z-10 pointer-events-none ${
                        canPremoveNow
                          ? 'bg-rose-400/50 ring-1 ring-rose-200/50'
                          : 'bg-black/25 ring-1 ring-white/30'
                      }`}
                    />
                  )}
                  {isTargetLegal && displayedPiece && (
                    <div
                      className={`absolute inset-1 rounded-full border-[3px] z-10 pointer-events-none ${
                        canPremoveNow ? 'border-rose-400/70' : 'border-black/30'
                      }`}
                    />
                  )}

                  {hasDuck && (
                    <div
                      className="w-full h-full flex items-center justify-center z-20 pointer-events-none"
                      title="Rubber Duck (Obstruction)"
                    >
                      <ChessPieceIcon type="d" color="w" set={activePieceSet} />
                    </div>
                  )}

                  {displayedPiece && !hasDuck && (
                    <div
                      key={isSettling ? `settle-${moveNonce}` : 'idle'}
                      className={`w-full h-full flex items-center justify-center z-10 transition-opacity duration-100 ${
                        isBeingDraggedOrigin ? 'opacity-20' : isGhostVirtualPiece ? 'opacity-80' : ''
                      } ${isSettling ? 'animate-piece-settle' : ''}`}
                    >
                      {blindfold ? (
                        <div className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-current opacity-30" />
                      ) : (
                        <ChessPieceIcon
                          type={displayedPiece.type as PieceType}
                          color={displayedPiece.color as PieceColor}
                          set={activePieceSet}
                          kingFinial={activeFinial}
                        />
                      )}
                    </div>
                  )}
                </button>
              );
            })
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Interactive 4-Piece Promotion Picker Modal when Auto-Queen is OFF */}
        {pendingPromotion && (
          <div
            className="absolute inset-0 z-40 bg-black/55 backdrop-blur-[1px] flex items-center justify-center p-4"
            onClick={() => setPendingPromotion(null)}
          >
            <div
              className="rounded-xl p-3 border shadow-2xl flex flex-col items-center gap-2"
              style={{
                backgroundColor: appTheme.cardHex,
                borderColor: appTheme.cardBorderHex,
                color: appTheme.textPrimary
              }}
              onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()}
            >
              <span className="text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider" style={{ color: appTheme.textSecondary }}>
                Promote Pawn ({pendingPromotion.to.toUpperCase()})
              </span>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                {(['q', 'r', 'b', 'n'] as const).map(promoType => (
                  <button
                    key={promoType}
                    type="button"
                    aria-label={`Promote to ${promoType === 'q' ? 'Queen' : promoType === 'r' ? 'Rook' : promoType === 'b' ? 'Bishop' : 'Knight'}`}
                    onClick={() => {
                      const req = pendingPromotion;
                      setPendingPromotion(null);
                      if (req.isPremove) {
                        onQueuePremove?.({ from: req.from, to: req.to, promotion: promoType });
                      } else {
                        onMakeMove?.({ from: req.from, to: req.to, promotion: promoType });
                      }
                    }}
                    className="w-12 h-12 rounded-lg border p-1.5 transition hover:scale-105"
                    style={{
                      backgroundColor: appTheme.cardSecondaryHex,
                      borderColor: appTheme.cardBorderHex
                    }}
                  >
                    <ChessPieceIcon
                      type={promoType}
                      color={pendingPromotion.color}
                      set={activePieceSet}
                      kingFinial={activeFinial}
                    />
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Outside Coordinates Overlay Labels */}
        {activeCoordMode === 'outside' && (
          <>
            <div className="absolute left-0.5 top-[18px] bottom-[18px] flex flex-col justify-around pointer-events-none">
              {ranks.map(r => (
                <span key={r} className="text-[9px] font-mono font-bold leading-none opacity-85" style={{ color: boardTheme.lightHex }}>
                  {r}
                </span>
              ))}
            </div>
            <div className="absolute bottom-0.5 left-[18px] right-[18px] flex justify-around pointer-events-none">
              {files.map(f => (
                <span key={f} className="text-[9px] font-mono font-bold leading-none opacity-85" style={{ color: boardTheme.lightHex }}>
                  {f}
                </span>
              ))}
            </div>
          </>
        )}

        {/* Unified SVG Overlay for Hint Arrow, Premove Chain Arrows & Right-Click Tactical Arrows */}
        {(bestMoveArrow || premoves.length > 0 || userArrows.length > 0) && (
          <svg
            className="absolute inset-0 w-full h-full pointer-events-none z-20"
            viewBox="0 0 100 100"
            preserveAspectRatio="none"
          >
            <defs>
              <marker
                id={`arrowhead-${arrowMarkerId}`}
                markerWidth="4"
                markerHeight="4"
                refX="2.5"
                refY="2"
                orient="auto"
              >
                <polygon points="0 0, 4 2, 0 4" fill={appTheme.accentHex} />
              </marker>
              <marker
                id={`arrowhead-premove-${arrowMarkerId}`}
                markerWidth="4"
                markerHeight="4"
                refX="2.5"
                refY="2"
                orient="auto"
              >
                <polygon points="0 0, 4 2, 0 4" fill="#fb7185" />
              </marker>
              <marker
                id={`arrowhead-amber-${arrowMarkerId}`}
                markerWidth="4"
                markerHeight="4"
                refX="2.5"
                refY="2"
                orient="auto"
              >
                <polygon points="0 0, 4 2, 0 4" fill="#f59e0b" />
              </marker>
              <marker
                id={`arrowhead-emerald-${arrowMarkerId}`}
                markerWidth="4"
                markerHeight="4"
                refX="2.5"
                refY="2"
                orient="auto"
              >
                <polygon points="0 0, 4 2, 0 4" fill="#10b981" />
              </marker>
            </defs>

            {/* User Right-Click Drawn Arrows */}
            {userArrows.map((arrow, idx) => {
              const start = getSquareGridCoords(arrow.from);
              const end = getSquareGridCoords(arrow.to);
              const isGreen = arrow.color === '#10b981';
              return (
                <line
                  key={`user-${idx}`}
                  x1={start.x}
                  y1={start.y}
                  x2={end.x}
                  y2={end.y}
                  stroke={arrow.color}
                  strokeWidth="2.1"
                  strokeLinecap="round"
                  opacity="0.82"
                  markerEnd={`url(#${isGreen ? `arrowhead-emerald-${arrowMarkerId}` : `arrowhead-amber-${arrowMarkerId}`})`}
                />
              );
            })}

            {/* Queued Premoves Dashed Chain */}
            {premoves.map((pm, idx) => {
              const start = getSquareGridCoords(pm.from);
              const end = getSquareGridCoords(pm.to);
              return (
                <line
                  key={`pm-${idx}`}
                  x1={start.x}
                  y1={start.y}
                  x2={end.x}
                  y2={end.y}
                  stroke="#fb7185"
                  strokeWidth="1.9"
                  strokeDasharray="2.8 1.8"
                  strokeLinecap="round"
                  opacity="0.9"
                  markerEnd={`url(#arrowhead-premove-${arrowMarkerId})`}
                />
              );
            })}

            {/* Engine Hint Arrow */}
            {bestMoveArrow && (() => {
              const start = getSquareGridCoords(bestMoveArrow.from);
              const end = getSquareGridCoords(bestMoveArrow.to);
              return (
                <line
                  x1={start.x}
                  y1={start.y}
                  x2={end.x}
                  y2={end.y}
                  stroke={appTheme.accentHex}
                  strokeWidth="2.3"
                  strokeLinecap="round"
                  opacity="0.88"
                  markerEnd={`url(#arrowhead-${arrowMarkerId})`}
                />
              );
            })()}
          </svg>
        )}
      </div>
      </BoardFrame>
      {keyboardControlEnabled && keyboardCursor && (
        <div className="mt-1.5 flex items-center justify-center gap-2 text-[11px] font-mono" style={{ color: appTheme.textMutedHex }}>
          <span>Key Cursor:</span>
          <span className="font-bold" style={{ color: appTheme.accentHex }}>
            {`${FILES[keyboardCursor.col]}${8 - keyboardCursor.row}`}
          </span>
          <span>· Arrows / WASD · Space / Enter</span>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};
</file>

export const ChessPieceIcon: React.FC<{
  type: PieceType;
  color: PieceColor;
  set?: PieceSetId;
  kingFinial?: KingFinialStyle;
  className?: string;
}> = ({ type, color, set = 'neo', kingFinial, className = 'w-full h-full' }) => {
  const { kingFinial: contextKingFinial } = useAppTheme();
  const activeKingFinial: KingFinialStyle = kingFinial || contextKingFinial || 'crescent';
  const isWhite = color === 'w';
  const rawId = useId();
  const safeId = rawId.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g, '_');
  const filterId = `shadow_${safeId}`;
  const gradId = `grad_${safeId}`;
  const microTexId = `tex_${safeId}`;
  const glossId = `gloss_${safeId}`;
  const compositeFillId = `cfill_${safeId}`;

  const cfg = PIECE_STYLE_CONFIGS[set] || PIECE_STYLE_CONFIGS.neo;
  const gradStops = isWhite ? cfg.whiteFillGrad : cfg.blackFillGrad;
  const stroke = isWhite ? cfg.whiteStroke : cfg.blackStroke;
  const inner = isWhite ? cfg.whiteInner : cfg.blackInner;
  const sheen = isWhite ? cfg.whiteHighlight : cfg.blackHighlight;
  const sw = cfg.strokeWidth ?? 1.45;
  const isAngular = cfg.isPixel || set === 'cyber' || set === 'emerald_gem' || set === 'metal' || set === 'modern';
  const join: 'round' | 'miter' | 'bevel' = isAngular ? 'miter' : 'round';
  const cap: 'round' | 'square' | 'butt' = cfg.isPixel ? 'square' : 'round';

  const fillRef = `url(#${compositeFillId})`;
  const shapeProps: PieceRenderProps = {
    set,
    fillRef,
    stroke,
    inner,
    sheen,
    sw,
    join,
    cap,
    isWhite,
    kingFinial: activeKingFinial
  };

  const renderMicroTexture = () => {
    switch (set) {
      case 'minimal':
        return (
          <pattern id={microTexId} patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse" width="5" height="5">
            <path d="M0 5L5 0M-1 1L1 -1M4 6L6 4" stroke={inner} strokeWidth="0.55" opacity="0.22" />
            <circle cx="2.5" cy="2.5" r="0.35" fill={inner} opacity="0.16" />
          </pattern>
        );
      case 'glass':
        return (
          <pattern id={microTexId} patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse" width="9" height="9">
            <polygon points="0,0 9,0 4.5,4.5" fill={sheen} opacity="0.22" />
            <polygon points="0,9 4.5,4.5 9,9" fill={inner} opacity="0.12" />
            <path d="M0 9L9 0" stroke={sheen} strokeWidth="0.65" opacity="0.32" />
          </pattern>
        );
      case 'wood':
        return (

    id: 'starting',
    label: 'Starting Position',
    fen: 'rnbqkbnr/pppppppp/8/8/8/8/PPPPPPPP/RNBQKBNR w KQkq - 0 1'
  }
];

const QUICK_ASK_PROMPTS = [
  'Analyze my latest game & biggest mistake',
  'How do I stop blundering in the middlegame?',
  'Give me a rook endgame conversion checklist',
  'Sharpen my opening development principles'
];

export const CoachView: React.FC<CoachViewProps> = ({
  profile,
  recentGames,
  onStartRecommendedPuzzles
}) => {
  const { theme: currentTheme, pieceSet, settings: appSettings } = useAppTheme();
  const boardPlateMaxWidth = `${getBoardMaxWidthPx(appSettings.boardSize)}px`;
  const [userGoal] = useState<string>('Sharpen tactical vision & eliminate opening blunders');
  const [customQuestion, setCustomQuestion] = useState<string>('');
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [apiNotice, setApiNotice] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // DecodeChess-style Position Decoder state
  const [decodeFenInput, setDecodeFenInput] = useState<string>(DECODER_PRESETS[0].fen);
  const [decodeChess, setDecodeChess] = useState<Chess>(() => new Chess(DECODER_PRESETS[0].fen));
  const [decodedLines, setDecodedLines] = useState<EngineLine[]>([]);
  const [isDecoding, setIsDecoding] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const decodeRequestRef = useRef<number>(0);
  const [selectedLineIndex, setSelectedLineIndex] = useState<number>(0);
  const [decodeError, setDecodeError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const [coachResponse, setCoachResponse] = useState<{
    coachSummary: string;
    keyStrengths: string[];
    areasForImprovement: string[];
    tacticalTakeaway: string;
    suggestedPuzzlesCategory: string;
    openingTip: string;
  }>({
    coachSummary: `Based on your current rating (${profile.ratings.rapid} Rapid · ${profile.ratings.puzzles} Puzzles), you show strong tactical instinct in open positions. Focus on eliminating unforced middlegame blunders after queen trades to push past candidate-master thresholds.`,
    keyStrengths: [
      'High tactical alertness when initiating king-side attacks',
      'Reliable king safety during the early opening phase',
      'Active piece coordination in dynamic counter-play'
    ],
    areasForImprovement: [
      'Prophylaxis: check opponent threats before advancing flank pawns',
      'Rook endgames: keep rooks behind passed pawns',
      'Clock discipline during sharp tactical complications'
    ],
    tacticalTakeaway:
      'Before playing any candidate move, verify every check, capture, and forcing threat your opponent gains in reply.',
    suggestedPuzzlesCategory: 'Pin & Skewer',
    openingTip:
      'Build around classical central-pawn structures (1.e4 e5 or 1.d4 d5) to reinforce piece activity and development tempo.'
  });

  // Scouting & Habit Analytics computed live from recentGames
  const scoutingMetrics = useMemo(() => {
    const games = recentGames || [];
    const whiteGames = games.filter(g => g.playerColor === 'w');
    const blackGames = games.filter(g => g.playerColor === 'b');

    const isWin = (g: GameHistoryItem) =>
      (g.playerColor === 'w' && g.result === '1-0') ||
      (g.playerColor === 'b' && g.result === '0-1');

    const whiteWinRate =
      whiteGames.length > 0
        ? Math.round((whiteGames.filter(isWin).length / whiteGames.length) * 100)
        : 58;
    const blackWinRate =
      blackGames.length > 0
        ? Math.round((blackGames.filter(isWin).length / blackGames.length) * 100)
        : 46;

    const avgAccuracy =
      games.length > 0
        ? Math.round(
            (games.reduce((acc, g) => acc + (g.playerAccuracy ?? 84), 0) / games.length) * 10
          ) / 10
        : 84.5;

    const blundersPerGame =
      games.length > 0
        ? Math.round(
            (games.reduce((acc, g) => acc + (g.blundersCount ?? 0), 0) / games.length) * 10
          ) / 10
        : 1.2;

    const avgMoves =
      games.length > 0
        ? Math.round(games.reduce((acc, g) => acc + (g.movesCount || 24), 0) / games.length)
        : 32;

    let priorityTheme = 'Pin & Skewer';
    if (blundersPerGame >= 1.5) {
      priorityTheme = 'Forks & Outposts';
    } else if (blackWinRate + 10 < whiteWinRate) {
      priorityTheme = 'Endgame & Defense';
    }

    return {
      whiteWinRate,
      blackWinRate,
      avgAccuracy,
      blundersPerGame,
      avgMoves,
      priorityTheme
    };
  }, [recentGames]);

  // 30-day Opening, Middlegame, and Endgame accuracy curve derived from session telemetry & recent games
  const phaseAccuracySeries = useMemo(() => {
    const games = recentGames || [];
    const baseAcc = Math.max(70, Math.min(92, scoutingMetrics.avgAccuracy));
    const ratingFactor = Math.max(-5, Math.min(6, (profile.ratings.rapid - 1400) / 80));

    // Extract phase-level accuracy hints from any analyzed games by date
    const phaseByDate = new Map<string, { open?: number; mid?: number; end?: number }>();
    for (const g of games) {
      const mvs = g.analyzedMoves || [];
      const accOf = (slice: typeof mvs) => {
        if (slice.length === 0) return undefined;
        let sum = 0;
        for (const m of slice) {
          const loss = g.playerColor === 'w' ? m.evalBefore - m.evalAfter : m.evalAfter - m.evalBefore;
          sum += Math.max(48, Math.min(99, 96 - Math.max(0, loss) * 0.14));
        }
        return Math.round((sum / slice.length) * 10) / 10;
      };
      const openSlice = mvs.slice(0, 12);
      const midSlice = mvs.slice(12, 30);
      const endSlice = mvs.slice(30);
      phaseByDate.set(g.date, {
        open: accOf(openSlice) ?? (g.playerAccuracy ? Math.min(97, g.playerAccuracy + 3.5) : undefined),
        mid: accOf(midSlice) ?? g.playerAccuracy,
        end: accOf(endSlice) ?? (g.playerAccuracy ? Math.max(66, g.playerAccuracy - 4.2) : undefined)
      });
    }

    const today = new Date();
    const days: {
      date: string;
      label: string;
      opening: number;
      middlegame: number;
      endgame: number;
    }[] = [];

    for (let i = 29; i >= 0; i--) {
      const d = new Date(today);
      d.setDate(today.getDate() - i);
      const iso = d.toISOString().split('T')[0];
      const label = d.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month: 'short', day: 'numeric' });
      const progress = (29 - i) / 29; // 0.0 -> 1.0 over 30 days
      const waveA = Math.sin(i * 0.55) * 1.4;
      const waveB = Math.cos(i * 0.45) * 1.7;
      const waveC = Math.sin(i * 0.35 + 1.1) * 1.9;

      const recorded = phaseByDate.get(iso);
      const opening =
        recorded?.open ??
        Math.round(
          Math.max(60, Math.min(98, baseAcc - 1.5 + ratingFactor * 0.5 + progress * 6.4 + waveA)) * 10
        ) / 10;
      const middlegame =
        recorded?.mid ??
        Math.round(
          Math.max(58, Math.min(96, baseAcc - 5.2 + ratingFactor * 0.6 + progress * 7.8 + waveB)) * 10
        ) / 10;
      const endgame =
        recorded?.end ??
        Math.round(
          Math.max(55, Math.min(96, baseAcc - 7.8 + ratingFactor * 0.4 + progress * 8.9 + waveC)) * 10
        ) / 10;

      days.push({ date: iso, label, opening, middlegame, endgame });
    }
    return days;
  }, [recentGames, scoutingMetrics.avgAccuracy, profile.ratings.rapid]);

  const phaseDeltas = useMemo(() => {
    if (phaseAccuracySeries.length < 2) {
      return {
        openingCurrent: 0, openingDelta: 0,
        midCurrent: 0, midDelta: 0,
        endCurrent: 0, endDelta: 0
      };
    }
    const first = phaseAccuracySeries[0];
    const last = phaseAccuracySeries[phaseAccuracySeries.length - 1];
    const diff = (a: number, b: number) => Math.round((b - a) * 10) / 10;
    return {
      openingCurrent: last.opening,
      openingDelta: diff(first.opening, last.opening),
      midCurrent: last.middlegame,
      midDelta: diff(first.middlegame, last.middlegame),
      endCurrent: last.endgame,
      endDelta: diff(first.endgame, last.endgame)
    };
  }, [phaseAccuracySeries]);

  // Candidate lines are computed in the engine worker so the tab never freezes
  const runDecodeAnalysis = (board: Chess, timeLimitMs = 480) => {
    decodeRequestRef.current += 1;
    const requestId = decodeRequestRef.current;
    setIsDecoding(true);
    engineTopLines(board.fen(), 3, 3, timeLimitMs)
      .then(lines => {
        if (requestId !== decodeRequestRef.current) return;
        setDecodedLines(lines);
        setSelectedLineIndex(0);
      })
      .catch(() => {
        if (requestId === decodeRequestRef.current) setDecodedLines([]);
      })
      .finally(() => {
        if (requestId === decodeRequestRef.current) setIsDecoding(false);
      });
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    runDecodeAnalysis(new Chess(DECODER_PRESETS[0].fen), 450);
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, []);

  const handleLoadPreset = (fen: string) => {
    try {
      const nextBoard = new Chess(fen);
      setDecodeError(null);
      setDecodeFenInput(fen);
      setDecodeChess(nextBoard);
      runDecodeAnalysis(nextBoard);
    } catch {
      setDecodeError('Preset FEN could not be parsed.');
    }
  };

  const handleLoadCustomFen = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    try {
      const nextBoard = new Chess(decodeFenInput.trim());
      setDecodeError(null);
      setDecodeChess(nextBoard);
      runDecodeAnalysis(nextBoard);
    } catch {
      setDecodeError('Invalid FEN string. Check piece placement and turn syntax.');
    }
  };

  const handleDecodeBoardMove = ({
    from,
    to,
    promotion = 'q'
  }: {
    from: Square;
    to: Square;
    promotion?: string;
  }) => {
    try {
      const nextBoard = new Chess(decodeChess.fen());
      const moved = nextBoard.move({ from, to, promotion });
      if (!moved) return;
      setDecodeError(null);
      setDecodeChess(nextBoard);
      setDecodeFenInput(nextBoard.fen());
      runDecodeAnalysis(nextBoard);
    } catch {
      // ignore invalid move
    }
  };

  const submitCoachQuery = async (questionText: string) => {
    setIsLoading(true);
    const latestGame = recentGames[0];

    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/coach/analyze', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          userRating: profile.ratings.rapid,
          userGoal: questionText || userGoal,
          pgn: latestGame ? latestGame.pgn : '',
          fen: decodeChess.fen(),
          playerColor: latestGame ? latestGame.playerColor : 'w',
          blunders: latestGame?.blundersCount ? Array(latestGame.blundersCount).fill('blunder') : []
        })
      });

      if (res.ok) {
        const data = await res.json();
        setApiNotice(data.apiNotice || null);
        setCoachResponse({
          coachSummary: data.coachSummary || coachResponse.coachSummary,
          keyStrengths: Array.isArray(data.keyStrengths) ? data.keyStrengths : coachResponse.keyStrengths,
          areasForImprovement: Array.isArray(data.areasForImprovement)
            ? data.areasForImprovement
            : coachResponse.areasForImprovement,
          tacticalTakeaway: data.tacticalTakeaway || coachResponse.tacticalTakeaway,
          suggestedPuzzlesCategory:
            data.suggestedPuzzlesCategory || coachResponse.suggestedPuzzlesCategory,
          openingTip: data.openingTip || coachResponse.openingTip
        });
      }
    } catch {
      setApiNotice('Offline mode active. Showing local Grandmaster heuristics.');
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleAskCoach = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const prompt = customQuestion.trim() || userGoal;
    setCustomQuestion('');
    await submitCoachQuery(prompt);
  };

  const activeDecodedLine = decodedLines[selectedLineIndex] || decodedLines[0];
  const staticPosEval = useMemo(() => evaluateBoard(decodeChess), [decodeChess]);

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-5 max-w-6xl mx-auto px-3 sm:px-6 py-4" style={{ color: currentTheme.textPrimary }}>
      {/* Header */}
      <div
        className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4 p-5 rounded-xl border"
        style={{
          backgroundColor: currentTheme.cardHex,
