                    className="flex items-center justify-between px-2 py-1 rounded"
                    style={{ backgroundColor: idx % 2 === 1 ? theme.surfaceHoverHex : 'transparent' }}
                  >
                    <span style={{ color: theme.textMutedHex }}>
                      {Math.floor(idx / 2) + 1}.{idx % 2 === 0 ? '' : '..'}
                    </span>
                    <span className="font-bold" style={{ color: m.piece.color === 'w' ? theme.textPrimary : theme.accentHex }}>
                      {m.san}
                    </span>
                    <span className="text-[10px]" style={{ color: theme.textMutedHex }}>
                      {coordsToSquare(m.fromRow, m.fromCol, playState.config.boardHeight)} → {coordsToSquare(m.toRow, m.toCol, playState.config.boardHeight)}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                ))
              )}
            </div>

            <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setActiveTab('editor')}
                className="w-full py-2 rounded-lg border text-xs font-bold transition hover:opacity-80"
                style={{
                  backgroundColor: theme.cardSecondaryHex,
                  borderColor: theme.cardBorderHex,
                  color: theme.textPrimary
                }}
              >
                Back to Board & Rules Editor
              </button>
              {onPlayInMainArena && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => onPlayInMainArena(currentVariant)}
                  className="w-full py-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold transition hover:opacity-90"
                  style={{
                    backgroundColor: theme.accentHex,
                    color: theme.accentTextHex
                  }}
                >
                  Open in Main Timed Arena
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* TAB 3: SAVED PRESET LIBRARY */}
      {activeTab === 'library' && (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
          {savedVariants.map(variant => (
            <div
              key={variant.id}
              className="p-5 rounded-xl border flex flex-col justify-between gap-4"
              style={{
                backgroundColor: theme.cardHex,
                borderColor: theme.cardBorderHex
              }}
            >
              <div>
                <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3 mb-2">
                  <div>
                    <h3 className="font-display font-bold text-base" style={{ color: theme.textPrimary }}>
                      {variant.name}
                    </h3>
                    <div className="text-[11px] font-mono font-bold uppercase tracking-wider" style={{ color: theme.accentHex }}>
                      {variant.boardWidth}×{variant.boardHeight} Grid
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => handleDeleteSaved(variant.id)}
                    aria-label={`Delete ${variant.name}`}
                    className="p-1.5 rounded-lg hover:opacity-80 text-rose-500"
                    title="Delete saved variant"
                  >
                    <Trash2 className="w-4 h-4" />
                  </button>
                </div>
                <p className="text-xs mb-3 leading-relaxed" style={{ color: theme.textSecondary }}>
                  {variant.description}
                </p>

                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5">
                  {variant.customPiecesUsed.map(pt => (
                    <div
                      key={pt}
                      className="w-6 h-6 p-0.5 rounded border"
                      style={{
                        backgroundColor: theme.cardSecondaryHex,
                        borderColor: theme.cardBorderHex
                      }}
                      title={ALL_CUSTOM_PIECE_DEFS.find(p => p.type === pt)?.name || pt}
                    >
                      <ChessPieceIcon type={pt} color="w" set={pieceSet} />
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 pt-3 border-t" style={{ borderColor: theme.cardBorderHex }}>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => {
                    setCurrentVariant(variant);
                    handleStartPlay();
                  }}
                  className="flex-1 flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold transition"
                  style={{ backgroundColor: theme.accentHex, color: theme.accentTextHex }}
                >
                  <Play className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>Play</span>
                </button>

                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => {
                    setCurrentVariant(variant);
                    setActiveTab('editor');
                  }}
                  className="px-3.5 py-2 rounded-lg border text-xs font-semibold transition hover:opacity-80"
                  style={{
                    backgroundColor: theme.cardSecondaryHex,
                    borderColor: theme.cardBorderHex,
                    color: theme.textPrimary
                  }}
                >
                  Edit
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};
</file>

<file path="src/components/DashboardView.tsx">
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { UserProfile, GameHistoryItem } from '../types/chess';
import { Trophy, TrendingUp, History, Sparkles, Swords, Zap, Clock, ChevronRight, FileUp } from 'lucide-react';
import { ImportPgnModal } from './ImportPgnModal';
import { AchievementsPanel } from './Achievements';
import { AchievementStatus } from '../engine/achievements';
import { useAppTheme } from '../context/ThemeContext';
import { ChessPieceIcon } from './ChessPieces';
import { getVariantDisplayName } from '../engine/variants';

interface DashboardViewProps {
  profile: UserProfile;
  matches: GameHistoryItem[];
  onReviewGame: (game: GameHistoryItem) => void;
  onPlayNewGame: () => void;
  onImportGame: (game: GameHistoryItem) => void;
  achievements: AchievementStatus[];
}

export const DashboardView: React.FC<DashboardViewProps> = ({
  profile,
  matches,
  onReviewGame,
  onPlayNewGame,
  onImportGame,
  achievements
}) => {
  const { theme: currentTheme, pieceSet } = useAppTheme();
  const [isImportOpen, setIsImportOpen] = useState(false);
  const totalGames = Math.max(1, profile.stats.gamesPlayed || matches.length || 1);
  const hasPlayed = (profile.stats.gamesPlayed || matches.length) > 0;
  const wins = profile.stats.wins || 0;
  const draws = profile.stats.draws || 0;
  const losses = profile.stats.losses || 0;

  const winRate = hasPlayed ? Math.round((wins / totalGames) * 100) : 0;
  const drawRate = hasPlayed ? Math.round((draws / totalGames) * 100) : 0;
  const lossRate = hasPlayed ? Math.round((losses / totalGames) * 100) : 0;

  const renderTrendChart = (history: { date: string; elo: number }[]) => {
    if (!history || history.length < 2) {
      return (
        <div
          className="h-32 flex items-center justify-center text-xs italic rounded-xl"
          style={{
            color: currentTheme.textMutedHex,
            backgroundColor: currentTheme.cardSecondaryHex,
            border: `1px dashed ${currentTheme.cardBorderHex}`
          }}
        >
          Complete additional matches to plot live Elo progression
        </div>
      );
    }

    const minElo = Math.min(...history.map(h => h.elo)) - 40;
    const maxElo = Math.max(...history.map(h => h.elo)) + 40;
    const range = Math.max(20, maxElo - minElo);

    const points = history
      .map((h, idx) => {
        const x = (idx / (history.length - 1)) * 300;
        const y = 88 - ((h.elo - minElo) / range) * 76;
        return `${x},${y}`;
      })
      .join(' ');

    return (
      <div className="relative w-full h-32 pt-2">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 300 100" className="w-full h-full overflow-visible" preserveAspectRatio="none">
          <defs>
            <linearGradient id="gmChartGradient" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
              <stop offset="0%" stopColor={currentTheme.accentHex} stopOpacity="0.32" />
              <stop offset="100%" stopColor={currentTheme.accentHex} stopOpacity="0.0" />
            </linearGradient>
          </defs>
          {/* Reference mid-grid lines */}
          <line x1="0" y1="25" x2="300" y2="25" stroke={currentTheme.cardBorderHex} strokeDasharray="3 3" strokeWidth="0.7" />
          <line x1="0" y1="55" x2="300" y2="55" stroke={currentTheme.cardBorderHex} strokeDasharray="3 3" strokeWidth="0.7" />
          <line x1="0" y1="85" x2="300" y2="85" stroke={currentTheme.cardBorderHex} strokeDasharray="3 3" strokeWidth="0.7" />

          <polygon points={`0,100 ${points} 300,100`} fill="url(#gmChartGradient)" />
          <polyline
            fill="none"
            stroke={currentTheme.accentHex}
            strokeWidth="2.5"
            strokeLinecap="round"
            strokeLinejoin="round"
            points={points}
          />
          {history.map((h, idx) => {
            const x = (idx / (history.length - 1)) * 300;
            const y = 88 - ((h.elo - minElo) / range) * 76;
            return (
              <circle
                key={idx}
                cx={x}
                cy={y}
                r="3.2"
                fill={currentTheme.cardHex}
                stroke={currentTheme.accentHex}
                strokeWidth="2"
              />
            );
          })}
        </svg>
      </div>
    );
  };

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-5 max-w-6xl mx-auto p-3 sm:p-5" style={{ color: currentTheme.textPrimary }}>
      {/* Profile Hero Strip */}
      <div
        className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4 rounded-xl p-5"
        style={{
          backgroundColor: currentTheme.cardHex,
          border: `1px solid ${currentTheme.cardBorderHex}`
        }}
      >
        <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
          <div
            className="w-14 h-14 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center p-2 shrink-0"
            style={{
              backgroundColor: currentTheme.cardSecondaryHex,
              border: `1px solid ${currentTheme.cardBorderHex}`
            }}
          >
            <ChessPieceIcon type="n" color="w" set={pieceSet} />
          </div>
          <div>
            <div className="flex items-baseline gap-2.5 flex-wrap">
              <h1 className="font-display text-xl sm:text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight" style={{ color: currentTheme.textPrimary }}>
                {profile.username}
              </h1>
              <span className="font-mono text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider" style={{ color: currentTheme.accentHex }}>
                {profile.title || 'NM'}
              </span>
            </div>
            <p className="text-xs mt-0.5 tabular-nums" style={{ color: currentTheme.textMutedHex }}>
              {profile.stats.gamesPlayed} Games Logged · Peak Rating {profile.stats.highestRating}
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={onPlayNewGame}
          className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2 px-5 py-2.5 rounded-lg font-bold text-sm transition whitespace-nowrap active:scale-[0.98] cursor-pointer"
          style={{
            backgroundColor: currentTheme.accentHex,
            color: currentTheme.accentTextHex
          }}
        >
          <Swords className="w-4 h-4" />
          Play Match
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Ratings Strip */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-5 gap-3">
        {[
          { label: 'Bullet', elo: profile.ratings.bullet, icon: <Zap className="w-4 h-4" style={{ color: '#D97706' }} />, highlight: false },
          { label: 'Blitz', elo: profile.ratings.blitz, icon: <Clock className="w-4 h-4" style={{ color: '#EA580C' }} />, highlight: false },
          { label: 'Rapid', elo: profile.ratings.rapid, icon: <TrendingUp className="w-4 h-4" style={{ color: currentTheme.accentHex }} />, highlight: true },
          { label: 'Puzzles', elo: profile.ratings.puzzles, icon: <Trophy className="w-4 h-4" style={{ color: '#2563EB' }} />, highlight: false },
          { label: 'Variants', elo: profile.ratings.variants, icon: <Sparkles className="w-4 h-4" style={{ color: '#7C3AED' }} />, highlight: false }
        ].map(item => (
          <div
            key={item.label}
            className="rounded-xl p-4"
            style={{
              backgroundColor: currentTheme.cardHex,
              border: `1px solid ${item.highlight ? currentTheme.accentHex + '60' : currentTheme.cardBorderHex}`
            }}
          >
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs mb-1.5 font-semibold" style={{ color: currentTheme.textMutedHex }}>
              <span>{item.label}</span>
              {item.icon}
            </div>
            <div
              className="text-2xl font-bold font-mono tabular-nums tracking-tight"
              style={{ color: item.highlight ? currentTheme.accentHex : currentTheme.textPrimary }}
            >
              {item.elo}
            </div>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* Analytics & Performance */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-5">
        {/* Rating Trend Chart */}
        <div
          className="lg:col-span-8 rounded-xl p-5 flex flex-col justify-between"
          style={{
            backgroundColor: currentTheme.cardHex,
            border: `1px solid ${currentTheme.cardBorderHex}`
          }}
        >
          <div className="flex items-baseline justify-between gap-2 mb-3">
            <div>
              <h2 className="font-display text-sm font-bold flex items-center gap-2" style={{ color: currentTheme.textPrimary }}>
                <TrendingUp className="w-4 h-4" style={{ color: currentTheme.accentHex }} />
                Rapid Rating Trajectory
              </h2>
              <p className="text-xs mt-0.5" style={{ color: currentTheme.textMutedHex }}>
                Elo curve recorded across local & custom engine sessions
              </p>
            </div>
            <div className="text-xs font-mono font-bold tabular-nums shrink-0" style={{ color: currentTheme.accentHex }}>
              Peak {profile.stats.highestRating}
            </div>
          </div>

          {renderTrendChart(profile.ratingHistory.rapid)}
        </div>

        {/* Win/Loss Distribution */}
        <div
          className="lg:col-span-4 rounded-xl p-5 flex flex-col justify-between"
          style={{
            backgroundColor: currentTheme.cardHex,
            border: `1px solid ${currentTheme.cardBorderHex}`
          }}
        >
          <div>
            <h2 className="font-display text-sm font-bold mb-0.5" style={{ color: currentTheme.textPrimary }}>
              Match Distribution
            </h2>
            <p className="text-xs mb-4" style={{ color: currentTheme.textMutedHex }}>
              Cumulative outcome split
            </p>

            <div className="space-y-3">
              <div>
                <div className="flex justify-between text-xs mb-1">
                  <span className="font-semibold" style={{ color: currentTheme.accentHex }}>Wins ({wins})</span>
                  <span className="font-mono tabular-nums" style={{ color: currentTheme.textPrimary }}>{winRate}%</span>
                </div>
                <div className="w-full h-2 rounded-full overflow-hidden" style={{ backgroundColor: currentTheme.cardSecondaryHex }}>
                  <div className="h-full rounded-full transition-all duration-300" style={{ width: `${winRate}%`, backgroundColor: currentTheme.accentHex }} />
                </div>
              </div>

              <div>
                <div className="flex justify-between text-xs mb-1">
                  <span className="font-semibold" style={{ color: currentTheme.textMutedHex }}>Draws ({draws})</span>
                  <span className="font-mono tabular-nums" style={{ color: currentTheme.textMutedHex }}>{drawRate}%</span>
                </div>
                <div className="w-full h-2 rounded-full overflow-hidden" style={{ backgroundColor: currentTheme.cardSecondaryHex }}>
                  <div className="h-full rounded-full transition-all duration-300" style={{ width: `${drawRate}%`, backgroundColor: currentTheme.textMutedHex }} />
                </div>
              </div>

              <div>
                <div className="flex justify-between text-xs mb-1">
                  <span className="font-semibold" style={{ color: '#E11D48' }}>Losses ({losses})</span>
                  <span className="font-mono tabular-nums" style={{ color: '#E11D48' }}>{lossRate}%</span>
                </div>
                <div className="w-full h-2 rounded-full overflow-hidden" style={{ backgroundColor: currentTheme.cardSecondaryHex }}>
                  <div className="h-full rounded-full transition-all duration-300" style={{ width: `${lossRate}%`, backgroundColor: '#E11D48' }} />
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div
            className="pt-3 text-xs flex items-center justify-between font-mono tabular-nums mt-4"
            style={{
              borderTop: `1px solid ${currentTheme.cardBorderHex}`,
              color: currentTheme.textMutedHex
            }}
          >
            <span>Puzzles Solved</span>
            <span className="font-bold" style={{ color: currentTheme.textPrimary }}>{profile.stats.puzzlesSolved}</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <AchievementsPanel statuses={achievements} />

      {/* Historical Matches Archive */}
      <div
        className="rounded-xl p-5"
        style={{
          backgroundColor: currentTheme.cardHex,
          border: `1px solid ${currentTheme.cardBorderHex}`
        }}
      >
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <History className="w-4 h-4" style={{ color: currentTheme.accentHex }} />
            <h2 className="font-display text-base font-bold" style={{ color: currentTheme.textPrimary }}>
              Historical Match Archive
            </h2>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <span className="hidden sm:inline text-xs font-mono tabular-nums" style={{ color: currentTheme.textMutedHex }}>
              {matches.length} Matches Saved
            </span>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setIsImportOpen(true)}
              className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold transition hover:opacity-90"
              style={{ backgroundColor: currentTheme.accentHex, color: currentTheme.accentTextHex }}
            >
              <FileUp className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              Import PGN
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {matches.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="text-center py-10 text-xs italic" style={{ color: currentTheme.textMutedHex }}>
            No matches recorded yet. Play a match, or import a PGN to review a game from another site.
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
            <table className="w-full text-left text-xs" style={{ color: currentTheme.textPrimary }}>
              <thead
                className="font-semibold uppercase text-[10px] tracking-wider"
                style={{
                  backgroundColor: currentTheme.cardSecondaryHex,
                  color: currentTheme.textMutedHex,
                  borderBottom: `1px solid ${currentTheme.cardBorderHex}`
                }}
              >
                <tr>
                  <th className="py-2.5 px-3">Date</th>
                  <th className="py-2.5 px-3">Variant</th>
                  <th className="py-2.5 px-3">Opponent</th>
                  <th className="py-2.5 px-3">Time</th>
                  <th className="py-2.5 px-3">Result</th>
                  <th className="py-2.5 px-3">Accuracy</th>
                  <th className="py-2.5 px-3 text-right">Review</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody className="font-medium">
                {matches.map(game => {
                  const isWin =
                    (game.result === '1-0' && game.playerColor === 'w') ||
                    (game.result === '0-1' && game.playerColor === 'b');
                  const isDraw = game.result === '1/2-1/2';
                  const resultColor = isWin ? '#059669' : isDraw ? '#D97706' : '#E11D48';

                  return (
                    <tr
                      key={game.id}
                      className="transition hover:opacity-90"
                      style={{ borderBottom: `1px solid ${currentTheme.cardBorderHex}55` }}
                    >
                      <td className="py-3 px-3 font-mono tabular-nums" style={{ color: currentTheme.textMutedHex }}>
                        {game.date}
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3 px-3 font-semibold" style={{ color: currentTheme.textPrimary }}>
                        {getVariantDisplayName(game.variant)}
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3 px-3 font-semibold tabular-nums" style={{ color: currentTheme.textPrimary }}>
                        {game.opponentName} ({game.opponentElo})
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3 px-3 font-mono tabular-nums" style={{ color: currentTheme.textMutedHex }}>
                        {game.timeControl}
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3 px-3 font-mono font-bold tabular-nums" style={{ color: resultColor }}>
                        {game.result}
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3 px-3 font-mono font-bold tabular-nums" style={{ color: currentTheme.accentHex }}>
                        {game.playerAccuracy ? `${game.playerAccuracy.toFixed(1)}%` : '—'}
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3 px-3 text-right">
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => onReviewGame(game)}
                          className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold transition cursor-pointer"
                          style={{
                            backgroundColor: `${currentTheme.accentHex}18`,
                            color: currentTheme.accentHex,
                            border: `1px solid ${currentTheme.accentHex}35`
                          }}
                        >
                          <span>Analyze</span>
                          <ChevronRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                        </button>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  );
                })}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      <ImportPgnModal
        isOpen={isImportOpen}
        username={profile.username}
        onClose={() => setIsImportOpen(false)}
        onImported={game => {
          setIsImportOpen(false);
          onImportGame(game);
        }}
      />
    </div>
  );
};

<file path="src/components/EndgameDrills.tsx">
import React, { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Chess, Square } from 'chess.js';
import { Check, ChevronRight, Flag, Lightbulb, Loader2, RotateCcw, Star, Target, X } from 'lucide-react';
import { ChessBoard, getBoardMaxWidthPx } from './ChessBoard';
import { useAppTheme } from '../context/ThemeContext';
import { sounds } from '../utils/sound';
import { engineGetAIMove, engineSearch } from '../engine/engineClient';
import {
  DRILL_OPPONENT,
  DrillOutcome,
  DrillProgress,
  ENDGAME_DRILLS,
  EndgameDrill,
  evaluateDrill,
  loadDrillProgress,
  saveDrillProgress,
  starsFor
} from '../engine/endgameDrills';

interface PlayedMove {
  from: string;
  to: string;
  promotion?: string;
}

const MIN_REPLY_DELAY_MS = 300;

function replay(fen: string, moves: PlayedMove[]): Chess {
  const board = new Chess(fen);
  for (const m of moves) board.move(m);
  return board;
}

function playSound(san: string) {
  if (san.includes('#') || san.includes('+')) sounds.playCheck();
  else if (san.includes('=')) sounds.playPromote();
  else if (san.includes('x')) sounds.playCapture();
  else sounds.playMove();
}

const GOAL_LABEL: Record<EndgameDrill['goal'], string> = {
  mate: 'Checkmate',
  promote: 'Promote the pawn',
  draw: 'Hold the draw'
};

const DIFFICULTY_COLOR: Record<EndgameDrill['difficulty'], string> = {
  Basic: '#10b981',
  Intermediate: '#f59e0b',
  Advanced: '#f43f5e'
};

export const EndgameDrills: React.FC = () => {
  const { theme, settings } = useAppTheme();
  const [drillId, setDrillId] = useState(ENDGAME_DRILLS[0].id);
  const [moves, setMoves] = useState<PlayedMove[]>([]);
  const [userMoves, setUserMoves] = useState(0);
  const [hintsUsed, setHintsUsed] = useState(0);
  const [hintArrow, setHintArrow] = useState<{ from: Square; to: Square } | null>(null);
  const [isThinking, setIsThinking] = useState(false);
  const [isHinting, setIsHinting] = useState(false);
  const [outcome, setOutcome] = useState<DrillOutcome>(null);
  const [earnedStars, setEarnedStars] = useState(0);
  const [progress, setProgress] = useState<Record<string, DrillProgress>>(() => loadDrillProgress());
  // Incremented on every restart so late engine replies from an old attempt are ignored
  const attemptRef = useRef(0);

  const drill = ENDGAME_DRILLS.find(d => d.id === drillId) ?? ENDGAME_DRILLS[0];
  const board = useMemo(() => replay(drill.fen, moves), [drill, moves]);
  const isUserTurn = !outcome && !isThinking && board.turn() === drill.side;

  const finish = (result: NonNullable<DrillOutcome>, movesMade: number) => {
    setOutcome(result);
    setHintArrow(null);
    if (result.status === 'success') {
      const stars = starsFor(drill, movesMade, hintsUsed);
      setEarnedStars(stars);
      sounds.playPuzzleSuccess();
      setProgress(prev => {
        const current = prev[drill.id] ?? { bestStars: 0, completions: 0 };
        const next = {
          ...prev,
          [drill.id]: { bestStars: Math.max(current.bestStars, stars), completions: current.completions + 1 }
        };
        saveDrillProgress(next);
        return next;
      });
    } else {
      sounds.playBlunder();
    }
  };

  const engineReply = (position: Chess, history: PlayedMove[], movesMade: number) => {
    const attempt = attemptRef.current;
    setIsThinking(true);
    const started = Date.now();
    engineGetAIMove(position, DRILL_OPPONENT)
      .then(reply => {
        const wait = Math.max(0, MIN_REPLY_DELAY_MS - (Date.now() - started));
        window.setTimeout(() => {
          if (attempt !== attemptRef.current) return;
          setIsThinking(false);
          if (!reply) return;
          const nextHistory = [...history, { from: reply.from, to: reply.to, promotion: reply.promotion }];
          const after = replay(drill.fen, nextHistory);
          playSound(reply.san);
          setMoves(nextHistory);
          const result = evaluateDrill(drill, after, movesMade, reply.promotion ? reply.color : null);
          if (result) finish(result, movesMade);
        }, wait);
      })
      .catch(() => {
        if (attempt === attemptRef.current) setIsThinking(false);
      });
  };

  const restart = () => {
    attemptRef.current += 1;
    setMoves([]);
    setUserMoves(0);
    setHintsUsed(0);
    setHintArrow(null);
    setIsThinking(false);
    setIsHinting(false);
    setOutcome(null);
    setEarnedStars(0);
    const start = new Chess(drill.fen);
    if (start.turn() !== drill.side) engineReply(start, [], 0);
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    restart();
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [drillId]);

  useEffect(() => () => {
    attemptRef.current += 1;
  }, []);

  const handleMove = ({ from, to, promotion }: { from: Square; to: Square; promotion?: string }) => {
    if (!isUserTurn) return false;
    let san: string;
    let promoted: string | undefined;
    try {
      const probe = new Chess(board.fen());
      const m = probe.move({ from, to, promotion: promotion || 'q' });
      san = m.san;
      promoted = m.promotion;
    } catch {
      return false;
    }
    const nextHistory = [...moves, { from, to, promotion: promoted }];
    const after = replay(drill.fen, nextHistory);
    const movesMade = userMoves + 1;
    playSound(san);
    setMoves(nextHistory);
    setUserMoves(movesMade);
    setHintArrow(null);

    const result = evaluateDrill(drill, after, movesMade, promoted ? drill.side : null);
    if (result) finish(result, movesMade);
    else engineReply(after, nextHistory, movesMade);
    return true;
  };

  const requestHint = () => {
    if (!isUserTurn || isHinting) return;
    const attempt = attemptRef.current;
    const fenAtRequest = board.fen();
    setIsHinting(true);
    engineSearch(board, 6, 1200)
      .then(result => {
        if (attempt !== attemptRef.current || board.fen() !== fenAtRequest) return;
        if (result.bestMove) {
          setHintArrow({ from: result.bestMove.from as Square, to: result.bestMove.to as Square });
          setHintsUsed(h => h + 1);
        }
      })
      .catch(() => {
        /* hint unavailable */
      })
      .finally(() => {
        if (attempt === attemptRef.current) setIsHinting(false);
      });
  };

  const goToNext = () => {
    const idx = ENDGAME_DRILLS.findIndex(d => d.id === drill.id);
    setDrillId(ENDGAME_DRILLS[(idx + 1) % ENDGAME_DRILLS.length].id);
  };

  const plateMaxWidth = `${getBoardMaxWidthPx(settings.boardSize)}px`;
  const counterText =
    drill.goal === 'draw'
      ? `Survive ${Math.min(userMoves, drill.surviveMoves ?? 0)}/${drill.surviveMoves}`
      : `Moves ${userMoves} · par ${drill.par}`;

  const renderStars = (count: number, size = 'w-3 h-3') => (
    <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-0.5" aria-label={`${count} of 3 stars`}>
      {[0, 1, 2].map(i => (
        <Star
          key={i}
          className={size}
          style={{ color: i < count ? '#f59e0b' : theme.textMutedHex }}
          fill={i < count ? '#f59e0b' : 'none'}
        />
      ))}
    </span>
  );

  return (
    <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-5 items-start">
      {/* Board */}
      <div className="lg:col-span-7 flex flex-col items-center gap-2.5">
        <div
          className="w-full flex items-center justify-between px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl border text-xs font-semibold"
          style={{ maxWidth: plateMaxWidth, backgroundColor: theme.cardHex, borderColor: theme.cardBorderHex }}
        >
          <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5" style={{ color: theme.textPrimary }}>
            {isThinking && <Loader2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin" style={{ color: theme.accentHex }} />}
            {outcome ? (outcome.status === 'success' ? 'Drill complete' : 'Drill failed') : isThinking ? 'Engine is thinking…' : 'Your move'}
          </span>
          <span className="font-mono tabular-nums" style={{ color: theme.accentHex }}>
            {counterText}
          </span>
        </div>
        <ChessBoard
          chess={board}
          isFlipped={drill.side === 'b'}
          playerColor={drill.side}
          premoveMode="off"
          bestMoveArrow={hintArrow}
          onMakeMove={handleMove}
          disabled={!isUserTurn}
        />
      </div>

      {/* Panel */}
      <div className="lg:col-span-5 flex flex-col gap-4">
        <div className="rounded-xl p-4 flex flex-col gap-3" style={{ backgroundColor: theme.cardHex, border: `1px solid ${theme.cardBorderHex}` }}>
          <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
            <div className="min-w-0">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-[10px] font-mono font-bold">
                <span style={{ color: DIFFICULTY_COLOR[drill.difficulty] }}>{drill.difficulty.toUpperCase()}</span>
                <span style={{ color: theme.textMutedHex }}>· YOU PLAY {drill.side === 'w' ? 'WHITE' : 'BLACK'}</span>
              </div>
              <h2 className="font-display text-base font-bold leading-tight mt-0.5" style={{ color: theme.textPrimary }}>
                {drill.name}
              </h2>
            </div>
            {renderStars(progress[drill.id]?.bestStars ?? 0, 'w-4 h-4')}
          </div>

          <div
            className="flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold"
            style={{ backgroundColor: `${theme.accentHex}14`, color: theme.accentHex, border: `1px solid ${theme.accentHex}33` }}
          >
            <Target className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
            <span>
              Goal: {GOAL_LABEL[drill.goal]}
              {drill.goal === 'draw' ? ` — survive ${drill.surviveMoves} moves` : ` — par ${drill.par} moves for ★★★`}
            </span>
          </div>

          <p className="text-xs leading-relaxed" style={{ color: theme.textSecondary }}>
            {drill.summary}
          </p>
          <ul className="flex flex-col gap-1">
            {drill.tips.map(tip => (
              <li key={tip} className="text-[11px] flex gap-1.5" style={{ color: theme.textMutedHex }}>
                <span style={{ color: theme.accentHex }}>•</span>
                {tip}
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>

          {outcome && (
            <div
              role="status"
              className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 px-3 py-2.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold"
              style={{
                backgroundColor: outcome.status === 'success' ? '#10b98114' : '#f43f5e14',
                color: outcome.status === 'success' ? '#10b981' : '#f43f5e',
                border: `1px solid ${outcome.status === 'success' ? '#10b98144' : '#f43f5e44'}`
              }}
            >
              <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                {outcome.status === 'success' ? <Check className="w-4 h-4" /> : <X className="w-4 h-4" />}
                {outcome.reason}
              </span>
              {outcome.status === 'success' && renderStars(earnedStars, 'w-3.5 h-3.5')}
            </div>
          )}

          <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] font-mono" style={{ color: theme.textMutedHex }}>
            <span>Hints used: {hintsUsed} (−1★ each)</span>
            <span>Completed: {progress[drill.id]?.completions ?? 0}×</span>
          </div>

          <div className="flex gap-2">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={restart}
              className="flex-1 inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold border transition hover:opacity-80"
              style={{ borderColor: theme.cardBorderHex, color: theme.textPrimary }}
            >
              <RotateCcw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              Restart
            </button>
            {!outcome ? (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={requestHint}
                disabled={!isUserTurn || isHinting}
                className="flex-1 inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold border transition hover:opacity-80 disabled:opacity-40"
                style={{ borderColor: theme.cardBorderHex, color: theme.textPrimary }}
              >
                {isHinting ? <Loader2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin" /> : <Lightbulb className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
                Hint
              </button>
            ) : (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={goToNext}
                className="flex-1 inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold transition hover:opacity-90"
                style={{ backgroundColor: theme.accentHex, color: theme.accentTextHex }}
              >
                Next drill
                <ChevronRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Drill list */}
        <div className="rounded-xl p-2 flex flex-col gap-1" style={{ backgroundColor: theme.cardHex, border: `1px solid ${theme.cardBorderHex}` }}>
          {ENDGAME_DRILLS.map(d => {
            const selected = d.id === drill.id;
            return (
              <button
                key={d.id}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setDrillId(d.id)}
                className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 px-2.5 py-2 rounded-lg text-left transition"
                style={{
                  backgroundColor: selected ? `${theme.accentHex}1f` : 'transparent',
                  border: `1px solid ${selected ? `${theme.accentHex}66` : 'transparent'}`
                }}
              >
                <span className="min-w-0 flex items-center gap-2">
                  <Flag className="w-3.5 h-3.5 shrink-0" style={{ color: DIFFICULTY_COLOR[d.difficulty] }} />
                  <span className="min-w-0">
                    <span className="block text-xs font-bold truncate" style={{ color: selected ? theme.accentHex : theme.textPrimary }}>
                      {d.name}
                    </span>
                    <span className="block text-[10px] font-mono" style={{ color: theme.textMutedHex }}>
                      {d.difficulty} · {GOAL_LABEL[d.goal]}
                    </span>
                  </span>
                </span>
                {renderStars(progress[d.id]?.bestStars ?? 0)}
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};
