                            : updateSettings({ boardTheme: board.id })
                        }
                        className="p-2 rounded-xl flex flex-col gap-1.5 transition text-left"
                        style={{
                          backgroundColor: isSelected ? `${currentTheme.accentHex}20` : currentTheme.cardSecondaryHex,
                          border: `2px solid ${isSelected ? currentTheme.accentHex : currentTheme.cardBorderHex}`,
                          color: currentTheme.textPrimary
                        }}
                      >
                        <BoardSwatch board={board} />
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-1">
                          <span className="font-bold text-[11px] truncate" style={{ color: currentTheme.textPrimary }}>{board.name}</span>
                          {isSelected && <Check className="w-3 h-3 shrink-0" style={{ color: currentTheme.accentHex }} />}
                        </div>
                        <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[9px] truncate" style={{ color: currentTheme.textMutedHex }}>
                          <span className="w-3.5 h-3.5 shrink-0">
                            <ChessPieceIcon type="k" color="w" set={board.pieceSet!} />
                          </span>
                          {pieceInfo?.name}
                        </span>
                      </button>
                    );
                  })}
                </div>

              </div>

              {/* SECTION 2: 10 APP THEMES, EACH WITH DARK & LIGHT MODE */}
              <div>
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 mb-2.5">
                  <span className="font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-xs flex items-center gap-1.5" style={{ color: currentTheme.textPrimary }}>
                    <Sparkles className="w-4 h-4" style={{ color: currentTheme.accentHex }} />
                    App Themes · 10
                  </span>

                  {/* Dark / Light mode toggle */}
                  <div
                    role="radiogroup"
                    aria-label="Color mode"
                    className="flex items-center p-0.5 rounded-full text-[11px] font-bold"
                    style={{ backgroundColor: currentTheme.cardSecondaryHex, border: `1px solid ${currentTheme.cardBorderHex}` }}
                  >
                    {(['dark', 'light'] as const).map(mode => {
                      const active = colorMode === mode;
                      return (
                        <button
                          key={mode}
                          type="button"
                          role="radio"
                          aria-checked={active}
                          onClick={() => updateSettingImmediate('colorMode', mode)}
                          className="flex items-center gap-1 px-3 py-1 rounded-full transition"
                          style={
                            active
                              ? { backgroundColor: currentTheme.accentHex, color: currentTheme.accentTextHex }
                              : { color: currentTheme.textMutedHex }
                          }
                        >
                          {mode === 'dark' ? <Moon className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> : <Sun className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
                          {mode === 'dark' ? 'Dark' : 'Light'}
                        </button>
                      );
                    })}
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-5 gap-2">
                  {APP_THEME_FAMILIES.map(family => {
                    const isSelected = activeFamily.id === family.id;
                    const t = colorMode === 'light' ? family.light : family.dark;
                    return (
                      <button
                        key={family.id}
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => updateSettingImmediate('appTheme', family.id)}
                        className="p-2 rounded-xl flex flex-col gap-1.5 transition text-left"
                        style={{
                          backgroundColor: isSelected ? `${currentTheme.accentHex}20` : currentTheme.cardSecondaryHex,
                          border: `2px solid ${isSelected ? currentTheme.accentHex : currentTheme.cardBorderHex}`,
                          color: currentTheme.textPrimary
                        }}
                      >
                        {/* Mini app preview in the active mode */}
                        <div
                          className="w-full h-12 rounded-lg p-1.5 flex flex-col gap-1 overflow-hidden"
                          style={{
                            backgroundColor: t.bgHex,
                            backgroundImage: t.bgGradient,
                            backgroundSize: 'cover',
                            border: `1px solid ${t.cardBorderHex}`
                          }}
                        >
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                            <div
                              className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full"
                              style={{ backgroundImage: `linear-gradient(135deg, ${t.accentHex}, ${t.accent2Hex})` }}
                            />
                            <div className="h-1 w-6 rounded-full" style={{ backgroundColor: t.textPrimary, opacity: 0.7 }} />
                          </div>
                          <div className="flex-1 rounded flex items-center gap-1 px-1" style={{ backgroundColor: t.cardHex, border: `1px solid ${t.cardBorderHex}` }}>
                            <div className="h-1 w-5 rounded-full" style={{ backgroundColor: t.textSecondary, opacity: 0.7 }} />
                            <div className="ml-auto h-2 w-4 rounded-sm" style={{ backgroundColor: t.accentHex }} />
                          </div>
                        </div>
                        {/* Dark / light pair swatch */}
                        <div className="flex h-1.5 rounded-full overflow-hidden">
                          <div className="flex-1" style={{ backgroundColor: family.dark.bgHex }} />
                          <div className="flex-1" style={{ backgroundColor: family.dark.accentHex }} />
                          <div className="flex-1" style={{ backgroundColor: family.light.accentHex }} />
                          <div className="flex-1" style={{ backgroundColor: family.light.bgHex }} />
                        </div>
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                          <span className="font-bold text-[11px] truncate" style={{ color: currentTheme.textPrimary }}>{family.name}</span>
                          {isSelected && <Check className="w-3 h-3 shrink-0" style={{ color: currentTheme.accentHex }} />}
                        </div>
                        <span className="text-[9px] truncate" style={{ color: currentTheme.textMutedHex }}>{family.description}</span>
                      </button>
                    );
                  })}
                </div>
              </div>
              {/* SECTION 4: KING CROWN EMBLEM (compact) */}
              <div
                className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-xl"
                style={{ backgroundColor: currentTheme.cardSecondaryHex, border: `1px solid ${currentTheme.cardBorderHex}` }}
              >
                <span className="flex items-center gap-2 min-w-0">
                  <span className="w-7 h-7 shrink-0">
                    <ChessPieceIcon type="k" color="w" set={current.pieceSet} kingFinial={current.kingFinial || 'crescent'} />
                  </span>
                  <span className="text-xs font-bold" style={{ color: currentTheme.textPrimary }}>King emblem</span>
                </span>
                <div
                  role="radiogroup"
                  aria-label="King crown emblem"
                  className="flex items-center p-0.5 rounded-lg"

            type="button"

            className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-5 py-2 rounded-xl font-bold transition shadow-lg active:scale-95"
            style={{
              backgroundColor: currentTheme.accentHex,
              color: currentTheme.accentTextHex
            }}
          >
            <Check className="w-4 h-4" />
            Done
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { BookOpen, Crown, GraduationCap, Microscope } from 'lucide-react';
import { useAppTheme } from '../context/ThemeContext';
import { OpeningTrainer } from './OpeningTrainer';
import { EndgameDrills } from './EndgameDrills';
import { AnalysisBoard } from './AnalysisBoard';

type TrainSection = 'openings' | 'endgames' | 'analysis';

const SECTIONS: { id: TrainSection; label: string; icon: React.ReactNode; blurb: string }[] = [
  {
    id: 'openings',
    label: 'Openings',
    icon: <BookOpen className="w-4 h-4" />,
    blurb: 'Learn a main line with arrows, then drill it from memory to earn stars.'
  },
  {
    id: 'endgames',
    label: 'Endgames',
    icon: <Crown className="w-4 h-4" />,
    blurb: 'Convert classic endgames against the engine — mate, promote or hold the draw.'
  },
  {
    id: 'analysis',
    label: 'Analysis board',
    icon: <Microscope className="w-4 h-4" />,
    blurb: 'Play both sides freely, load any FEN or PGN, and see live engine lines.'
  }
];

/** Training hub: opening trainer, endgame drills and a free analysis board. */
export const TrainView: React.FC = () => {
  const { theme } = useAppTheme();
  const [section, setSection] = useState<TrainSection>('openings');
  const active = SECTIONS.find(s => s.id === section) ?? SECTIONS[0];

  return (
    <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-3 sm:px-6 py-5 flex flex-col gap-5">
      <div
        className="rounded-xl p-5 flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4"
        style={{ backgroundColor: theme.cardHex, border: `1px solid ${theme.cardBorderHex}` }}
      >
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div
            className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center"
            style={{ backgroundColor: `${theme.accentHex}1f`, color: theme.accentHex }}
          >
            <GraduationCap className="w-5 h-5" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h1 className="font-display text-xl sm:text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight" style={{ color: theme.textPrimary }}>
              Training
            </h1>
            <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm" style={{ color: theme.textSecondary }}>
              {active.blurb}
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

        {SECTIONS.length > 1 && (
          <div
            role="tablist"
            aria-label="Training sections"
            className="flex p-1 rounded-xl self-start sm:self-auto"
            style={{ backgroundColor: theme.cardSecondaryHex, border: `1px solid ${theme.cardBorderHex}` }}
          >
            {SECTIONS.map(s => {
              const isActive = s.id === section;
              return (
                <button
                  key={s.id}
                  type="button"
                  role="tab"
                  aria-selected={isActive}
                  onClick={() => setSection(s.id)}

                </button>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {section === 'openings' && <OpeningTrainer />}
      {section === 'endgames' && <EndgameDrills />}
      {section === 'analysis' && <AnalysisBoard />}
    </div>
  );
};

const stripParenthetical = (name: string) => name.replace(/\s*\([^)]*\)/g, '').trim();

export const VariantsView: React.FC<VariantsViewProps> = ({

  const [studioSeedConfig, setStudioSeedConfig] = useState<CustomVariantConfig | null>(initialCustomConfig);

  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState<string>('');
  const [activeModalVariant, setActiveModalVariant] = useState<VariantDefinition | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {

    }

    const matchesQuery =
      v.name.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()) ||
      v.description.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()) ||
      v.tagline.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase());

      grid: Array.from({ length: 8 }, (_, r) =>
        Array.from({ length: 8 }, (_, c) => {

          if (r === 7 && c === 4) return { type: 'k', color: 'w' };
          return null;
        })
      ),
      rules: {
        pawnDoubleStep: true,
        enPassant: false,
        castling: false,
        mandatoryCaptures: false,
        atomicExplosions: false,
        allowDuckPlacement: false,
        promotionPiece: 'q',
        winConditions: {
          checkmate: true,
          centerHill: false,
          racingKings: false,
          bareKing: false,
          threeCheck: false
        }
      },
      customPiecesUsed: ['k'],
      createdAt: new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]
    });
    setActiveSubTab('custom');

          style={{
            backgroundColor: theme.cardSecondaryHex,
            borderColor: theme.cardBorderHex
          }}

<file path="src/context/ThemeContext.tsx">
import React, { createContext, useContext } from 'react';
import { AppThemeConfig, BoardThemeConfig, getAppTheme, resolveBoardTheme } from '../theme/themes';
import { PieceSetId, KingFinialStyle, UserSettings } from '../types/chess';

interface ThemeContextType {
  theme: AppThemeConfig;
  boardTheme: BoardThemeConfig;
  pieceSet: PieceSetId;
  kingFinial: KingFinialStyle;
  settings: UserSettings;
}

const defaultSettings: UserSettings = {
  appTheme: 'emerald_studio',
  colorMode: 'dark',
  boardTheme: 'emerald',
  matchBoardToPieces: true,
  customBoards: [],
  pieceSet: 'neo',
  kingFinial: 'crescent',
  soundEnabled: true,
  soundVolume: 0.6,
  hapticsEnabled: true,
  batterySaver: false,
  evalBarPosition: 'left',
  boardSize: 100,
  showLiveEval: true,
  showCoordinates: 'inside',
  showBestMoveArrow: true,
  autoQueen: true,
  moveInputMethod: 'both',
  keyboardControl: false,
  notationInput: false,
  autoFlipLocal2P: false,
  premoveMode: 'infinite',
  aiThinkingMode: 'human',
  highlightLegalMoves: true,
  engineMaxDepth: 16,
  syncVaultId: 'gm-vault-8812',
  e2eeEnabled: true,
};

const defaultContext: ThemeContextType = {
  theme: getAppTheme('emerald_studio', 'dark'),
  boardTheme: resolveBoardTheme(defaultSettings),
  pieceSet: 'neo',
  kingFinial: 'crescent',
  settings: defaultSettings
};

export const ThemeContext = createContext<ThemeContextType>(defaultContext);

export const useAppTheme = () => useContext(ThemeContext);

export const ThemeProvider: React.FC<{
  settings: UserSettings;
  children: React.ReactNode;
}> = ({ settings, children }) => {
  const theme = getAppTheme(settings.appTheme || 'emerald_studio', settings.colorMode || 'dark');
  const boardTheme = resolveBoardTheme(settings);
  const pieceSet = settings.pieceSet || 'neo';
  const kingFinial: KingFinialStyle = settings.kingFinial || 'crescent';

  return (
    <ThemeContext.Provider value={{ theme, boardTheme, pieceSet, kingFinial, settings }}>
      {children}
    </ThemeContext.Provider>
  );
};

<file path="src/engine/achievements.ts">
import { GameHistoryItem, MoveAnalysis, UserProfile } from '../types/chess';
import { MASTERY_TARGET, OPENING_REPERTOIRE, OpeningProgress, loadOpeningProgress } from './openingRepertoire';
import { DrillProgress, ENDGAME_DRILLS, loadDrillProgress } from './endgameDrills';

/**
 * Achievements are derived from data the app already stores (games, profile stats and
 * training progress), so nothing needs special tracking and past activity counts.
 */

export type AchievementCategory = 'Games' | 'Puzzles' | 'Training';

export interface AchievementContext {
  profile: UserProfile;
  /** Games played in the app (imports excluded). */
  playedGames: GameHistoryItem[];
  importedGames: GameHistoryItem[];
  openingProgress: Record<string, OpeningProgress>;
  drillProgress: Record<string, DrillProgress>;
}

export interface AchievementDef {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  description: string;
  icon: string;
  category: AchievementCategory;
  progress: (ctx: AchievementContext) => { current: number; target: number };
}

const isWin = (g: GameHistoryItem) =>
  (g.result === '1-0' && g.playerColor === 'w') || (g.result === '0-1' && g.playerColor === 'b');

/** The player's own analysed moves (white moves first from the standard start). */
const playerMoves = (g: GameHistoryItem): MoveAnalysis[] =>
  (g.analyzedMoves || []).filter((_, i) => (i % 2 === 0 ? 'w' : 'b') === g.playerColor);

const count = (n: number, target: number) => ({ current: Math.min(n, target), target });
const flag = (ok: boolean) => ({ current: ok ? 1 : 0, target: 1 });

export function buildAchievementContext(profile: UserProfile, matches: GameHistoryItem[]): AchievementContext {
  return {
    profile,
    playedGames: matches.filter(g => !g.id.startsWith('import-')),
    importedGames: matches.filter(g => g.id.startsWith('import-')),
    openingProgress: loadOpeningProgress(),
    drillProgress: loadDrillProgress()
  };
}

export interface AchievementStatus {
  def: AchievementDef;
  current: number;
  target: number;
  unlocked: boolean;
  unlockedOn?: string;
}

export function evaluateAchievements(ctx: AchievementContext, unlockDates: Record<string, string>): AchievementStatus[] {
  return ACHIEVEMENTS.map(def => {
    const { current, target } = def.progress(ctx);
    const unlocked = current >= target;
    return { def, current, target, unlocked, unlockedOn: unlocked ? unlockDates[def.id] : undefined };
  });
}

// ---- Persistence of unlock dates ----

export { PROGRESS_EVENT } from './progressEvents';
export const ACHIEVEMENTS_KEY = 'gm_achievements_unlocked';

export function loadUnlockDates(): Record<string, string> | null {
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(ACHIEVEMENTS_KEY);
    return raw ? (JSON.parse(raw) as Record<string, string>) : null;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

export function saveUnlockDates(dates: Record<string, string>) {
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(ACHIEVEMENTS_KEY, JSON.stringify(dates));
  } catch {
    // storage unavailable
  }
}

test('Initial chess board evaluation is approximately equal (near 0)', () => {
  const chess = new Chess();
  const evalScore = evaluateBoard(chess);
  // Both sides have symmetric material and PSTs, slight mobility difference may exist
  assert.ok(Math.abs(evalScore) < 50, `Initial eval score should be close to 0, was ${evalScore}`);
});

test('Minimax detects checkmate in 1', () => {
  // Scholar's mate setup: White queen at f3, bishop at c4, black king at e8. Move Qf7#
  const chess = new Chess('r1bqkb1r/pppp1ppp/2n5/4p3/2B1n3/5Q2/PPPP1PPP/RNB1K1NR w KQkq - 0 1');
  const result = minimax(chess, 2, -Infinity, Infinity, true);
  assert.ok(result.bestMove, 'Should find a move');
  assert.equal(result.bestMove?.from, 'f3');
  assert.equal(result.bestMove?.to, 'f7');
});

});

test('15 classic + 15 signature boards, 10 app themes (dark & light), and 15 piece sets are configured', async () => {
  const {
    ALL_15_BOARD_THEMES,
    APP_THEME_FAMILIES,
    SIGNATURE_BOARDS,
    ALL_15_PIECE_SETS,
    getBoardTheme,
    getAppTheme,
    signatureBoardFor,
    normalizeThemeSettings
  } = await import('../theme/themes');
  
  // Verify 15 Boards
  assert.equal(ALL_15_BOARD_THEMES.length, 15, 'Should have exactly 15 board themes');
  const boardIds = new Set(ALL_15_BOARD_THEMES.map(b => b.id));
  assert.equal(boardIds.size, 15, 'All 15 board IDs must be unique');
  for (const b of ALL_15_BOARD_THEMES) {
    assert.ok(b.name && b.name.length > 0);
    assert.ok(b.darkHex && b.darkHex.length > 0);
    assert.ok(b.lightHex && b.lightHex.length > 0);
    assert.equal(getBoardTheme(b.id).name, b.name);
  }

  // Verify 10 App Themes, each with a dark and a light mode
  assert.equal(APP_THEME_FAMILIES.length, 10, 'Should have exactly 10 app themes');
  const themeIds = new Set(APP_THEME_FAMILIES.map(t => t.id));
  assert.equal(themeIds.size, 10, 'All 10 app theme IDs must be unique');
  for (const f of APP_THEME_FAMILIES) {
    assert.ok(f.name && f.name.length > 0);
    for (const mode of ['dark', 'light'] as const) {
      const t = getAppTheme(f.id, mode);
      assert.equal(t.mode, mode);
      assert.equal(t.name, f.name);
      assert.match(t.accentHex, /^#[0-9a-f]{6}$/i, 'accentHex must be 6-digit hex (alpha suffixes are appended)');
      assert.ok(t.bgHex && t.bgGradient);
    }
  }

  // Every piece style has a framed signature board
  assert.equal(SIGNATURE_BOARDS.length, 15, 'Should have one signature board per piece style');
  for (const p of ALL_15_PIECE_SETS) {
    const sig = signatureBoardFor(p.id);
    assert.equal(sig.pieceSet, p.id);
    assert.ok(sig.frame, `${p.id} signature board needs a frame`);
  }

  // Legacy single-mode theme ids migrate to a family + mode
  const migrated = normalizeThemeSettings({ appTheme: 'rose_light' } as unknown as Partial<import('../types/chess').UserSettings>);
  assert.equal(migrated.appTheme, 'ink_vermilion');
  assert.equal(migrated.colorMode, 'light');

  // Replaced v2 families migrate without touching the chosen mode
  const replaced = normalizeThemeSettings({ appTheme: 'deep_ocean', colorMode: 'light' } as unknown as Partial<import('../types/chess').UserSettings>);
  assert.equal(replaced.appTheme, 'coral_reef');
  assert.equal(replaced.colorMode, 'light');

  // Verify 15 Piece Sets
  assert.equal(ALL_15_PIECE_SETS.length, 15, 'Should have exactly 15 piece styles');
  const pieceIds = new Set(ALL_15_PIECE_SETS.map(p => p.id));
  assert.equal(pieceIds.size, 15, 'All 15 piece set IDs must be unique');
  for (const p of ALL_15_PIECE_SETS) {
    assert.ok(p.name && p.name.length > 0);
    assert.ok(p.tagline && p.tagline.length > 0);
    assert.ok(p.icon && p.icon.length > 0);
  }
});

test('Custom Variant Engine correctly handles fairy pieces, custom sizes, and bare king victory', async () => {
  const {
    getPieceMoves,
    executeCustomMove,
    getAllLegalMoves,
    evaluateCustomBoard,
    DEFAULT_CUSTOM_PRESETS
  } = await import('./customVariantEngine');

  // 1. Elephant (Gaja / Alfil) leaps exactly 2 squares diagonally over any piece
  const grid: (import('../types/chess').CustomBoardSquare | null)[][] = Array.from({ length: 8 }, () => Array.from({ length: 8 }, () => null));
  grid[4][4] = { type: 'e', color: 'w' };
  // Put a piece right next to the elephant (at 3, 3) to test jumping over
  grid[3][3] = { type: 'p', color: 'w' };

  const elephantMoves = getPieceMoves(grid, 4, 4, {
    pawnDoubleStep: false,
    enPassant: false,
    castling: false,
    mandatoryCaptures: false,
    atomicExplosions: false,
    allowDuckPlacement: false,
    winConditions: { checkmate: true, centerHill: false, racingKings: false, bareKing: true, threeCheck: false }
  }, null);

  // An Elephant at (4,4) should leap to (2,2), (2,6), (6,2), (6,6) even jumping over (3,3)!
  const targetSquares = elephantMoves.map(m => `${m.toRow},${m.toCol}`);
  assert.ok(targetSquares.includes('2,2'), 'Elephant leaps over piece at (3,3) to (2,2)');
  assert.ok(targetSquares.includes('2,6'), 'Elephant leaps to (2,6)');
  assert.ok(targetSquares.includes('6,2'), 'Elephant leaps to (6,2)');
  assert.ok(targetSquares.includes('6,6'), 'Elephant leaps to (6,6)');
  assert.equal(elephantMoves.length, 4, 'Elephant on open board has exactly 4 diagonal leaps');

  // 2. Ferz / Mantri moves 1 square diagonally
  grid[4][4] = { type: 'f', color: 'w' };
  const ferzMoves = getPieceMoves(grid, 4, 4, {
    pawnDoubleStep: false,
    enPassant: false,
    castling: false,
    mandatoryCaptures: false,
    atomicExplosions: false,
    allowDuckPlacement: false,
    winConditions: { checkmate: true, centerHill: false, racingKings: false, bareKing: true, threeCheck: false }
  }, null);
  // (3,3) has a friendly pawn, so Ferz can move to (3,5), (5,3), (5,5)
  assert.equal(ferzMoves.length, 3, 'Ferz moves 1 diagonal step');

  // 3. Chancellor (Rook + Knight compound)
  grid[4][4] = { type: 'c', color: 'w' };
  const chancellorMoves = getPieceMoves(grid, 4, 4, {
    pawnDoubleStep: false,
    enPassant: false,
    castling: false,
    mandatoryCaptures: false,
    atomicExplosions: false,
    allowDuckPlacement: false,
    winConditions: { checkmate: true, centerHill: false, racingKings: false, bareKing: false, threeCheck: false }
  }, null);
  // Should have orthogonal moves + knight hops
  assert.ok(chancellorMoves.some(m => m.toRow === 4 && m.toCol === 0), 'Chancellor moves like Rook');
  assert.ok(chancellorMoves.some(m => m.toRow === 2 && m.toCol === 5), 'Chancellor jumps like Knight');

  // 4. Bare King Victory test
  const bareKingPreset = DEFAULT_CUSTOM_PRESETS[0]; // Chaturanga
  const customGrid: (import('../types/chess').CustomBoardSquare | null)[][] = Array.from({ length: 8 }, () => Array.from({ length: 8 }, () => null));
  const customState = {
    config: bareKingPreset,
    grid: customGrid,
    turn: 'w' as const,
    moveNumber: 1,
    history: [],
    duckPos: null,
    whiteChecks: 0,
    blackChecks: 0,
    winner: null
  };
  // White has King and Rook, Black has King and 1 Pawn
  customState.grid[7][4] = { type: 'k', color: 'w' };
  customState.grid[7][0] = { type: 'r', color: 'w' };
  customState.grid[0][4] = { type: 'k', color: 'b' };
  customState.grid[1][0] = { type: 'p', color: 'b' };

  // Rook captures the last Black pawn
  const captureMove = {
    fromRow: 7,
    fromCol: 0,
    toRow: 1,
    toCol: 0,
    piece: { type: 'r' as const, color: 'w' as const },
    captured: { type: 'p' as const, color: 'b' as const },
    san: 'Rxa7'
  };
  const afterCap = executeCustomMove(customState, captureMove);
  assert.equal(afterCap.winner, 'w', 'White wins by baring the Black King');
  assert.ok(afterCap.winReason?.includes('bared the opponent King'));
});

test('variantToCustomConfig produces authentic Chaturanga setup and enforces check legality', async () => {
  const {
    variantToCustomConfig,
    getAllLegalMoves,
    executeCustomMove
  } = await import('./customVariantEngine');

  const chaturangaConfig = variantToCustomConfig('chaturanga');
  assert.equal(chaturangaConfig.boardWidth, 8);
  assert.equal(chaturangaConfig.boardHeight, 8);
  assert.equal(chaturangaConfig.rules.pawnDoubleStep, false);
  assert.equal(chaturangaConfig.rules.castling, false);
  assert.equal(chaturangaConfig.rules.promotionPiece, 'f');
  assert.equal(chaturangaConfig.rules.winConditions.bareKing, true);

  // Verify White back rank has Gaja (e) on c1/f1, Raja (k) on d1, and Mantri (f) on e1
  assert.equal(chaturangaConfig.grid[7][2]?.type, 'e');
  assert.equal(chaturangaConfig.grid[7][3]?.type, 'k');
  assert.equal(chaturangaConfig.grid[7][4]?.type, 'f');
  assert.equal(chaturangaConfig.grid[7][5]?.type, 'e');

  const game = {
    config: chaturangaConfig,
    grid: chaturangaConfig.grid.map(row => row.map(sq => (sq ? { ...sq } : null))),
    turn: 'w' as const,
    moveNumber: 1,
    history: [],
    duckPos: null,
    whiteChecks: 0,
    blackChecks: 0,
    winner: null
  };
  const openingMoves = getAllLegalMoves(game);
  // 8 pawns x 1 step (no double step) + 2 knights x 2 hops + 2 Gajas x 2 diagonal leaps over pawns = 16
  assert.equal(openingMoves.length, 16, 'Chaturanga opening has 16 legal moves (single pawn steps + knight hops + Gaja leaps)');

  // Verify self-check is filtered and back-rank checkmate ends the game
  const emptyGrid: (import('../types/chess').CustomBoardSquare | null)[][] = Array.from({ length: 8 }, () =>
    Array.from({ length: 8 }, () => null)
  );
  emptyGrid[0][7] = { type: 'k', color: 'b' };
  emptyGrid[1][6] = { type: 'p', color: 'b' };
  emptyGrid[1][7] = { type: 'p', color: 'b' };
  emptyGrid[7][4] = { type: 'k', color: 'w' };
  emptyGrid[2][0] = { type: 'r', color: 'w' };

  const mateSetup = {
    config: chaturangaConfig,
    grid: emptyGrid,
    turn: 'w' as const,
    moveNumber: 10,
    history: [],
    duckPos: null,
    whiteChecks: 0,
    blackChecks: 0,
    winner: null
  };

  const mateMove = {
    fromRow: 2,
    fromCol: 0,
    toRow: 0,
    toCol: 0,
    piece: { type: 'r' as const, color: 'w' as const },
    san: 'Ra8'
  };
  const afterMate = executeCustomMove(mateSetup, mateMove);
  assert.equal(afterMate.winner, 'w', 'Back-rank rook mate awards victory in customVariantEngine');
  assert.ok(afterMate.winReason?.includes('Checkmate'));
});

test('All 1000+ puzzles in PUZZLE_DATABASE have valid FENs and 100% legal UCI move sequences', () => {
  assert.ok(PUZZLE_DATABASE.length >= 1000, `Expected at least 1000 puzzles, found ${PUZZLE_DATABASE.length}`);
  const seenIds = new Set<string>();

  for (const puzzle of PUZZLE_DATABASE) {
    assert.ok(!seenIds.has(puzzle.id), `Duplicate puzzle ID: ${puzzle.id}`);
    seenIds.add(puzzle.id);

    const game = new Chess(puzzle.fen);
    assert.equal(game.turn(), puzzle.playerColor, `Turn mismatch for puzzle ${puzzle.id}`);
    assert.ok(puzzle.moves.length >= 1, `Puzzle ${puzzle.id} must have moves`);

    for (let i = 0; i < puzzle.moves.length; i++) {
      const uci = puzzle.moves[i];
      const from = uci.slice(0, 2);
      const to = uci.slice(2, 4);
      const promotion = uci.length > 4 ? uci[4] : undefined;
      const move = game.move({ from, to, promotion });
      assert.ok(move, `Illegal move ${uci} at step ${i} in puzzle ${puzzle.id} (FEN: ${puzzle.fen})`);
    }
  }
});

test('Puzzle filtering, search query, daily fallback, and Puzzle Rush ordering work accurately', () => {
  assert.equal(normalizePuzzleCategory('Pin & Skewer'), 'Pins & Skewers');
  assert.equal(normalizePuzzleCategory('Greek Gift'), 'Sacrifices & Attack');

  const forkPuzzle = getFilteredPuzzle(1000, 'Forks & Outposts', 'all', []);

test('computeHumanThinkDelayMs scales naturally by time control, low-clock scramble, and forcingness', () => {

  const complexMid = new Chess('r1bq1rk1/pp2bppp/2n1pn2/2pp4/3P4/2NBPN2/PP3PPP/R1BQ1RK1 w - - 0 9');
  const forcedOnlyKing = new Chess('7k/5Q2/6K1/8/8/8/8/8 b - - 0 1'); // Only one or two legal moves (Kg8)

  const rapidDelay = computeHumanThinkDelayMs(complexMid, bot, 600, 580, 0.5);
  const blitzDelay = computeHumanThinkDelayMs(complexMid, bot, 180, 170, 0.5);
  const bulletDelay = computeHumanThinkDelayMs(complexMid, bot, 60, 55, 0.5);
  const scrambleDelay = computeHumanThinkDelayMs(complexMid, bot, 600, 8, 0.5);
  const forcedDelay = computeHumanThinkDelayMs(forcedOnlyKing, bot, 600, 580, 0.5);

  assert.ok(rapidDelay > blitzDelay, `Rapid (${rapidDelay}ms) should exceed Blitz (${blitzDelay}ms)`);
  assert.ok(blitzDelay > bulletDelay, `Blitz (${blitzDelay}ms) should exceed Bullet (${bulletDelay}ms)`);
  assert.ok(scrambleDelay <= 720 && scrambleDelay >= 220, `Scramble (${scrambleDelay}ms) should stay brisk`);
  assert.ok(forcedDelay < rapidDelay, `Forced reply (${forcedDelay}ms) should be quicker than complex middlegame (${rapidDelay}ms)`);
});

<file path="src/engine/chessEngine.ts">
import { Chess, Square, PieceSymbol, Color, Move } from 'chess.js';
import { MoveClassification, MoveAnalysis } from '../types/chess';

export const MIN_AI_ELO = 100;
export const MAX_AI_ELO = 3600;

// Piece values in centipawns
export const PIECE_VALUES: Record<PieceSymbol, number> = {
  p: 100,
  n: 320,
  b: 330,
  r: 500,
  q: 900,
  k: 20000
};

const PIECE_NAMES: Record<PieceSymbol, string> = {
  p: 'pawn',
  n: 'knight',
  b: 'bishop',
  r: 'rook',
  q: 'queen',
  k: 'king'
};

// Piece Square Tables (From White's perspective, index 0 is a8, 63 is h1)
const PAWN_TABLE = [
   0,  0,  0,  0,  0,  0,  0,  0,
  50, 50, 50, 50, 50, 50, 50, 50,
  10, 10, 20, 30, 30, 20, 10, 10,
   5,  5, 10, 25, 25, 10,  5,  5,
   0,  0,  0, 20, 20,  0,  0,  0,
   5, -5,-10,  0,  0,-10, -5,  5,
   5, 10, 10,-20,-20, 10, 10,  5,
   0,  0,  0,  0,  0,  0,  0,  0
];

const KNIGHT_TABLE = [
 -50,-40,-30,-30,-30,-30,-40,-50,
 -40,-20,  0,  0,  0,  0,-20,-40,
 -30,  0, 10, 15, 15, 10,  0,-30,
 -30,  5, 15, 20, 20, 15,  5,-30,
 -30,  0, 15, 20, 20, 15,  0,-30,
 -30,  5, 10, 15, 15, 10,  5,-30,
 -40,-20,  0,  5,  5,  0,-20,-40,
 -50,-40,-30,-30,-30,-30,-40,-50
];

const BISHOP_TABLE = [
 -20,-10,-10,-10,-10,-10,-10,-20,
 -10,  0,  0,  0,  0,  0,  0,-10,
 -10,  0,  5, 10, 10,  5,  0,-10,
 -10,  5,  5, 10, 10,  5,  5,-10,
 -10,  0, 10, 10, 10, 10,  0,-10,
 -10, 10, 10, 10, 10, 10, 10,-10,
 -10,  5,  0,  0,  0,  0,  5,-10,
 -20,-10,-10,-10,-10,-10,-10,-20
];

const ROOK_TABLE = [
   0,  0,  0,  0,  0,  0,  0,  0,
   5, 10, 10, 10, 10, 10, 10,  5,
  -5,  0,  0,  0,  0,  0,  0, -5,
  -5,  0,  0,  0,  0,  0,  0, -5,
  -5,  0,  0,  0,  0,  0,  0, -5,
  -5,  0,  0,  0,  0,  0,  0, -5,
  -5,  0,  0,  0,  0,  0,  0, -5,
   0,  0,  0,  5,  5,  0,  0,  0
];

const QUEEN_TABLE = [
 -20,-10,-10, -5, -5,-10,-10,-20,
 -10,  0,  0,  0,  0,  0,  0,-10,
 -10,  0,  5,  5,  5,  5,  0,-10,
  -5,  0,  5,  5,  5,  5,  0, -5,
   0,  0,  5,  5,  5,  5,  0, -5,
 -10,  5,  5,  5,  5,  5,  0,-10,
 -10,  0,  5,  0,  0,  0,  0,-10,
 -20,-10,-10, -5, -5,-10,-10,-20
];

const KING_MIDGAME_TABLE = [
 -30,-40,-40,-50,-50,-40,-40,-30,
 -30,-40,-40,-50,-50,-40,-40,-30,
 -30,-40,-40,-50,-50,-40,-40,-30,
 -30,-40,-40,-50,-50,-40,-40,-30,
 -20,-30,-30,-40,-40,-30,-30,-20,
 -10,-20,-20,-20,-20,-20,-20,-10,
  20, 20,  0,  0,  0,  0, 20, 20,
  20, 30, 10,  0,  0, 10, 30, 20
];

const KING_ENDGAME_TABLE = [
 -50,-40,-30,-20,-20,-30,-40,-50,
 -30,-20,-10,  0,  0,-10,-20,-30,
 -30,-10, 20, 30, 30, 20,-10,-30,
 -30,-10, 30, 40, 40, 30,-10,-30,
 -30,-10, 30, 40, 40, 30,-10,-30,
 -30,-10, 20, 30, 30, 20,-10,-30,
 -30,-30,  0,  0,  0,  0,-30,-30,
 -50,-30,-30,-30,-30,-30,-30,-50
];

function getSquareIndex(square: Square, color: Color): number {
  const file = square.charCodeAt(0) - 97; // a=0, h=7
  const rank = parseInt(square[1], 10) - 1; // 1=0, 8=7
  if (color === 'w') {
    return (7 - rank) * 8 + file;
  } else {
    return rank * 8 + file;
  }
}

/**
 * Static positional evaluation of a position from White's perspective in centipawns.
 * Incorporates material, PSTs, bishop pair, pawn structure (doubled, isolated, passed),
 * and rook open/semi-open file activity.
 */
export function evaluateBoard(chess: Chess): number {
  if (chess.isCheckmate()) {
    return chess.turn() === 'w' ? -20000 : 20000;
  }
  if (chess.isDraw() || chess.isStalemate() || chess.isThreefoldRepetition() || chess.isInsufficientMaterial()) {
    return 0;
  }

  let whiteMaterial = 0;
  let blackMaterial = 0;
  let whitePst = 0;
  let blackPst = 0;
  let whiteBishops = 0;
  let blackBishops = 0;

  const whitePawnsPerFile = [0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0];
  const blackPawnsPerFile = [0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0];
  const whitePawnRanks: { r: number; c: number }[] = [];
  const blackPawnRanks: { r: number; c: number }[] = [];
  const whiteRooks: number[] = [];
  const blackRooks: number[] = [];

  const board = chess.board();

  let totalNonPawns = 0;
  for (let r = 0; r < 8; r++) {
    for (let c = 0; c < 8; c++) {
      const p = board[r][c];
      if (p && p.type !== 'p' && p.type !== 'k') {
        totalNonPawns++;
      }
    }
  }
  const isEndgame = totalNonPawns <= 4;

  for (let r = 0; r < 8; r++) {
    for (let c = 0; c < 8; c++) {
      const piece = board[r][c];
      if (!piece) continue;

      const val = PIECE_VALUES[piece.type];
      const sq = (String.fromCharCode(97 + c) + (8 - r)) as Square;
      const idx = getSquareIndex(sq, piece.color);

      let pstBonus = 0;
      switch (piece.type) {
        case 'p':
          pstBonus = PAWN_TABLE[idx];
          if (piece.color === 'w') {
            whitePawnsPerFile[c]++;
            whitePawnRanks.push({ r, c });
          } else {
            blackPawnsPerFile[c]++;
            blackPawnRanks.push({ r, c });
          }
          break;
        case 'n':
          pstBonus = KNIGHT_TABLE[idx];
          break;
        case 'b':
          pstBonus = BISHOP_TABLE[idx];
          if (piece.color === 'w') whiteBishops++;
          else blackBishops++;
          break;
        case 'r':
          pstBonus = ROOK_TABLE[idx];
          if (piece.color === 'w') whiteRooks.push(c);
          else blackRooks.push(c);
          break;
        case 'q':
          pstBonus = QUEEN_TABLE[idx];
          break;
        case 'k':
          pstBonus = isEndgame ? KING_ENDGAME_TABLE[idx] : KING_MIDGAME_TABLE[idx];
          break;
      }

      if (piece.color === 'w') {
        whiteMaterial += val;
        whitePst += pstBonus;
      } else {
        blackMaterial += val;
        blackPst += pstBonus;
      }
    }
  }

  let positionalScore = 0;

  // Bishop pair advantage
  if (whiteBishops >= 2) positionalScore += 35;
  if (blackBishops >= 2) positionalScore -= 35;

  // Doubled & isolated pawn structure penalties
  for (let f = 0; f < 8; f++) {
    if (whitePawnsPerFile[f] > 1) positionalScore -= 14 * (whitePawnsPerFile[f] - 1);
    if (blackPawnsPerFile[f] > 1) positionalScore += 14 * (blackPawnsPerFile[f] - 1);

    if (whitePawnsPerFile[f] > 0) {
      const hasLeft = f > 0 && whitePawnsPerFile[f - 1] > 0;
      const hasRight = f < 7 && whitePawnsPerFile[f + 1] > 0;
      if (!hasLeft && !hasRight) positionalScore -= 12 * whitePawnsPerFile[f];
    }
    if (blackPawnsPerFile[f] > 0) {
      const hasLeft = f > 0 && blackPawnsPerFile[f - 1] > 0;
      const hasRight = f < 7 && blackPawnsPerFile[f + 1] > 0;
      if (!hasLeft && !hasRight) positionalScore += 12 * blackPawnsPerFile[f];
    }
  }

  // Passed pawn bonus (row 0 = rank 8, row 7 = rank 1)
  const passedBonusByAdvancement = [0, 12, 18, 28, 44, 68, 95, 0];
  for (const wp of whitePawnRanks) {
    let isPassed = true;
    for (const bp of blackPawnRanks) {
      if (Math.abs(bp.c - wp.c) <= 1 && bp.r < wp.r) {
        isPassed = false;
        break;
      }
    }
    if (isPassed) {
      const advancement = 7 - wp.r;
      positionalScore += passedBonusByAdvancement[advancement] || 20;
    }
  }
  for (const bp of blackPawnRanks) {
    let isPassed = true;
    for (const wp of whitePawnRanks) {
      if (Math.abs(wp.c - bp.c) <= 1 && wp.r > bp.r) {
        isPassed = false;
        break;
      }
    }
    if (isPassed) {
      const advancement = bp.r;
      positionalScore -= passedBonusByAdvancement[advancement] || 20;
    }
  }

  // Rooks on open / semi-open files
  for (const file of whiteRooks) {
    if (whitePawnsPerFile[file] === 0) {
      positionalScore += blackPawnsPerFile[file] === 0 ? 22 : 12;
    }
  }
  for (const file of blackRooks) {
    if (blackPawnsPerFile[file] === 0) {
      positionalScore -= whitePawnsPerFile[file] === 0 ? 22 : 12;
    }
  }

  // Mobility bonus (mild, normalized by turn)
  const currentTurn = chess.turn();
  const legalMoves = chess.moves().length;
  const tempo = currentTurn === 'w' ? 10 : -10;
  const mobility = (legalMoves - 20) * 1.5 * (currentTurn === 'w' ? 1 : -1);

  return (whiteMaterial - blackMaterial) + (whitePst - blackPst) + positionalScore + tempo + mobility;
}

/**
 * Quiescence search to avoid horizon effect on sharp tactical captures (Negamax perspective)
 */
function quiescence(chess: Chess, alpha: number, beta: number, depthLeft: number): number {
  if (chess.isCheckmate()) return -19000;
  if (chess.isDraw() || chess.isStalemate() || chess.isThreefoldRepetition() || chess.isInsufficientMaterial()) {
    return 0;
  }

  const standPat = chess.turn() === 'w' ? evaluateBoard(chess) : -evaluateBoard(chess);

  if (depthLeft <= 0) return standPat;
  if (standPat >= beta) return beta;
  if (alpha < standPat) alpha = standPat;

  const captureMoves = chess.moves({ verbose: true }).filter(m => m.captured);
  captureMoves.sort((a, b) => {
    const valA = (a.captured ? PIECE_VALUES[a.captured] : 0) * 10 - PIECE_VALUES[a.piece];
    const valB = (b.captured ? PIECE_VALUES[b.captured] : 0) * 10 - PIECE_VALUES[b.piece];
    return valB - valA;
  });

  for (const move of captureMoves) {
    chess.move(move);
    const score = -quiescence(chess, -beta, -alpha, depthLeft - 1);
    chess.undo();

    if (score >= beta) return beta;
    if (score > alpha) alpha = score;
  }
  return alpha;
}

function orderMoves(moves: Move[], preferredMoveSan?: string): Move[] {
  return [...moves].sort((a, b) => {
    let scoreA = 0;
    let scoreB = 0;
    if (preferredMoveSan) {
      if (a.san === preferredMoveSan) scoreA += 50000;
      if (b.san === preferredMoveSan) scoreB += 50000;
    }
    if (a.captured) scoreA += 1000 + PIECE_VALUES[a.captured] * 10 - PIECE_VALUES[a.piece];
    if (b.captured) scoreB += 1000 + PIECE_VALUES[b.captured] * 10 - PIECE_VALUES[b.piece];
    if (a.promotion) scoreA += 850 + PIECE_VALUES[a.promotion];
    if (b.promotion) scoreB += 850 + PIECE_VALUES[b.promotion];
    if (a.san.includes('+')) scoreA += 300;
    if (b.san.includes('+')) scoreB += 300;
    if (a.flags.includes('k') || a.flags.includes('q')) scoreA += 90;
    if (b.flags.includes('k') || b.flags.includes('q')) scoreB += 90;
    return scoreB - scoreA;
  });
}

/**
 * Minimax with Alpha-Beta pruning and optional search deadline
 */
export function minimax(
  chess: Chess,
  depth: number,
  alpha: number,
  beta: number,
  isMaximizingTurn: boolean,
  nodesCount = { count: 0 },
  deadlineMs?: number,
  quiescenceDepth = 3,
  preferredRootSan?: string
): { score: number; bestMove?: Move; timedOut?: boolean } {
  nodesCount.count++;

  if (deadlineMs && nodesCount.count % 128 === 0 && Date.now() >= deadlineMs) {
    const evalNow = evaluateBoard(chess);
    return { score: evalNow, timedOut: true };
  }

  if (chess.isGameOver()) {
    if (chess.isCheckmate()) {
      return { score: isMaximizingTurn ? -19000 - depth : 19000 + depth };
    }
    return { score: 0 };
  }

  if (depth <= 0) {
    if (isMaximizingTurn) {
      return { score: quiescence(chess, alpha, beta, quiescenceDepth) };
    }
    return { score: -quiescence(chess, -beta, -alpha, quiescenceDepth) };
  }

  const rawMoves = chess.moves({ verbose: true });
  if (rawMoves.length === 0) return { score: 0 };

  const moves = orderMoves(rawMoves, preferredRootSan);
  let bestMove: Move = moves[0];

  if (isMaximizingTurn) {
    let maxEval = -Infinity;
    for (const move of moves) {
      chess.move(move);
      const child = minimax(chess, depth - 1, alpha, beta, false, nodesCount, deadlineMs, quiescenceDepth);
      chess.undo();

      if (child.timedOut) {
        return { score: maxEval === -Infinity ? evaluateBoard(chess) : maxEval, bestMove, timedOut: true };
      }

      if (child.score > maxEval) {
        maxEval = child.score;
        bestMove = move;
      }
      alpha = Math.max(alpha, child.score);
      if (beta <= alpha) break;
    }
    return { score: maxEval, bestMove };
  } else {
    let minEval = Infinity;
    for (const move of moves) {
      chess.move(move);
      const child = minimax(chess, depth - 1, alpha, beta, true, nodesCount, deadlineMs, quiescenceDepth);
      chess.undo();

      if (child.timedOut) {
        return { score: minEval === Infinity ? evaluateBoard(chess) : minEval, bestMove, timedOut: true };
      }

      if (child.score < minEval) {
        minEval = child.score;
        bestMove = move;
      }
      beta = Math.min(beta, child.score);
      if (beta <= alpha) break;
    }
    return { score: minEval, bestMove };
  }
}

/**
 * Time-bounded Iterative Deepening search for maximum local strength without locking UI.
 */
export function iterativeDeepeningSearch(
  chess: Chess,
  maxDepth: number,
  timeLimitMs = 700,
  quiescenceDepth = 4
): { score: number; bestMove?: Move; completedDepth: number; nodes: number } {
  const isMaximizing = chess.turn() === 'w';
  const deadlineMs = Date.now() + timeLimitMs;
  const nodesCount = { count: 0 };

  let completedDepth = 0;
  let bestResult: { score: number; bestMove?: Move } = minimax(
    chess,
    1,
    -Infinity,
    Infinity,
    isMaximizing,
    nodesCount,
    undefined,
    quiescenceDepth
  );
  completedDepth = 1;

  for (let d = 2; d <= maxDepth; d++) {
    if (Date.now() >= deadlineMs) break;
    const candidate = minimax(
      chess,
      d,
      -Infinity,
      Infinity,
      isMaximizing,
      nodesCount,
      deadlineMs,
      quiescenceDepth,
      bestResult.bestMove?.san
    );
    if (!candidate.timedOut && candidate.bestMove) {
      bestResult = candidate;
      completedDepth = d;
    } else {
      break;
    }
  }

  return {
    score: bestResult.score,
    bestMove: bestResult.bestMove,
    completedDepth,
    nodes: nodesCount.count
  };
}

/**
 * Calculate win chance (0 to 100) from White's perspective given centipawns score
 */
export function winChanceFromCp(cp: number): number {
  if (cp >= 15000) return 100;
  if (cp <= -15000) return 0;
  return Math.round(50 + 50 * (2 / (1 + Math.exp(-0.00368208 * cp)) - 1));
}

/**
 * Format evaluation centipawn for display (e.g. +1.4, -0.8, +M2, -M3)
 */
export function formatEvaluation(cp: number): string {
  if (cp >= 15000) {
    const mateMoves = Math.ceil((20000 - cp) / 2);
    return `+M${Math.max(1, mateMoves)}`;
  }
  if (cp <= -15000) {
    const mateMoves = Math.ceil((20000 + cp) / 2);
    return `-M${Math.max(1, mateMoves)}`;
  }
  const pawns = cp / 100;
  return pawns > 0 ? `+${pawns.toFixed(1)}` : pawns.toFixed(1);
}

/**
 * Move Classification logic for post-game and real-time game review
 */
export function classifyMove(
  evalBefore: number,
  evalAfter: number,
  turn: Color,
  isBestMove: boolean,
  isCaptureSacrifice: boolean
): MoveClassification {
  const delta = turn === 'w' ? (evalAfter - evalBefore) : (evalBefore - evalAfter);

  if (isBestMove) {
    if (isCaptureSacrifice && delta >= -30) {
      return 'brilliant';
    }
    return 'best';
  }

  if (isCaptureSacrifice && delta >= -40) {
    return 'brilliant';
  }

  if (delta >= -15) return 'great';
  if (delta >= -40) return 'excellent';
  if (delta >= -90) return 'good';
  if (delta >= -180) return 'inaccuracy';
  if (delta >= -320) return 'mistake';

  const wasDecisive = turn === 'w' ? evalBefore > 300 : evalBefore < -300;
  const isLostOrDrawn = turn === 'w' ? evalAfter < 100 : evalAfter > -100;
  if (wasDecisive && isLostOrDrawn) {
    return 'missed_win';
  }

  return 'blunder';
}

export function calculateSingleMoveAccuracy(
  evalBefore: number,
  evalAfter: number,
  turn: Color,
  isBestMove: boolean,
  classification: MoveClassification
): number {
  if (classification === 'brilliant' || classification === 'book') return 100.0;
  if (classification === 'best' || isBestMove) return 98.5;

  const winBefore = turn === 'w' ? winChanceFromCp(evalBefore) : 100 - winChanceFromCp(evalBefore);
  const winAfter = turn === 'w' ? winChanceFromCp(evalAfter) : 100 - winChanceFromCp(evalAfter);
  const winDrop = Math.max(0, winBefore - winAfter);

  // Chess.com-inspired exponential decay from win-probability loss
  const raw = 103.1668 * Math.exp(-0.04354 * winDrop) - 3.1668;
  const clamped = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, raw));

  if (classification === 'great') return Math.max(94.0, Math.round(clamped * 10) / 10);
  if (classification === 'excellent') return Math.max(87.0, Math.round(clamped * 10) / 10);
  if (classification === 'good') return Math.max(72.0, Math.min(91.0, Math.round(clamped * 10) / 10));
  if (classification === 'inaccuracy') return Math.min(72.0, Math.max(48.0, Math.round(clamped * 10) / 10));
  if (classification === 'mistake') return Math.min(48.0, Math.max(22.0, Math.round(clamped * 10) / 10));
  if (classification === 'missed_win') return Math.min(42.0, Math.max(18.0, Math.round(clamped * 10) / 10));
  return Math.min(22.0, Math.max(2.0, Math.round(clamped * 10) / 10));
}

/**
 * Calculate real accuracy (0-100%) from analyzed moves for White or Black
 */
export function calculateAccuracyFromMoves(moves: MoveAnalysis[], color: Color): number {
  const weights: Record<MoveClassification, number> = {
    brilliant: 100,
    great: 97,
    best: 98.5,
    excellent: 92,
    book: 98,
    good: 83,
    inaccuracy: 64,
    mistake: 40,
    missed_win: 34,
    blunder: 12
  };

  const playerMoves = moves.filter((_, idx) => (color === 'w' ? idx % 2 === 0 : idx % 2 === 1));
  if (playerMoves.length === 0) return 90.0;

  const total = playerMoves.reduce(
    (sum, m) => sum + (typeof m.moveAccuracy === 'number' ? m.moveAccuracy : weights[m.classification] ?? 80),
    0
  );
  return Math.round((total / playerMoves.length) * 10) / 10;
}

/**
 * Create a calibrated custom AI opponent profile for any rating from 100 to 3600 (Max local strength).
 */
export function createCustomBotProfile(requestedElo: number): BotProfile {
  const elo = Math.max(MIN_AI_ELO, Math.min(MAX_AI_ELO, Math.round(requestedElo)));

  let depth = 1;
  let blunderRate = 0;
  let tierLabel = 'Novice';
  let timeLimitMs: number | undefined;
  let quiescenceDepth = 3;

  if (elo < 250) {
    depth = 1;
    blunderRate = 0.78;
    tierLabel = 'Beginner';
  } else if (elo < 500) {
    depth = 1;
    blunderRate = 0.52;
    tierLabel = 'Novice';
  } else if (elo < 850) {
    depth = 2;
    blunderRate = 0.34;
    tierLabel = 'Casual';
  } else if (elo < 1200) {
    depth = 2;
    blunderRate = 0.20;
    tierLabel = 'Club';
  } else if (elo < 1600) {
    depth = 3;
    blunderRate = 0.10;
    tierLabel = 'Intermediate';
  } else if (elo < 2000) {
    depth = 4;
    blunderRate = 0.04;
    tierLabel = 'Expert';
  } else if (elo < 2500) {
    depth = 4;
    blunderRate = 0;
    timeLimitMs = 350;
    tierLabel = 'Master';
  } else if (elo < 3100) {
    depth = 5;
    blunderRate = 0;
    timeLimitMs = 520;
    quiescenceDepth = 4;
    tierLabel = 'Grandmaster';
  } else {
    depth = 7;
    blunderRate = 0;
    timeLimitMs = 750;
    quiescenceDepth = 4;
    tierLabel = 'Apex Core';
  }

  return {
    id: 'custom_elo',
    name: `Custom · ${tierLabel}`,
    title: 'Custom Challenger',
    accentHex: '#10b981',
    avatar: 'AI',
    elo,
    depth,
    blunderRate,
    timeLimitMs,
    quiescenceDepth,
    isCustom: true,
    description:
      elo >= 3200
        ? 'Peak local engine using iterative deepening up to depth 7 and extended quiescence search.'
        : elo <= 300
        ? 'Entry-level trainer calibrated to simulate 100–300 Elo tactical oversights.'
        : `Calibrated ${elo} Elo opponent balancing search depth ${depth} and natural precision.`
  };
}

/**
 * Compute the best AI move for the given bot profile
 */
export function getAIMove(chess: Chess, bot: BotProfile): Move | null {
  const moves = chess.moves({ verbose: true });
  if (moves.length === 0) return null;

  // Calibrated error simulation for sub-master bots
  if (bot.blunderRate > 0 && Math.random() < bot.blunderRate && moves.length > 1) {
    // At very low Elo (<300), pick heavily suboptimal or random moves; around 800-1400 pick from top half
    const isVeryWeak = bot.elo < 350;
    if (isVeryWeak) {
      const randomIdx = Math.floor(Math.random() * moves.length);
      return moves[randomIdx];
    }
    const isMax = chess.turn() === 'w';
    const scored = moves.map(m => {
      chess.move(m);
      const val = evaluateBoard(chess);
      chess.undo();
      return { move: m, val };
    });
    scored.sort((a, b) => (isMax ? b.val - a.val : a.val - b.val));
    const poolEnd = Math.min(scored.length, Math.max(2, Math.ceil(scored.length * 0.45)));
    const pickIdx = Math.floor(Math.random() * poolEnd);
    return scored[pickIdx].move;
  }

  // Bounded iterative deepening for all depth >= 2 bots so search stays responsive and never stalls premoves
  if (bot.depth >= 2 || bot.timeLimitMs) {
    const budgetMs =
      bot.timeLimitMs ??
      (bot.depth === 2 ? 150 : bot.depth === 3 ? 240 : bot.depth === 4 ? 340 : 600);
    const result = iterativeDeepeningSearch(
      chess,
      bot.depth,
      budgetMs,
      bot.quiescenceDepth || 3
    );
    return result.bestMove || moves[0];
  }

  const isMaximizing = chess.turn() === 'w';
  const result = minimax(chess, bot.depth, -Infinity, Infinity, isMaximizing);
  return result.bestMove || moves[0];
}

/**
 * Estimate a realistic human-like think duration (in ms) for an AI move based on
 * time control, remaining bot clock scramble, game phase, forcingness, and position complexity.
 */
export function computeHumanThinkDelayMs(
  chess: Chess,
  bot: BotProfile,
  initialTimeSec = 600,
  botRemainingSec = 600,
  jitterSample = Math.random()
): number {
  const moves = chess.moves({ verbose: true });
  const clampedJitter = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, jitterSample));
  if (moves.length <= 1) {
    return Math.round(240 + clampedJitter * 160);
  }

  const isBullet = initialTimeSec <= 120;
  const isBlitz = !isBullet && initialTimeSec <= 300;
  const scrambleThreshold = isBullet ? 12 : 20;

  if (botRemainingSec <= scrambleThreshold) {
    const scrambleRatio = Math.max(0.2, botRemainingSec / scrambleThreshold);
    return Math.round(
      Math.max(220, Math.min(720, (240 + scrambleRatio * 360) * (0.85 + clampedJitter * 0.35)))
    );
  }

  let baseMs = isBullet ? 580 : isBlitz ? 1150 : 1650;
  const maxMs = isBullet ? 1350 : isBlitz ? 2500 : 4200;

  const history = chess.history({ verbose: true });
  if (history.length <= 6) {
    baseMs *= 0.58;
  }

  const lastMove = history.length > 0 ? history[history.length - 1] : null;
  if (lastMove?.captured && moves.some(m => m.to === lastMove.to && m.captured)) {
    baseMs *= 0.65;
  }

  if (moves.length <= 4) {
    baseMs *= 0.55;
  } else if (chess.inCheck()) {
    baseMs *= 1.18;
  } else if (moves.length >= 30) {
    baseMs *= 1.28;
  }

  const eloPace = bot.elo < 700 ? 0.8 : bot.elo >= 1800 ? 1.12 : 1.0;
  baseMs *= eloPace;

  const jittered = baseMs * (0.78 + clampedJitter * 0.46);
  return Math.round(Math.max(240, Math.min(maxMs, jittered)));
}

export interface EngineLine {
  san: string;
  from: Square;
  to: Square;
  promotion?: string;
  pvSan: string[];
  scoreCp: number;
  formattedEval: string;
  reasons: string[];
}

const CENTER_SQUARES = new Set<string>(['d4', 'e4', 'd5', 'e5']);
const EXTENDED_CENTER = new Set<string>(['c3', 'c4', 'c5', 'c6', 'd3', 'd6', 'e3', 'e6', 'f3', 'f4', 'f5', 'f6']);

/**
 * DecodeChess-style plain-English tactical & positional explanation for a move.
 */
export function decodeMoveReasons(chessBefore: Chess, move: Move, scoreCp?: number): string[] {
  const reasons: string[] = [];
  const sim = new Chess(chessBefore.fen());
  const executed = sim.move(move);
  if (!executed) return ['Improves piece coordination and board presence.'];

  if (sim.isCheckmate()) {
    reasons.push('Delivers immediate checkmate against the enemy king.');
    return reasons;
  }

  if (sim.inCheck()) {
    reasons.push('Delivers check, forcing the opponent into a defensive response.');
  }

  if (executed.flags.includes('k') || executed.flags.includes('q')) {
    reasons.push('Castles to safeguard the king and activate the corner rook.');
  }

  if (executed.promotion) {
    reasons.push(`Promotes a pawn into a ${PIECE_NAMES[executed.promotion as PieceSymbol] || 'queen'} for decisive material gain.`);
  }

  if (executed.captured) {
    const capturedName = PIECE_NAMES[executed.captured];
    const moverName = PIECE_NAMES[executed.piece];
    const valDiff = PIECE_VALUES[executed.captured] - PIECE_VALUES[executed.piece];
    if (valDiff > 50) {
      reasons.push(`Wins a higher-value ${capturedName} (+${(valDiff / 100).toFixed(1)} net material trade).`);
    } else if (valDiff === 0) {
      reasons.push(`Initiates a balanced ${moverName}-for-${capturedName} exchange to simplify.`);
    } else {
      reasons.push(`Removes an active ${capturedName} defending key lines.`);
    }
  }

  if (CENTER_SQUARES.has(executed.to)) {
    reasons.push(`Seizes direct control over central square ${executed.to}.`);
  } else if (EXTENDED_CENTER.has(executed.to) && (executed.piece === 'n' || executed.piece === 'b')) {
    reasons.push(`Develops ${PIECE_NAMES[executed.piece]} toward an active central outpost on ${executed.to}.`);
  }

  // Passed pawn advancement check
  if (executed.piece === 'p') {
    const rank = parseInt(executed.to[1], 10);
    if ((executed.color === 'w' && rank >= 6) || (executed.color === 'b' && rank <= 3)) {
      reasons.push(`Advances pawn deep to ${executed.to}, creating dangerous promotion threats.`);
    }
  }

  // Check if the moved piece attacks high-value enemy pieces
  const attackers = sim.moves({ verbose: true }).filter(m => m.from === executed.to && m.captured);
  if (attackers.length >= 2) {
    reasons.push('Creates simultaneous pressure against multiple enemy targets.');
  }

  if (reasons.length === 0) {
    if (typeof scoreCp === 'number') {
      const sideWinning = executed.color === 'w' ? scoreCp > 120 : scoreCp < -120;
      reasons.push(
        sideWinning
          ? 'Consolidates an existing advantage and restricts enemy counterplay.'
          : 'Improves piece harmony and prepares future pawn breaks.'
      );
    } else {
      reasons.push('Improves piece harmony and maintains structural flexibility.');
    }
  }

  return reasons.slice(0, 3);
}

/**
 * Compute top N candidate lines with PV continuation & plain-English move decoding.
 */
export function analyzeTopLines(
  chess: Chess,
  depth = 3,
  count = 3,
  timeLimitMs = 600
): EngineLine[] {
  const legalMoves = orderMoves(chess.moves({ verbose: true }));
  if (legalMoves.length === 0) return [];

  const isMaximizing = chess.turn() === 'w';
  const deadline = Date.now() + timeLimitMs;

  // Stage 1: Fast static + capture screening over ALL legal moves (~8ms total)
  const quickScreened = legalMoves.map(move => {
    const sim = new Chess(chess.fen());
    sim.move(move);
    if (sim.isCheckmate()) {
      return { move, scoreCp: isMaximizing ? 20000 : -20000, isMate: true };
    }
    const res = minimax(sim, 0, -Infinity, Infinity, !isMaximizing, { count: 0 }, undefined, 1);
    return { move, scoreCp: res.score, isMate: false };
  });

  quickScreened.sort((a, b) => (isMaximizing ? b.scoreCp - a.scoreCp : a.scoreCp - b.scoreCp));

  // Stage 2: Deepen top candidates within time budget
  const candidateSlice = quickScreened.slice(0, Math.min(8, quickScreened.length));
  const deepResults: { move: Move; scoreCp: number }[] = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < candidateSlice.length; i++) {
    const item = candidateSlice[i];
    if (item.isMate) {
      deepResults.push({ move: item.move, scoreCp: item.scoreCp });
      continue;
    }

    if (i >= count && Date.now() >= deadline) {
      deepResults.push({ move: item.move, scoreCp: item.scoreCp });
      continue;
    }

    const sim = new Chess(chess.fen());
    sim.move(item.move);
    const searchDepth = Math.max(1, depth - 1);
    const res = minimax(sim, searchDepth, -Infinity, Infinity, !isMaximizing, { count: 0 }, deadline, 3);
    deepResults.push({
      move: item.move,
      scoreCp: res.timedOut ? item.scoreCp : res.score
    });
  }

  deepResults.sort((a, b) => (isMaximizing ? b.scoreCp - a.scoreCp : a.scoreCp - b.scoreCp));

  return deepResults.slice(0, count).map(entry => {
    const pvSan: string[] = [entry.move.san];
    const pvBoard = new Chess(chess.fen());
    pvBoard.move(entry.move);
    for (let ply = 0; ply < 2; ply++) {
      if (pvBoard.isGameOver()) break;
      const follow = minimax(pvBoard, 2, -Infinity, Infinity, pvBoard.turn() === 'w', { count: 0 }, Date.now() + 100, 2);
      if (!follow.bestMove) break;
      pvSan.push(follow.bestMove.san);
      pvBoard.move(follow.bestMove);
    }

    return {
      san: entry.move.san,
      from: entry.move.from,
      to: entry.move.to,
      promotion: entry.move.promotion,
      pvSan,
      scoreCp: entry.scoreCp,
      formattedEval: formatEvaluation(entry.scoreCp),
      reasons: decodeMoveReasons(chess, entry.move, entry.scoreCp)
    };
  });
}

/**
 * Detect undefended or under-defended non-king pieces currently threatened by the opponent.
 */
export function getThreatenedSquares(chess: Chess, targetColor: Color = chess.turn()): Square[] {
  const oppColor: Color = targetColor === 'w' ? 'b' : 'w';
  const board = chess.board();
  const threatened: Square[] = [];

  for (let r = 0; r < 8; r++) {
    for (let c = 0; c < 8; c++) {
      const piece = board[r][c];
      if (!piece || piece.color !== targetColor || piece.type === 'k') continue;
      const sq = `${String.fromCharCode(97 + c)}${8 - r}` as Square;
      const enemyAttackers = chess.attackers(sq, oppColor);
      if (enemyAttackers.length === 0) continue;

      const defenders = chess.attackers(sq, targetColor);
      if (defenders.length === 0) {
        threatened.push(sq);
        continue;
      }

      const lowestAttackerVal = Math.min(
        ...enemyAttackers.map(atkSq => {
          const atkPiece = chess.get(atkSq);
          return atkPiece ? PIECE_VALUES[atkPiece.type] : 9999;
        })
      );
      if (lowestAttackerVal < PIECE_VALUES[piece.type]) {
        threatened.push(sq);
      }
    }
  }

  return threatened;
}

export interface MoveQualityAnalysis {
  classification: MoveClassification;
  evalBefore: number;
  evalAfter: number;
  moveAccuracy: number;
  bestMoveSan: string;
  bestMoveFrom: Square;
  bestMoveTo: Square;
  pvSan: string[];
  commentary: string;
  isSacrifice: boolean;
}

/**
 * Evaluate the quality of a specific move played from `chessBefore` with fast bounded search.
 * Catches tactical blunders (hanging pieces, mate threats), best/great/brilliant finds,
 * and produces a best-move refutation + PV line + plain-English explanation.
 */
export function analyzeMoveInPosition(
  chessBefore: Chess,
  executedMove: Move,
  budgetMs = 45,
  plyIndex = 99
): MoveQualityAnalysis {
  const turn = executedMove.color;
  const isMax = turn === 'w';
  const deadline = Date.now() + budgetMs;

  // 1. Evaluate position BEFORE move using bounded depth-2 search for best baseline & second-best comparison
  const legalBefore = orderMoves(chessBefore.moves({ verbose: true }));
  let bestMoveObj = executedMove;
  let bestScore = isMax ? -Infinity : Infinity;
  let secondBestScore = isMax ? -Infinity : Infinity;

  if (legalBefore.length > 0) {
    const topSlice = legalBefore.slice(0, Math.min(10, legalBefore.length));
    // Ensure executedMove is included in evaluation slice
    if (!topSlice.some(m => m.from === executedMove.from && m.to === executedMove.to && m.promotion === executedMove.promotion)) {
      topSlice.push(executedMove);
    }

    const candidateScores: { move: Move; score: number }[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < topSlice.length; i++) {
      const m = topSlice[i];
      const sim = new Chess(chessBefore.fen());
      sim.move(m);
      let s: number;
      if (sim.isCheckmate()) {
        s = isMax ? 20000 : -20000;
      } else if (sim.isDraw()) {
        s = 0;
      } else {
        const useDepth = i < 5 && Date.now() < deadline ? 1 : 0;
        const res = minimax(sim, useDepth, -Infinity, Infinity, !isMax, { count: 0 }, deadline, 2);
        s = res.score;
      }
      candidateScores.push({ move: m, score: s });
    }

    candidateScores.sort((a, b) => (isMax ? b.score - a.score : a.score - b.score));
    bestMoveObj = candidateScores[0].move;
    bestScore = candidateScores[0].score;
    secondBestScore = candidateScores.length > 1 ? candidateScores[1].score : bestScore;
  } else {
    bestScore = evaluateBoard(chessBefore);
    secondBestScore = bestScore;
  }

  // 2. Evaluate resulting position AFTER executedMove (depth 1 + quiescence 2 catches hanging pieces & mates)
  const chessAfter = new Chess(chessBefore.fen());
  chessAfter.move({
    from: executedMove.from,
    to: executedMove.to,
    promotion: executedMove.promotion
  });

  let evalAfter: number;
  if (chessAfter.isCheckmate()) {
    evalAfter = isMax ? 20000 : -20000;
  } else if (chessAfter.isDraw() || chessAfter.isStalemate()) {
    evalAfter = 0;
  } else {
    const afterRes = minimax(
      chessAfter,
      1,
      -Infinity,
      Infinity,
      !isMax,
      { count: 0 },
      Date.now() + Math.max(20, Math.floor(budgetMs * 0.6)),
      2
    );
    evalAfter = afterRes.score;
  }

  return buildMoveQuality(
    chessBefore,
    executedMove,
    {
      bestMove: bestMoveObj,
      bestScore: Number.isFinite(bestScore) ? bestScore : evaluateBoard(chessBefore),
      secondBestScore: Number.isFinite(secondBestScore) ? secondBestScore : bestScore,
      evalAfter,
      legalMoveCount: legalBefore.length
    },
    plyIndex
  );
}

/** Engine scores for a played move, from any search (built-in minimax or Stockfish). Scores are White-perspective centipawns. */
export interface MoveQualityInputs {
  bestMove: Move;
  bestScore: number;
  secondBestScore: number;
  evalAfter: number;
  legalMoveCount: number;
  /** Principal variation starting with the best move; computed with a quick search when omitted. */
  pvSan?: string[];
}

/**
 * Turn engine scores into a graded move: classification, accuracy, best-move PV and commentary.
 */
export function buildMoveQuality(
  chessBefore: Chess,
  executedMove: Move,
  inputs: MoveQualityInputs,
  plyIndex = 99
): MoveQualityAnalysis {
  const turn = executedMove.color;
  const isMax = turn === 'w';
  const { bestMove: bestMoveObj, bestScore, secondBestScore, evalAfter, legalMoveCount } = inputs;
  const chessAfter = new Chess(chessBefore.fen());
  chessAfter.move({
    from: executedMove.from,
    to: executedMove.to,
    promotion: executedMove.promotion
  });

  const evalBefore = bestScore;
  const delta = isMax ? evalAfter - evalBefore : evalBefore - evalAfter;

  const isBestMove =
    executedMove.from === bestMoveObj.from &&
    executedMove.to === bestMoveObj.to &&
    (executedMove.promotion || undefined) === (bestMoveObj.promotion || undefined);

  // Detect real tactical sacrifice (captures lower-value piece OR lands on square attacked by enemy with value > pawn)
  const oppColor: Color = turn === 'w' ? 'b' : 'w';
  const movedValue = PIECE_VALUES[executedMove.piece];
  const capturedValue = executedMove.captured ? PIECE_VALUES[executedMove.captured] : 0;
  const isRiskyLanding =
    movedValue >= 320 &&
    chessAfter.attackers(executedMove.to, oppColor).length > chessAfter.attackers(executedMove.to, turn).length;
  const isCaptureSacrifice =
    (Boolean(executedMove.captured) && movedValue > capturedValue + 100) || isRiskyLanding;

  const alreadyCrushing = isMax ? evalBefore > 700 : evalBefore < -700;
  const onlyGoodMoveGap = isMax ? bestScore - secondBestScore : secondBestScore - bestScore;

  let classification: MoveClassification;
  if (plyIndex < 6 && delta >= -30 && !isCaptureSacrifice) {
    classification = 'book';
  } else if (isCaptureSacrifice && delta >= -45 && !alreadyCrushing) {
    classification = 'brilliant';
  } else if (isBestMove && onlyGoodMoveGap >= 115 && legalMoveCount >= 3) {
    classification = 'great';
  } else if (isBestMove || delta >= -10) {
    classification = 'best';
  } else {
    classification = classifyMove(evalBefore, evalAfter, turn, false, false);
  }

  const moveAccuracy = calculateSingleMoveAccuracy(
    evalBefore,
    evalAfter,
    turn,
    isBestMove,
    classification
  );

  // 3. Build 2-3 ply PV continuation from best move (supplied by the caller's search when available)
  const pvSan: string[] = inputs.pvSan && inputs.pvSan.length > 0 ? inputs.pvSan.slice(0, 3) : [bestMoveObj.san];
  if (!inputs.pvSan || inputs.pvSan.length === 0) {
    const pvCursor = new Chess(chessBefore.fen());
    pvCursor.move(bestMoveObj);
    for (let p = 0; p < 2; p++) {
      if (pvCursor.isGameOver()) break;
      const reply = minimax(pvCursor, 1, -Infinity, Infinity, pvCursor.turn() === 'w', { count: 0 }, Date.now() + 18, 1);
      if (!reply.bestMove) break;
      pvSan.push(reply.bestMove.san);
      pvCursor.move(reply.bestMove);
    }
  }

  // 4. Plain-English commentary explaining played move vs best move
  const playedReasons = decodeMoveReasons(chessBefore, executedMove, evalAfter);
  const bestReasons = isBestMove ? playedReasons : decodeMoveReasons(chessBefore, bestMoveObj, evalBefore);

  let commentary: string;
  if (classification === 'brilliant') {
    commentary = `Brilliant sacrifice! ${executedMove.san} creates decisive pressure. ${playedReasons[0] || ''}`.trim();
  } else if (classification === 'great') {
    commentary = `Great find — ${executedMove.san} was the only move keeping full control. ${playedReasons[0] || ''}`.trim();
  } else if (classification === 'best' || classification === 'book') {
    commentary = `${executedMove.san} is ${classification === 'book' ? 'sound opening theory' : 'the top engine choice'}. ${playedReasons[0] || ''}`.trim();
  } else if (classification === 'excellent' || classification === 'good') {
    commentary = `${executedMove.san} maintains a solid position${!isBestMove ? `, though ${bestMoveObj.san} was slightly sharper` : ''}. ${playedReasons[0] || ''}`.trim();
  } else if (classification === 'inaccuracy') {
    commentary = `Inaccuracy: ${executedMove.san} concedes slight momentum (${formatEvaluation(evalBefore)} → ${formatEvaluation(evalAfter)}). ${bestMoveObj.san} was stronger: ${bestReasons[0] || 'improves piece coordination.'}`;
  } else if (classification === 'missed_win') {
    commentary = `Missed win! ${bestMoveObj.san} converted the decisive advantage (${pvSan.join(' ')}).`;
  } else {
    commentary = `${classification === 'blunder' ? 'Blunder' : 'Mistake'}: ${executedMove.san} drops the evaluation (${formatEvaluation(evalBefore)} → ${formatEvaluation(evalAfter)}). Best was ${bestMoveObj.san}: ${bestReasons[0] || 'defends key squares.'}`;
  }

  return {
    classification,
    evalBefore,
    evalAfter,
    moveAccuracy,
    bestMoveSan: bestMoveObj.san,
    bestMoveFrom: bestMoveObj.from,
    bestMoveTo: bestMoveObj.to,
    pvSan,
    commentary,
    isSacrifice: isCaptureSacrifice
  };
}

/**
 * Enrich or compute full per-move analysis across a completed game's move list.
 */
export function analyzeCompletedGame(
  moves: MoveAnalysis[],
  startFen?: string
): MoveAnalysis[] {
  const board = startFen ? new Chess(startFen) : new Chess();
  const enriched: MoveAnalysis[] = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < moves.length; i++) {
    const item = moves[i];
    const alreadyRich =
      typeof item.moveAccuracy === 'number' &&
      Boolean(item.bestMoveSan) &&
      Boolean(item.commentary) &&
      Array.isArray(item.pvSan) &&
      item.pvSan.length > 0;

    let played: Move | null = null;
    try {
      played = board.move({ from: item.from, to: item.to });
    } catch {
      try {
        played = board.move(item.san);
      } catch {
        played = null;
      }
    }

    if (!played) {
      enriched.push(item);
      continue;
    }

    if (alreadyRich) {
      enriched.push(item);
      continue;
    }

    board.undo();
    const q = analyzeMoveInPosition(board, played, 28, i);
    board.move(played);

    enriched.push({
      ...item,
      classification: item.classification === 'book' && i < 8 ? 'book' : q.classification,
      evalBefore: q.evalBefore,
      evalAfter: q.evalAfter,
      moveAccuracy: item.classification === 'book' && i < 8 ? 100 : q.moveAccuracy,
      bestMoveSan: q.bestMoveSan,
      bestMoveFrom: q.bestMoveFrom,
      bestMoveTo: q.bestMoveTo,
      pvSan: q.pvSan,
      commentary: q.commentary
    });
  }

  return enriched;
}

/**
 * Compute Opening / Middlegame / Endgame phase accuracies for a player.
 */
export function computeGamePhaseAccuracy(
  moves: MoveAnalysis[],
  color: Color
): { opening: number | null; middlegame: number | null; endgame: number | null } {
  const playerPlies = moves
    .map((m, idx) => ({ m, idx }))
    .filter(item => (color === 'w' ? item.idx % 2 === 0 : item.idx % 2 === 1));

  const avg = (list: typeof playerPlies): number | null => {
    if (list.length === 0) return null;
    const sum = list.reduce(
      (acc, { m }) =>
        acc +
        (typeof m.moveAccuracy === 'number'
          ? m.moveAccuracy
          : calculateSingleMoveAccuracy(m.evalBefore, m.evalAfter, color, m.classification === 'best', m.classification)),
      0
    );
    return Math.round((sum / list.length) * 10) / 10;
  };

  return {
    opening: avg(playerPlies.filter(p => p.idx < 16)),
    middlegame: avg(playerPlies.filter(p => p.idx >= 16 && p.idx < 48)),
    endgame: avg(playerPlies.filter(p => p.idx >= 48))
  };
}

/**
 * Chess.com-style single-game Performance Rating ("Game Rating") estimate.
 */
export function estimatePerformanceElo(
  accuracy: number,
  opponentElo: number,
  resultScore: 1 | 0.5 | 0
): number {
  const baseOpp = opponentElo > 0 ? opponentElo : 1200;
  const accDelta = (accuracy - 75) * 18;
  const resultBonus = resultScore === 1 ? 140 : resultScore === 0.5 ? 0 : -110;
  const raw = Math.round((baseOpp + accDelta + resultBonus) / 25) * 25;
  return Math.max(200, Math.min(3400, raw));
}
