export interface BoardFrameParts {
  corners?: boolean;
  edges?: boolean;
  sides?: boolean;
  studs?: boolean;
}

export interface BoardFrameConfig {
  /** Which ornament set the frame draws (see components/BoardFrame.tsx). */
  ornament: BoardOrnamentKind | 'none';
  /** Hide individual ornament groups (all shown by default). */
  parts?: BoardFrameParts;
  /** Show the inset filigree line in the band (default on). */
  bandLine?: boolean;
  /** Animate every ornament group, not just the set's defaults. */
  animateAll?: boolean;
  /** CSS background for the frame band (gradients / patterns). */
  plating: string;
  /** Outer rim colour. */
  rim: string;
  /** Thin line framing the squares. */
  innerLine: string;
  /** Ornament palette. */
  primary: string;
  secondary: string;
  accent: string;
  /** Optional outer glow colour. */
  glow?: string;
  /** Band thickness as % of board width. */
  thickness?: number;
  /** Corner radius in px. */
  radius?: number;
  /** Ornament animation flavour. */
  motion?: 'pulse' | 'twinkle' | 'shimmer' | 'flicker';
  /** Render the band with a frosted backdrop blur. */
  frosted?: boolean;
}

}

/** Best-effort conversion of any CSS colour we use (hex / rgb / rgba) to #rrggbb. */
export function toHex(color: string | undefined, fallback = '#888888'): string {
  if (!color) return fallback;
  const c = color.trim();
  if (/^#[0-9a-f]{6}$/i.test(c)) return c.toLowerCase();
  if (/^#[0-9a-f]{8}$/i.test(c)) return c.slice(0, 7).toLowerCase();
  if (/^#[0-9a-f]{3}$/i.test(c)) return `#${c[1]}${c[1]}${c[2]}${c[2]}${c[3]}${c[3]}`.toLowerCase();
  const m = c.match(/rgba?\(\s*([\d.]+)\s*,\s*([\d.]+)\s*,\s*([\d.]+)/i);
  if (m) {
    return `#${[m[1], m[2], m[3]].map(v => Math.round(Number(v)).toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('')}`;
  }
  return fallback;
}

export function withAlpha(hex: string, alpha: number): string {
  const h = toHex(hex);
  const r = parseInt(h.slice(1, 3), 16);
  const g = parseInt(h.slice(3, 5), 16);
  const b = parseInt(h.slice(5, 7), 16);
  return `rgba(${r}, ${g}, ${b}, ${alpha})`;
}

/** Turns an editor recipe into a renderable board. */
export function buildCustomBoard(r: CustomBoardRecipe): BoardThemeConfig {
  const texture = TEXTURE_PRESETS.find(t => t.id === r.texture);
  const preset = PLATING_PRESETS.find(p => p.id === r.plating);
  const plating =
    r.plating === 'none'
      ? null
      : r.plating === 'custom' || !preset
        ? { plating: `linear-gradient(135deg, ${r.plateA} 0%, ${r.plateB} 50%, ${r.plateA} 100%)`, frosted: false }
        : { plating: preset.plating, frosted: preset.frosted };

  return {
    id: r.id,
    name: r.name || 'Custom board',
    description: 'Built in the Board Editor',
    lightHex: r.lightHex,
    darkHex: r.darkHex,
    selectedHex: withAlpha(r.selectedHex, 0.8),
    lastMoveHex: withAlpha(r.lastMoveHex, 0.5),
    coordDark: r.lightHex,
    coordLight: r.darkHex,
    squareTexture: texture && texture.id !== 'none' ? { dark: texture.dark, light: texture.light } : undefined,
    frame: plating
      ? {
          ornament: r.ornament,
          plating: plating.plating,
          frosted: plating.frosted,
          rim: r.rim,
          innerLine: r.innerLine,
          primary: r.primary,
          secondary: r.secondary,
          accent: r.accent,
          glow: r.glow ? withAlpha(r.glowColor, 0.45) : undefined,
          thickness: r.thickness,
          radius: r.radius,
          motion: r.motion === 'none' ? undefined : r.motion,
          animateAll: true,
          bandLine: r.bandLine,
          parts: { corners: r.showCorners, edges: r.showEdges, sides: r.showSides, studs: r.showStuds }
        }
      : undefined
  };
}

/** Seeds an editor recipe from any existing board so it can be remixed. */
export function recipeFromBoard(board: BoardThemeConfig, id: CustomBoardRecipe['id'], name: string): CustomBoardRecipe {
  const f = board.frame;
  const texture = TEXTURE_PRESETS.find(t => t.id !== 'none' && t.dark && t.dark === board.squareTexture?.dark);
  const plating = f ? PLATING_PRESETS.find(p => p.plating === f.plating)?.id || 'custom' : 'none';
  return {
    id,
    name,
    lightHex: toHex(board.lightHex, '#eeeeee'),
    darkHex: toHex(board.darkHex, '#777777'),
    selectedHex: toHex(board.selectedHex, '#facc15'),
    lastMoveHex: toHex(board.lastMoveHex, '#fde047'),
    texture: texture?.id || 'none',
    plating,
    plateA: toHex(f?.rim, '#3b2a12'),
    plateB: toHex(f?.primary, '#c8941a'),
    rim: toHex(f?.rim, '#111111'),
    innerLine: toHex(f?.innerLine, '#d4af37'),
    ornament: f?.ornament || 'none',
    primary: toHex(f?.primary, '#ffe08a'),
    secondary: toHex(f?.secondary, '#8a5a0b'),
    accent: toHex(f?.accent, '#c81d3a'),
    showCorners: f?.parts?.corners !== false,
    showEdges: f?.parts?.edges !== false,
    showSides: f?.parts?.sides !== false,
    showStuds: f?.parts?.studs !== false,
    bandLine: f?.bandLine !== false,
    glow: Boolean(f?.glow),
    glowColor: toHex(f?.glow, '#f5d17a'),
    motion: f?.motion || 'none',
    thickness: f?.thickness ?? 5,
    radius: f?.radius ?? 10
  };
}

export function getBoardTheme(id: BoardThemeId, customBoards: CustomBoardRecipe[] = []): BoardThemeConfig {
  if (typeof id === 'string' && id.startsWith('custom_')) {
    const recipe = customBoards.find(c => c.id === id);
    if (recipe) return buildCustomBoard(recipe);
  }
  return ALL_BOARD_THEMES.find(t => t.id === id) || ALL_15_BOARD_THEMES[0];
}

export function signatureBoardFor(pieceSet: PieceSetId): BoardThemeConfig {
  return getBoardTheme(`sig_${pieceSet}` as SignatureBoardId);
}

/** The board actually shown: the piece style's signature board when matching is on. */
export function resolveBoardTheme(
  settings: Pick<UserSettings, 'boardTheme' | 'matchBoardToPieces' | 'pieceSet'> & { customBoards?: CustomBoardRecipe[] },
  pieceSetOverride?: PieceSetId
): BoardThemeConfig {
  if (settings.matchBoardToPieces !== false) {
    return signatureBoardFor(pieceSetOverride || settings.pieceSet || 'neo');
  }
  return getBoardTheme(settings.boardTheme || 'emerald', settings.customBoards || []);
}

/** Legacy single-mode theme ids map onto a family + mode. */
const LEGACY_APP_THEMES: Record<string, { id: AppThemeId; mode?: ColorMode }> = {
  // v1 single-mode themes
  midnight_dark: { id: 'emerald_studio', mode: 'dark' },
  oled_dark: { id: 'carbon_volt', mode: 'dark' },
  cyber_dark: { id: 'synthwave', mode: 'dark' },
  crimson_dark: { id: 'royal_velvet', mode: 'dark' },
  forest_dark: { id: 'emerald_studio', mode: 'dark' },
  clean_light: { id: 'emerald_studio', mode: 'light' },
  ivory_light: { id: 'honeycomb', mode: 'light' },
  sky_light: { id: 'blueprint', mode: 'light' },
  rose_light: { id: 'ink_vermilion', mode: 'light' },
  mint_light: { id: 'coral_reef', mode: 'light' },
  // v2 families that were replaced (keep the player's current mode)
  enchanted_forest: { id: 'blueprint' },
  deep_ocean: { id: 'coral_reef' },
  sahara_sunset: { id: 'honeycomb' },
  sakura_bloom: { id: 'ink_vermilion' },
  arctic_frost: { id: 'liquid_chrome' }
}

export function getAppTheme(id: AppThemeId | string, mode: ColorMode = 'dark'): AppThemeConfig {
  const legacy = LEGACY_APP_THEMES[id];
  const familyId = legacy ? legacy.id : id;
  const family = APP_THEME_FAMILIES.find(f => f.id === familyId) || APP_THEME_FAMILIES[0];
  return {
    id: family.id,
    name: family.name,
    description: family.description,
    mode,
    ...(mode === 'light' ? family.light : family.dark)
  };
}

/** Upgrades settings saved by older versions (legacy theme ids, missing toggles). */
export function normalizeThemeSettings<T extends Partial<UserSettings>>(s: T): T {
  const next = { ...s };
  const legacy = s.appTheme ? LEGACY_APP_THEMES[s.appTheme as string] : undefined;
  if (legacy) {
    next.appTheme = legacy.id;
    if (legacy.mode) next.colorMode = legacy.mode;
  } else if (s.appTheme && !APP_THEME_FAMILIES.some(f => f.id === s.appTheme)) {
    next.appTheme = 'emerald_studio';
  }
  if (next.colorMode !== 'light' && next.colorMode !== 'dark') next.colorMode = 'dark';
  if (typeof next.matchBoardToPieces !== 'boolean') next.matchBoardToPieces = true;
  if (!Array.isArray(next.customBoards)) next.customBoards = [];
  if (typeof next.boardSize !== 'number' || !Number.isFinite(next.boardSize)) next.boardSize = 100;
  next.boardSize = Math.min(140, Math.max(60, next.boardSize));
  return next;
}

<file path="src/utils/crypto.ts">
/**
 * End-to-End Encryption (E2EE) utilities using Web Crypto API.
 * Uses PBKDF2 (SHA-256) with 100,000 iterations and AES-GCM 256-bit.
 * Zero plaintext ever sent across network or exposed.
 */

function bufferToBase64(buf: ArrayBuffer): string {
  const bytes = new Uint8Array(buf);
  let binary = '';
  for (let i = 0; i < bytes.byteLength; i++) {
    binary += String.fromCharCode(bytes[i]);
  }
  return btoa(binary);
}

function base64ToBuffer(base64: string): ArrayBuffer {
  const binary = atob(base64);
  const bytes = new Uint8Array(binary.length);
  for (let i = 0; i < binary.length; i++) {
    bytes[i] = binary.charCodeAt(i);
  }
  return bytes.buffer;
}

export async function deriveKey(passphrase: string, salt: Uint8Array): Promise<CryptoKey> {
  const enc = new TextEncoder();
  const keyMaterial = await crypto.subtle.importKey(
    'raw',
    enc.encode(passphrase),
    { name: 'PBKDF2' },
    false,
    ['deriveKey']
  );

  return crypto.subtle.deriveKey(
    {
      name: 'PBKDF2',
      salt: salt as unknown as BufferSource,
      iterations: 100000,
      hash: 'SHA-256'
    },
    keyMaterial,
    { name: 'AES-GCM', length: 256 },
    false,
    ['encrypt', 'decrypt']
  );
}

export async function encryptData(data: string, passphrase: string): Promise<string> {
  const salt = crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(16));
  const iv = crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(12));
  const key = await deriveKey(passphrase, salt);

  const enc = new TextEncoder();
  const encrypted = await crypto.subtle.encrypt(
    { name: 'AES-GCM', iv },
    key,
    enc.encode(data)
  );

  const payload = {
    salt: bufferToBase64(salt.buffer),
    iv: bufferToBase64(iv.buffer),
    ciphertext: bufferToBase64(encrypted),
    version: '1.0'
  };

  return JSON.stringify(payload);
}

export async function decryptData(encryptedJson: string, passphrase: string): Promise<string> {
  const payload = JSON.parse(encryptedJson);
  const salt = new Uint8Array(base64ToBuffer(payload.salt));
  const iv = new Uint8Array(base64ToBuffer(payload.iv));
  const ciphertext = base64ToBuffer(payload.ciphertext);

  const key = await deriveKey(passphrase, salt);
  const decrypted = await crypto.subtle.decrypt(
    { name: 'AES-GCM', iv },
    key,
    ciphertext
  );

  const dec = new TextDecoder();
  return dec.decode(decrypted);
}

export function generateRandomVaultId(): string {
  const chars = 'abcdefghjkmnpqrstuvwxyz23456789';
  let id = 'gm-';
  const vals = crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(8));
  for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
    id += chars[vals[i] % chars.length];
  }
  return id;
}

/**
 * Offline Web Audio sound effects generator.
 * Zero external MP3/WAV requests, zero network overhead, ultra-low battery drain.
 */

class SoundController {
  private ctx: AudioContext | null = null;
  private enabled: boolean = true;
  private volume: number = 0.5;

  private initCtx() {
    if (!this.ctx && typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      const AudioCtx = window.AudioContext || (window as unknown as { webkitAudioContext: typeof AudioContext }).webkitAudioContext;
      if (AudioCtx) {
        this.ctx = new AudioCtx();
      }
    }
    if (this.ctx && this.ctx.state === 'suspended') {
      this.ctx.resume().catch(() => {});
    }
  }

  public setEnabled(enabled: boolean) {
    this.enabled = enabled;
  }

  public setVolume(vol: number) {
    this.volume = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, vol));
  }

  public playMove() {
    if (!this.enabled) return;
    this.initCtx();
    if (!this.ctx) return;

    const t = this.ctx.currentTime;
    const osc = this.ctx.createOscillator();
    const gain = this.ctx.createGain();

    osc.type = 'sine';
    osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(320, t);
    osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(140, t + 0.06);

    gain.gain.setValueAtTime(this.volume * 0.4, t);
    gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, t + 0.07);

    osc.connect(gain);
    gain.connect(this.ctx.destination);

    osc.start(t);
    osc.stop(t + 0.08);
  }

  public playCapture() {
    if (!this.enabled) return;
    this.initCtx();
    if (!this.ctx) return;

    const t = this.ctx.currentTime;
    const osc = this.ctx.createOscillator();
    const noiseGain = this.ctx.createGain();

    osc.type = 'triangle';
    osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(260, t);
    osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(80, t + 0.1);

    noiseGain.gain.setValueAtTime(this.volume * 0.7, t);
    noiseGain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, t + 0.12);

    osc.connect(noiseGain);
    noiseGain.connect(this.ctx.destination);

    osc.start(t);
    osc.stop(t + 0.13);
  }

  public playCheck() {
    if (!this.enabled) return;
    this.initCtx();
    if (!this.ctx) return;

    const t = this.ctx.currentTime;
    [440, 660].forEach((freq, i) => {
      if (!this.ctx) return;
      const osc = this.ctx.createOscillator();
      const gain = this.ctx.createGain();
      osc.type = 'sine';
      osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, t + i * 0.05);

      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(this.volume * 0.5, t + i * 0.05);
      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, t + i * 0.05 + 0.15);

      osc.connect(gain);
      gain.connect(this.ctx.destination);

      osc.start(t + i * 0.05);
      osc.stop(t + i * 0.05 + 0.16);
    });
  }

  public playCastle() {
    if (!this.enabled) return;
    this.playMove();
    setTimeout(() => this.playMove(), 80);
  }

  public playVictory() {
    if (!this.enabled) return;
    this.initCtx();
    if (!this.ctx) return;

    const chord = [392, 523.25, 659.25, 783.99]; // G4, C5, E5, G5
    const t = this.ctx.currentTime;
    chord.forEach((freq, idx) => {
      if (!this.ctx) return;
      const osc = this.ctx.createOscillator();
      const gain = this.ctx.createGain();
      osc.type = 'triangle';
      osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, t + idx * 0.07);

      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(this.volume * 0.45, t + idx * 0.07);
      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, t + idx * 0.07 + 0.4);

      osc.connect(gain);
      gain.connect(this.ctx.destination);

      osc.start(t + idx * 0.07);
      osc.stop(t + idx * 0.07 + 0.45);
    });
  }

  public playBlunder() {
    if (!this.enabled) return;
    this.initCtx();
    if (!this.ctx) return;

    const t = this.ctx.currentTime;
    const osc = this.ctx.createOscillator();
    const gain = this.ctx.createGain();

    osc.type = 'sawtooth';
    osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(180, t);
    osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(110, t + 0.2);

    gain.gain.setValueAtTime(this.volume * 0.35, t);
    gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, t + 0.22);

    osc.connect(gain);
    gain.connect(this.ctx.destination);

    osc.start(t);
    osc.stop(t + 0.23);
  }

  public playPuzzleSuccess() {
    if (!this.enabled) return;
    this.initCtx();
    if (!this.ctx) return;

    const notes = [523.25, 659.25, 783.99, 1046.50]; // C5, E5, G5, C6
    const t = this.ctx.currentTime;
    notes.forEach((freq, idx) => {
      if (!this.ctx) return;
      const osc = this.ctx.createOscillator();
      const gain = this.ctx.createGain();
      osc.type = 'sine';
      osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, t + idx * 0.06);

      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(this.volume * 0.4, t + idx * 0.06);
      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, t + idx * 0.06 + 0.2);

      osc.connect(gain);
      gain.connect(this.ctx.destination);

      osc.start(t + idx * 0.06);
      osc.stop(t + idx * 0.06 + 0.22);
    });
  }

  public playPremove() {
    if (!this.enabled) return;
    this.initCtx();
    if (!this.ctx) return;

    const t = this.ctx.currentTime;
    const osc = this.ctx.createOscillator();
    const gain = this.ctx.createGain();
    osc.type = 'sine';
    osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(510, t);
    osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(640, t + 0.05);

    gain.gain.setValueAtTime(this.volume * 0.24, t);
    gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, t + 0.065);

    osc.connect(gain);
    gain.connect(this.ctx.destination);

    osc.start(t);
    osc.stop(t + 0.07);
  }

  public playPromote() {
    if (!this.enabled) return;
    this.initCtx();
    if (!this.ctx) return;

    const t = this.ctx.currentTime;
    [523.25, 783.99].forEach((freq, i) => {
      if (!this.ctx) return;
      const osc = this.ctx.createOscillator();
      const gain = this.ctx.createGain();
      osc.type = 'triangle';
      osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, t + i * 0.045);
      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(this.volume * 0.36, t + i * 0.045);
      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, t + i * 0.045 + 0.16);
      osc.connect(gain);
      gain.connect(this.ctx.destination);
      osc.start(t + i * 0.045);
      osc.stop(t + i * 0.045 + 0.17);
    });
  }
}

export const sounds = new SoundController();
</file>

export default function App() {
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<AppTab>('play');
  const [activeVariant, setActiveVariant] = useState<VariantId>('standard');
  const [activeCustomVariant, setActiveCustomVariant] = useState<CustomVariantConfig | null>(null);
  const [variantsSubTab, setVariantsSubTab] = useState<'catalog' | 'custom'>('catalog');
  const [studioSeedConfig, setStudioSeedConfig] = useState<CustomVariantConfig | null>(null);

  const [isSettingsOpen, setIsSettingsOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [selectedReviewGame, setSelectedReviewGame] = useState<GameHistoryItem | null>(SEED_MATCHES[0]);
  const [recommendedPuzzleTheme, setRecommendedPuzzleTheme] = useState<string | undefined>(undefined);
  const [isOnline, setIsOnline] = useState<boolean>(true);

  const [profile, setProfile] = useState<UserProfile>(() => {
    try {
      const saved = localStorage.getItem('gm_chess_profile');
      if (saved) {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(saved) as UserProfile;
        return {
          ...parsed,
          settings: normalizeThemeSettings({ ...DEFAULT_SETTINGS, ...(parsed.settings || {}) })
        };
      }
    } catch {
      // ignore
    }
    return SEED_PROFILE;
  });

  const [matches, setMatches] = useState<GameHistoryItem[]>(() => {
    try {
      const saved = localStorage.getItem('gm_chess_matches');
      if (saved) return JSON.parse(saved);
    } catch {
      // ignore
    }
    return SEED_MATCHES;
  });

  const currentAppTheme = getAppTheme(
    profile.settings.appTheme || 'emerald_studio',
    profile.settings.colorMode || 'dark'
  );
  const isLightMode = currentAppTheme.mode === 'light';

  // Synchronize global CSS variables and document surface with active theme
  useEffect(() => {
    const root = document.documentElement;
    root.style.setProperty('--gm-bg', currentAppTheme.bgHex);
    root.style.setProperty('--gm-header', currentAppTheme.headerHex);
    root.style.setProperty('--gm-card', currentAppTheme.cardHex);
    root.style.setProperty('--gm-card-2', currentAppTheme.cardSecondaryHex);
    root.style.setProperty('--gm-border', currentAppTheme.cardBorderHex);
    root.style.setProperty('--gm-accent', currentAppTheme.accentHex);
    root.style.setProperty('--gm-accent-text', currentAppTheme.accentTextHex);
    root.style.setProperty('--gm-text', currentAppTheme.textPrimary);
    root.style.setProperty('--gm-text-2', currentAppTheme.textSecondary);
    root.style.setProperty('--gm-muted', currentAppTheme.textMutedHex);
    root.style.setProperty('--gm-hover', currentAppTheme.surfaceHoverHex);
    root.style.setProperty('--gm-accent-2', currentAppTheme.accent2Hex);
    root.style.colorScheme = currentAppTheme.mode;

    document.body.style.backgroundColor = currentAppTheme.bgHex;
    document.body.style.color = currentAppTheme.textPrimary;
  }, [currentAppTheme]);

  // Start each tab at the top instead of inheriting the previous tab's scroll position
  useEffect(() => {
    window.scrollTo({ top: 0, left: 0, behavior: 'auto' });
  }, [activeTab]);

  // Start loading Stockfish in the background so the first engine move is instant
  useEffect(() => {
    const id = window.setTimeout(warmUpEngine, 1500);
    return () => window.clearTimeout(id);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleOnline = () => setIsOnline(true);
    const handleOffline = () => setIsOnline(false);
    window.addEventListener('online', handleOnline);
    window.addEventListener('offline', handleOffline);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('online', handleOnline);
      window.removeEventListener('offline', handleOffline);
    };
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    try {
      localStorage.setItem('gm_chess_profile', JSON.stringify(profile));
      localStorage.setItem('gm_chess_matches', JSON.stringify(matches));
    } catch {
      // ignore storage quota errors
    }
  }, [profile, matches]);

  // ---- Achievements: derived from games, stats and training progress ----
  const [progressTick, setProgressTick] = useState(0);
  const [unlockDates, setUnlockDates] = useState<Record<string, string>>(() => loadUnlockDates() ?? {});
  const [toastQueue, setToastQueue] = useState<AchievementDef[]>([]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const onProgress = () => setProgressTick(t => t + 1);
    window.addEventListener(PROGRESS_EVENT, onProgress);
    return () => window.removeEventListener(PROGRESS_EVENT, onProgress);
  }, []);

  const achievementStatuses = useMemo(
    () => evaluateAchievements(buildAchievementContext(profile, matches), unlockDates),
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
    [profile, matches, unlockDates, progressTick]
  );

  // Record unlock dates; toast new unlocks (the very first run records silently so old progress doesn't spam)
  useEffect(() => {
    const stored = loadUnlockDates();
    const isFirstRun = stored === null;
    const dates = { ...(stored ?? {}) };
    const newlyUnlocked = achievementStatuses.filter(s => s.unlocked && !dates[s.def.id]);
    if (newlyUnlocked.length === 0) {
      if (isFirstRun) saveUnlockDates(dates);
      return;
    }
    const today = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
    newlyUnlocked.forEach(s => {
      dates[s.def.id] = today;
    });
    saveUnlockDates(dates);
    setUnlockDates(dates);
    if (!isFirstRun) setToastQueue(q => [...q, ...newlyUnlocked.map(s => s.def)]);
  }, [achievementStatuses]);

  const dismissToast = useCallback(() => setToastQueue(q => q.slice(1)), []);

  const handleSaveGame = (newGame: GameHistoryItem) => {
    setMatches(prev => [newGame, ...prev]);

    setProfile(prev => {
      const isWin =
        (newGame.result === '1-0' && newGame.playerColor === 'w') ||
        (newGame.result === '0-1' && newGame.playerColor === 'b');
      const isDraw = newGame.result === '1/2-1/2';

      const nextStreak = isWin ? prev.stats.currentStreak + 1 : 0;
      const ratingGain = isWin ? 16 : isDraw ? 0 : -14;
      const nextRapidElo = prev.ratings.rapid + ratingGain;

      return {
        ...prev,
        ratings: {
          ...prev.ratings,
          rapid: nextRapidElo,
        },
        ratingHistory: {
          ...prev.ratingHistory,
          rapid: [
            ...prev.ratingHistory.rapid,
            { date: new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0], elo: nextRapidElo }
          ]
        },
        stats: {
          ...prev.stats,
          gamesPlayed: prev.stats.gamesPlayed + 1,
          wins: isWin ? prev.stats.wins + 1 : prev.stats.wins,
          draws: isDraw ? prev.stats.draws + 1 : prev.stats.draws,
          losses: !isWin && !isDraw ? prev.stats.losses + 1 : prev.stats.losses,
          highestRating: Math.max(prev.stats.highestRating, nextRapidElo),
          currentStreak: nextStreak
        }
      };
    });
  };

  const handleUpdatePuzzleElo = (newElo: number) => {
    setProfile(prev => {
      const gained = newElo >= prev.ratings.puzzles;
      return {
        ...prev,
        ratings: { ...prev.ratings, puzzles: newElo },
        stats: {
          ...prev.stats,
          puzzlesAttempted: prev.stats.puzzlesAttempted + 1,
          puzzlesSolved: gained ? prev.stats.puzzlesSolved + 1 : prev.stats.puzzlesSolved,
          highestRating: Math.max(prev.stats.highestRating, newElo)
        },
        ratingHistory: {
          ...prev.ratingHistory,
          puzzles: [
            ...prev.ratingHistory.puzzles,
            { date: new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0], elo: newElo }
          ]
        }
      };
    });
  };

  const handleSelectVariantToPlay = (variantId: VariantId) => {
    setActiveVariant(variantId);
    if (CUSTOM_ENGINE_VARIANTS.includes(variantId)) {
      setActiveCustomVariant(variantToCustomConfig(variantId));
    } else {
      setActiveCustomVariant(null);
    }
    setActiveTab('play');
  };

  const handlePlayCustomInArena = (config: CustomVariantConfig) => {
    setActiveCustomVariant(config);
    setActiveVariant('chaturanga');
    setActiveTab('play');
  };

  const handleEditVariantRules = (config: CustomVariantConfig) => {
    setStudioSeedConfig(config);
    setVariantsSubTab('custom');
    setActiveTab('variants');
  };

  // Imported games join the archive and open in review, without touching ratings or W/L stats
  const handleImportGame = (game: GameHistoryItem) => {
    setMatches(prev => [game, ...prev]);
    setSelectedReviewGame(game);
    setActiveTab('review');
  };

  const handleRunGameReview = (game: GameHistoryItem) => {
    setSelectedReviewGame(game);
    setActiveTab('review');
  };

  const navItems: { id: AppTab; label: string; shortLabel: string; icon: React.ReactNode }[] = [
    { id: 'play', label: 'Play', shortLabel: 'Play', icon: <Swords className="w-4 h-4" /> },
    { id: 'variants', label: 'Variants & Studio', shortLabel: 'Variants', icon: <Compass className="w-4 h-4" /> },
    { id: 'puzzles', label: 'Puzzles', shortLabel: 'Puzzles', icon: <Trophy className="w-4 h-4" /> },
    { id: 'train', label: 'Training', shortLabel: 'Train', icon: <GraduationCap className="w-4 h-4" /> },
    { id: 'coach', label: 'AI Coach', shortLabel: 'Coach', icon: <Brain className="w-4 h-4" /> },
    { id: 'dashboard', label: 'Archive', shortLabel: 'Stats', icon: <BarChart3 className="w-4 h-4" /> },
  ];

  return (
    <ThemeProvider settings={profile.settings}>
      <div
        className="relative isolate min-h-screen flex flex-col transition-colors duration-200"
        style={{
          color: currentAppTheme.textPrimary
        }}
      >
        {/* Fixed background layer: composited once instead of `background-attachment: fixed`,
            which forces a full-page repaint on every scroll frame */}
        <div
          aria-hidden="true"
          className="fixed inset-0 -z-10 pointer-events-none transition-colors duration-200"
          style={{
            backgroundColor: currentAppTheme.bgHex,
            backgroundImage: currentAppTheme.bgGradient,
            transform: 'translateZ(0)'
          }}
        />
        {/* 3-Zone Studio Top Navigation Bar */}
        <header
          className="sticky top-0 z-40 border-b backdrop-blur-md transition-colors duration-200"
          style={{ backgroundColor: currentAppTheme.headerHex, borderColor: currentAppTheme.cardBorderHex }}
        >
          {/* Accent hairline */}
          <div
            className="absolute inset-x-0 bottom-[-1px] h-px pointer-events-none"
            style={{
              backgroundImage: `linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, ${currentAppTheme.accentHex}, ${currentAppTheme.accent2Hex}, transparent)`,
              opacity: 0.7
            }}
          />
          <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto h-14 px-3 sm:px-6 flex items-center justify-between gap-4">
            {/* Zone 1: Brand Emblem */}
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setActiveTab('play')}
              className="flex items-center gap-2.5 cursor-pointer group select-none text-left focus:outline-none shrink-0"
            >
              <div
                className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center p-1 transition-transform group-hover:scale-105"
                style={{
                  backgroundImage: `linear-gradient(135deg, ${currentAppTheme.accentHex}33, ${currentAppTheme.accent2Hex}26)`,
                  backgroundColor: currentAppTheme.cardSecondaryHex,
                  border: `1px solid ${currentAppTheme.accentHex}55`,
                  boxShadow: `0 0 18px -4px ${currentAppTheme.accentHex}66`
                }}
              >
                <ChessPieceIcon type="n" color="w" set={profile.settings.pieceSet} />
              </div>
              <span className="font-display font-extrabold text-sm sm:text-base tracking-tight whitespace-nowrap" style={{ color: currentAppTheme.textPrimary }}>
                Grandmaster Studio
              </span>
            </button>

            {/* Zone 2: Desktop Primary Navigation Tabs */}
            <nav className="hidden md:flex items-center h-full gap-0.5 xl:gap-1 min-w-0" aria-label="Main navigation">
              {navItems.map(item => {
                const isActive = activeTab === item.id;
                return (
                  <button
                    key={item.id}
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => {
                      if (item.id === 'variants') setVariantsSubTab('catalog');
                      setActiveTab(item.id);
                    }}
                    aria-label={item.label}
                    title={item.label}
                    className="relative h-full flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 xl:px-3 text-xs font-bold transition whitespace-nowrap"
                    style={{
                      color: isActive ? currentAppTheme.accentHex : currentAppTheme.textSecondary
                    }}
                  >
                    {item.icon}
                    {/* Icons only on narrow desktops, short labels on medium, full labels on wide screens */}
                    <span className="hidden lg:inline xl:hidden">{item.shortLabel}</span>
                    <span className="hidden xl:inline">{item.label}</span>
                    {isActive && (
                      <span
                        className="absolute bottom-0 left-2 right-2 h-0.5 rounded-t-full"
                        style={{
                          backgroundImage: `linear-gradient(90deg, ${currentAppTheme.accentHex}, ${currentAppTheme.accent2Hex})`,
                          boxShadow: `0 0 10px ${currentAppTheme.accentHex}`
                        }}
                      />
                    )}
                  </button>
                );
              })}
            </nav>

            {/* Zone 3: Telemetry & Controls */}
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 sm:gap-3 shrink-0">
              {profile.settings.batterySaver && (
                <span
                  className="hidden sm:inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] font-semibold"
                  style={{ color: currentAppTheme.accentHex }}
                  title="Battery Saver Mode Active"
                >
                  <BatteryCharging className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>Eco</span>
                </span>
              )}

              {/* Offline indicator only shown when offline */}
              {!isOnline && (
                <span
                  className="hidden sm:inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] font-mono text-amber-500"
                  title="Offline · Local Encrypted Vault"
                >
                  <WifiOff className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>Offline</span>
                </span>
              )}

              {/* Quick 10 App Theme Switcher */}
              <label
                className="hidden 2xl:flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg border text-xs cursor-pointer"
                style={{
                  backgroundColor: currentAppTheme.cardSecondaryHex,
                  borderColor: currentAppTheme.cardBorderHex
                }}
              >
                <Palette className="w-3.5 h-3.5 shrink-0" style={{ color: currentAppTheme.accentHex }} />
                <select
                  value={currentAppTheme.id}
                  aria-label="Select app theme"
                  onChange={e => {
                    const newTheme = e.target.value as AppThemeId;
                    setProfile(prev => ({
                      ...prev,
                      settings: { ...prev.settings, appTheme: newTheme }
                    }));
                  }}
                  className="bg-transparent text-xs font-semibold focus:outline-none cursor-pointer"
                  style={{ color: currentAppTheme.textPrimary }}
                >
                  {APP_THEME_FAMILIES.map(t => (
                    <option
                      key={t.id}
                      value={t.id}
                      style={{ backgroundColor: currentAppTheme.cardHex, color: currentAppTheme.textPrimary }}
                    >
                      {t.name}
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </select>
              </label>

              {/* Dark / Light Mode Toggle */}
              <button
                type="button"
                role="switch"
                aria-checked={isLightMode}
                aria-label="Light mode"
                title={isLightMode ? 'Switch to dark mode' : 'Switch to light mode'}
                onClick={() =>
                  setProfile(prev => ({
                    ...prev,
                    settings: { ...prev.settings, colorMode: isLightMode ? 'dark' : 'light' }
                  }))
                }
                className="relative h-8 w-[58px] rounded-full border shrink-0 transition-colors"
                style={{
                  backgroundColor: currentAppTheme.cardSecondaryHex,
                  borderColor: currentAppTheme.cardBorderHex
                }}
              >
                <Moon
                  className="absolute left-[9px] top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-3.5 h-3.5"
                  style={{ color: currentAppTheme.textMutedHex }}
                />
                <Sun
                  className="absolute right-[9px] top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-3.5 h-3.5"
                  style={{ color: currentAppTheme.textMutedHex }}
                />
                <span
                  className="absolute top-[3px] w-6 h-6 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center shadow-md transition-all duration-200"
                  style={{
                    left: isLightMode ? 'calc(100% - 27px)' : '3px',
                    backgroundImage: `linear-gradient(135deg, ${currentAppTheme.accentHex}, ${currentAppTheme.accent2Hex})`,
                    color: currentAppTheme.accentTextHex
                  }}
                >
                  {isLightMode ? <Sun className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> : <Moon className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
                </span>
              </button>

              {/* Rapid Rating Metric */}
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setActiveTab('dashboard')}
                className="text-xs font-mono font-bold tabular-nums hover:opacity-80 transition"
                style={{ color: currentAppTheme.accentHex }}
                title="View Rating Archive & Dashboard"
              >
                {profile.ratings.rapid} Elo
              </button>

              {/* Settings Trigger */}
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setIsSettingsOpen(true)}
                aria-label="Open settings"
                className="p-2 rounded-lg border transition hover:opacity-80"
                style={{
                  backgroundColor: currentAppTheme.cardSecondaryHex,
                  borderColor: currentAppTheme.cardBorderHex,
                  color: currentAppTheme.textPrimary
                }}
                title="Customization & Settings"
              >
                <Settings className="w-4 h-4" />
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </header>

        {/* Main Workspace */}
        <main className="flex-1 pb-20 md:pb-8">
          {activeTab === 'play' && (
            <PlayView
              initialVariant={activeVariant}
              customVariantConfig={activeCustomVariant}
              settings={profile.settings}
              onSaveGame={handleSaveGame}
              onRunGameReview={handleRunGameReview}
              onUpdateSettings={(newSettings) =>
                setProfile(prev => ({ ...prev, settings: newSettings }))
              }
              onEditVariantRules={handleEditVariantRules}
            />
          )}

          {activeTab === 'variants' && (
            <VariantsView
              initialSubTab={variantsSubTab}
              initialCustomConfig={studioSeedConfig}
              onSelectVariant={handleSelectVariantToPlay}
              onPlayCustomInArena={handlePlayCustomInArena}
            />
          )}

          {activeTab === 'puzzles' && (
            <PuzzlesView
              userPuzzleElo={profile.ratings.puzzles}
              initialTheme={recommendedPuzzleTheme}
              onRatingChange={handleUpdatePuzzleElo}
            />
          )}

          {activeTab === 'train' && <TrainView />}

          {activeTab === 'review' && selectedReviewGame && (
            <GameReviewView
              game={selectedReviewGame}
              playerElo={profile.ratings.rapid}
              onBack={() => setActiveTab('dashboard')}
            />
          )}

          {activeTab === 'coach' && (
            <CoachView
              profile={profile}
              recentGames={matches}
              onStartRecommendedPuzzles={(themeName) => {
                setRecommendedPuzzleTheme(themeName);
                setActiveTab('puzzles');
              }}
            />
          )}

          {activeTab === 'dashboard' && (
            <DashboardView
              profile={profile}
              matches={matches}
              onReviewGame={handleRunGameReview}
              onPlayNewGame={() => setActiveTab('play')}
              onImportGame={handleImportGame}
              achievements={achievementStatuses}
            />
          )}
        </main>

        {/* Mobile Bottom Navigation Bar */}
        <nav
          className="md:hidden fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 z-40 h-14 backdrop-blur-lg border-t px-2 flex items-center justify-around transition-colors duration-200"
          style={{
            backgroundColor: currentAppTheme.headerHex,
            borderColor: currentAppTheme.cardBorderHex
          }}
        >
          {navItems.map(item => {
            const isActive = activeTab === item.id;
            return (
              <button
                key={item.id}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => {
                  if (item.id === 'variants') setVariantsSubTab('catalog');
                  setActiveTab(item.id);
                }}
                className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-0.5 px-2 py-1 rounded-lg text-[10px] font-bold transition"
                style={{
                  color: isActive ? currentAppTheme.accentHex : currentAppTheme.textSecondary
                }}
              >
                {item.icon}
                <span>{item.shortLabel}</span>
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </nav>

        <AchievementToast
          achievement={toastQueue[0] ?? null}
          onDismiss={dismissToast}
          onOpen={() => {
            dismissToast();
            setActiveTab('dashboard');
          }}
        />

        {/* Settings & Customization Modal */}
        <SettingsModal
          isOpen={isSettingsOpen}
          onClose={() => setIsSettingsOpen(false)}
          settings={profile.settings}
          onSaveSettings={(newSettings) =>
            setProfile(prev => ({ ...prev, settings: newSettings }))
          }
          fullDataPayload={{ profile, matches }}
          onRestoreDataPayload={(payload: unknown) => {
            const p = payload as { profile?: UserProfile; matches?: GameHistoryItem[] } | null;
            if (p?.profile) {
              setProfile({
                ...p.profile,
                settings: normalizeThemeSettings({ ...DEFAULT_SETTINGS, ...(p.profile.settings || {}) })
              });
            }
            if (p?.matches) setMatches(p.matches);
          }}
        />
      </div>
    </ThemeProvider>
  );
}
</file>

# Run and deploy your AI Studio app

This contains everything you need to run your app locally.

View your app in AI Studio: https://ai.studio/apps/c6507323-37de-410e-bea5-012ac1b1d040

## Run Locally

**Prerequisites:**  Node.js


1. Install dependencies:
   `npm install`
2. Set the `GEMINI_API_KEY` in [.env.local](.env.local) to your Gemini API key
3. Run the app:
   `npm run dev`

<file path="server.ts">
import express from 'express';
import path from 'path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'url';
import dotenv from 'dotenv';
import { GoogleGenAI, Type } from '@google/genai';

dotenv.config();

const __filename = fileURLToPath(import.meta.url);
const __dirname = path.dirname(__filename);

const app = express();

function resolveServerPort(): number {
  const portFlagIdx = process.argv.findIndex(arg => arg === '--port' || arg.startsWith('--port='));
  if (portFlagIdx !== -1) {
    const raw = process.argv[portFlagIdx];
    const value = raw.includes('=') ? raw.split('=')[1] : process.argv[portFlagIdx + 1];
    const parsed = parseInt(value ?? '', 10);
    if (!Number.isNaN(parsed) && parsed > 0) return parsed;
  }

  const envPort = process.env.PORT ? parseInt(process.env.PORT, 10) : NaN;
  const nginxPort = process.env.NGINX_PORT ? parseInt(process.env.NGINX_PORT, 10) : NaN;
  const defaultAppPort = process.env.DEFAULT_APP_PORT ? parseInt(process.env.DEFAULT_APP_PORT, 10) : 3000;

  if (!Number.isNaN(envPort) && envPort > 0 && envPort !== nginxPort) {
    return envPort;
  }
  return !Number.isNaN(defaultAppPort) && defaultAppPort > 0 ? defaultAppPort : 3000;
}

const PORT = resolveServerPort();

app.use(express.json({ limit: '10mb' }));

// In-memory encrypted sync store (E2EE: stores only encrypted ciphertext)
const encryptedSyncVaults = new Map<string, { ciphertext: string; updatedAt: number }>();

interface CoachReport {
  coachSummary: string;
  keyStrengths: string[];
  areasForImprovement: string[];
  tacticalTakeaway: string;
  suggestedPuzzlesCategory: string;
  openingTip: string;
}

function buildOfflineCoachReport(params: {
  userRating?: number;
  blundersCount?: number;
  userGoal?: string;
  variant?: string;
  playerColor?: string;
}): CoachReport {
  const rating = params.userRating || 1200;
  const blunders = params.blundersCount || 0;
  const goal = (params.userGoal || '').toLowerCase();
  const variant = params.variant || 'Standard Chess';
  const color = params.playerColor === 'b' ? 'Black' : 'White';

  let suggestedPuzzlesCategory = 'Pin & Skewer';
  let tacticalTakeaway = 'Always inspect every check, capture, and forcing threat before finalizing your move.';
  let openingTip = `As ${color}, prioritize rapid minor-piece development and central pawn control before launching wing attacks.`;
  let summaryFocus = 'converting middlegame advantages without allowing tactical counterplay';

  if (goal.includes('endgame') || goal.includes('rook') || goal.includes('pawn')) {
    suggestedPuzzlesCategory = 'Rook Endgames';
    tacticalTakeaway = 'In rook endgames, place your rook behind passed pawns and activate your King toward the center immediately.';
    openingTip = 'Aim for clean pawn structures with minimal isolated islands so your endgame remains resilient.';
    summaryFocus = 'king activation and pawn-race calculation in simplified positions';
  } else if (goal.includes('opening') || goal.includes('trap') || goal.includes('development')) {
    suggestedPuzzlesCategory = 'Development & Tempo';
    tacticalTakeaway = 'Avoid moving the same minor piece twice in the opening unless winning material or forcing a structural concession.';
    openingTip = `In ${variant}, fight directly for central squares (d4/e4/d5/e5) and castle early before opening central files.`;
    summaryFocus = 'opening development tempo and early king safety';
  } else if (goal.includes('chaturanga') || goal.includes('variant') || goal.includes('custom')) {
    suggestedPuzzlesCategory = 'Tactical Motif';
    tacticalTakeaway = 'Map out leaping piece ranges (like Knights and Gajas) two moves ahead—they bypass pawn chains.';
    openingTip = 'In historical and fairy variants, coordinate non-linear jumpers with central pawns before trading major pieces.';
    summaryFocus = 'piece coordination and asymmetric threat calculation';
  } else if (goal.includes('blunder') || goal.includes('mistake') || blunders > 0) {
    suggestedPuzzlesCategory = 'Hanging Pieces & Forks';
    tacticalTakeaway = 'Run a 3-second blunder check before clicking: verify that your destination square and back rank stay defended.';
    openingTip = 'Choose solid, well-protected piece posts over sharp gambits until your tactical scan becomes automatic.';
    summaryFocus = `eliminating unforced tactical oversights (${blunders} flagged recently)`;
  }

  return {
    coachSummary: `Tailored assessment for ${rating} Elo (${variant}): focus primarily on ${summaryFocus}. Consistent pattern recognition in ${suggestedPuzzlesCategory.toLowerCase()} will produce the fastest rating improvement.`,
    keyStrengths: [
      rating >= 1400 ? 'Strong tactical awareness in open positions' : 'Willingness to contest central territory early',
      blunders === 0 ? 'Clean tactical discipline across recent turns' : 'Resourcefulness in dynamic middlegame positions'
    ],
    areasForImprovement: [
      `Deepen candidate-move scanning around ${suggestedPuzzlesCategory.toLowerCase()}`,
      'Evaluate your opponent’s sharpest reply before committing pawn breaks'
    ],
    tacticalTakeaway,
    suggestedPuzzlesCategory,
    openingTip
  };
}

// Health check
app.get('/api/health', (_req, res) => {
  res.json({ status: 'ok', timestamp: Date.now() });
});

// E2EE Cloud Sync Endpoints
app.post('/api/sync/push', (req, res) => {
  const { vaultId, encryptedPayload } = req.body;
  if (!vaultId || !encryptedPayload) {
    res.status(400).json({ error: 'Missing vaultId or encryptedPayload' });
    return;
  }
  encryptedSyncVaults.set(vaultId, {
    ciphertext: encryptedPayload,
    updatedAt: Date.now(),
  });
  res.json({ success: true, updatedAt: Date.now() });
});

app.get('/api/sync/pull/:vaultId', (req, res) => {
  const { vaultId } = req.params;
  const entry = encryptedSyncVaults.get(vaultId);
  if (!entry) {
    res.status(404).json({ error: 'Vault not found' });
    return;
  }
  res.json({ ciphertext: entry.ciphertext, updatedAt: entry.updatedAt });
});

// Gemini AI Chess Coach endpoint
app.post('/api/coach/analyze', async (req, res) => {
  const apiKey = process.env.GEMINI_API_KEY;
  const { pgn, fen, playerColor, userRating, blunders, userGoal, variant } = req.body;

  const offlineFallback = buildOfflineCoachReport({
    userRating,
    blundersCount: Array.isArray(blunders) ? blunders.length : 0,
    userGoal,
    variant,
    playerColor
  });

  if (!apiKey) {
    res.json({
      ...offlineFallback,
      mode: 'offline',
      apiNotice: 'Offline Grandmaster heuristics active. Attach a Gemini API key in Settings > Secrets to enable live cloud coaching.'
    });
    return;
  }

  try {
    const ai = new GoogleGenAI({
      apiKey,
      httpOptions: {
        headers: {
          'User-Agent': 'aistudio-build'
        }
      }
    });

    const prompt = `You are a high-level Chess Grandmaster Coach and mentor.
A player with an Elo rating of ~${userRating || 1200} just played a game of ${variant || 'Standard Chess'} as ${playerColor || 'White'}.
Current board position (FEN): ${fen || 'standard'}
PGN moves summary: ${pgn ? pgn.slice(0, 1000) : 'N/A'}
Number of blunders/mistakes flagged: ${blunders?.length || 0}
Player's stated learning goal: ${userGoal || 'Improve tactical vision and endgame technique'}

Provide a high-impact, encouraging coaching report grounded in concrete chess principles.`;

    const response = await ai.models.generateContent({
      model: 'gemini-4-hydrogen',
      contents: prompt,
      config: {
        systemInstruction: 'You are Grandmaster Mikhail, a concise, accurate chess coach. Always output valid JSON matching the requested schema.',
        responseMimeType: 'application/json',
        responseSchema: {
          type: Type.OBJECT,
          properties: {
            coachSummary: { type: Type.STRING, description: '2-3 sentences of direct grandmaster feedback.' },
            keyStrengths: { type: Type.ARRAY, items: { type: Type.STRING } },
            areasForImprovement: { type: Type.ARRAY, items: { type: Type.STRING } },
            tacticalTakeaway: { type: Type.STRING },
            suggestedPuzzlesCategory: { type: Type.STRING },
            openingTip: { type: Type.STRING }
          }
        }
      }
    });

    const text = (response.text ?? '{}').trim();
    let data: Partial<CoachReport> = {};
    try {
      data = JSON.parse(text) as Partial<CoachReport>;
    } catch {
      data = {
        ...offlineFallback,
        coachSummary: text.slice(0, 320) || offlineFallback.coachSummary
      };
    }

    res.json({
      coachSummary: data.coachSummary || offlineFallback.coachSummary,
      keyStrengths: Array.isArray(data.keyStrengths) && data.keyStrengths.length > 0 ? data.keyStrengths : offlineFallback.keyStrengths,
      areasForImprovement: Array.isArray(data.areasForImprovement) && data.areasForImprovement.length > 0 ? data.areasForImprovement : offlineFallback.areasForImprovement,
      tacticalTakeaway: data.tacticalTakeaway || offlineFallback.tacticalTakeaway,
      suggestedPuzzlesCategory: data.suggestedPuzzlesCategory || offlineFallback.suggestedPuzzlesCategory,
      openingTip: data.openingTip || offlineFallback.openingTip,
      mode: 'gemini'
    });
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    const errObj = err as { status?: number; message?: string } | null;
    const rawMsg = errObj?.message || String(err || 'Gemini API request unavailable');
    const isPermissionOrBilling =
      errObj?.status === 403 ||
      rawMsg.includes('PERMISSION_DENIED') ||
      rawMsg.includes('free tier is not available') ||
      rawMsg.includes('billing');

    const apiNotice = isPermissionOrBilling
      ? 'Cloud Gemini coaching requires a billing-enabled API key in Settings > Secrets for this project. Using tailored offline Grandmaster heuristics instead.'
      : 'Cloud Gemini coaching is temporarily unavailable. Using tailored offline Grandmaster heuristics instead.';

    res.json({
      ...offlineFallback,
      mode: 'offline',
      apiError: rawMsg,
      apiNotice
    });
  }
});

interface MoveCoachExplanation {
  headline: string;
  whyMoveWorkedOrFailed: string;
  bestMoveIdea: string;
  coachTip: string;
  source: 'gemini' | 'local';
}

function buildLocalMoveCoachExplanation(params: {
  playedSan?: string;
  bestSan?: string;
  classification?: string;
  evalBeforeCp?: number;
  evalAfterCp?: number;
  moveAccuracy?: number;
  pvSan?: string[];
  threats?: string[];
  sideToMove?: string;
}): MoveCoachExplanation {
  const played = params.playedSan || 'Your move';
  const best = params.bestSan || played;
  const cls = (params.classification || 'good').toLowerCase();
  const hasAcc = typeof params.moveAccuracy === 'number';
  const acc = hasAcc ? `${params.moveAccuracy!.toFixed(1)}%` : null;
  const beforePawns = ((params.evalBeforeCp || 0) / 100).toFixed(1);
  const afterPawns = ((params.evalAfterCp || 0) / 100).toFixed(1);
  const pvText = Array.isArray(params.pvSan) && params.pvSan.length > 0 ? params.pvSan.join(' ') : best;
  const threatText =
    Array.isArray(params.threats) && params.threats.length > 0
      ? `Watch targets on ${params.threats.join(', ')}.`
      : 'Keep pieces mutually defended and control central squares.';

  if (cls === 'brilliant') {
    return {
      headline: acc ? `${played} is Brilliant (${acc} accuracy)` : `${played} is Brilliant!`,
      whyMoveWorkedOrFailed: `${played} sacrifices material or steps into tension to seize lasting initiative (${beforePawns} → ${afterPawns}).`,
      bestMoveIdea: `The critical follow-up line is ${pvText}, maintaining active piece pressure.`,
      coachTip: `Always calculate one move deeper after a sacrifice to confirm the king cannot escape. ${threatText}`,
      source: 'local'
    };
  }
  if (cls === 'great' || cls === 'best' || cls === 'book') {
    return {
      headline: acc ? `${played} hits ${acc} move accuracy` : `${played} is the top engine choice`,
      whyMoveWorkedOrFailed: `${played} keeps optimal evaluation (${beforePawns} → ${afterPawns}) and improves piece coordination cleanly.`,
      bestMoveIdea: `Continuation idea: ${pvText}.`,
      coachTip: `Strong discipline — maintain this habit of checking forcing moves first. ${threatText}`,
      source: 'local'
    };
  }
  if (cls === 'excellent' || cls === 'good') {
    return {
      headline: acc ? `${played} is solid (${acc} accuracy)` : `${played} is a solid continuation`,
      whyMoveWorkedOrFailed: `${played} preserves structural balance (${beforePawns} → ${afterPawns}), though ${best} put slightly more pressure on the position.`,
      bestMoveIdea: `Comparing ${played} vs ${best}: ${pvText} gains an extra tempo on active squares.`,
      coachTip: `Look for the most active square for your least-developed piece before settling. ${threatText}`,
      source: 'local'
    };
  }

  return {
    headline: acc
      ? `${played} dropped accuracy to ${acc}`
      : best !== played
      ? `${played} overlooks ${best}`
      : `${played} weakens the position`,
    whyMoveWorkedOrFailed: `${played} shifted the evaluation from ${beforePawns} to ${afterPawns}, allowing the opponent cleaner counterplay or tactical targets.`,
    bestMoveIdea: `${best} was best here — continuing with ${pvText} neutralizes threats and preserves coordination.`,
    coachTip: `Before playing ${played}, pause for a 3-second check on hanging pieces, checks, and captures. ${threatText}`,
    source: 'local'
  };
}

// Per-move Coach Mikhail interactive explanation endpoint (Game Review & Live Coach Mode)
app.post('/api/coach/explain-move', async (req, res) => {
  const apiKey = process.env.GEMINI_API_KEY;
  const {
    fenBefore,
    fenAfter,
    playedSan,
    bestSan,
    bestMoveSan,
    classification,
    evalBeforeCp,
    evalAfterCp,
    moveAccuracy,
    pvSan,
    threats,
    mode,
    userQuestion,
    question
  } = req.body || {};

  const resolvedBestSan = bestSan || bestMoveSan;
  const resolvedQuestion = userQuestion || question;

  const localFallback = buildLocalMoveCoachExplanation({
    playedSan,
    bestSan: resolvedBestSan,
    classification,
    evalBeforeCp,
    evalAfterCp,
    moveAccuracy,
    pvSan,
    threats
  });

  if (!apiKey) {
    res.json(localFallback);
    return;
  }

  try {
    const ai = new GoogleGenAI({
      apiKey,
      httpOptions: {
        headers: {
          'User-Agent': 'aistudio-build'
        }
      }
    });

    const prompt = `Analyze this chess move clearly for an improving club player (${mode === 'live_coach' ? 'mid-game live coaching' : 'post-game review'}):
- FEN before move: ${fenBefore || 'unknown'}
- FEN after move: ${fenAfter || 'unknown'}
- Move played: ${playedSan || 'unknown'} (classification: ${classification || 'good'}, move accuracy: ${typeof moveAccuracy === 'number' ? `${moveAccuracy}%` : 'unknown'})
- Engine best move: ${resolvedBestSan || playedSan || 'unknown'}
- Engine continuation PV: ${Array.isArray(pvSan) ? pvSan.join(' ') : 'N/A'}
- Evaluation swing (White perspective, centipawns): ${evalBeforeCp ?? 0} -> ${evalAfterCp ?? 0}
- Threatened squares after move: ${Array.isArray(threats) && threats.length > 0 ? threats.join(', ') : 'none'}
${resolvedQuestion ? `- Player's specific question: ${resolvedQuestion}` : ''}

Give concise, practical chess coaching without fluff.`;

    const response = await ai.models.generateContent({
      model: 'gemini-4-hydrogen',
      contents: prompt,
      config: {
        systemInstruction:
          'You are Coach Mikhail, a supportive Chess Grandmaster instructor. Return crisp, accurate chess explanations matching the JSON schema. Keep each field 1-2 sentences.',
        responseMimeType: 'application/json',
        responseSchema: {
          type: Type.OBJECT,
          properties: {
            headline: { type: Type.STRING, description: 'Short headline summarizing the move quality and key idea.' },
            whyMoveWorkedOrFailed: { type: Type.STRING, description: 'Concrete tactical or positional reason why the played move succeeded or faltered.' },
            bestMoveIdea: { type: Type.STRING, description: 'Why the engine best move and continuation work better.' },
            coachTip: { type: Type.STRING, description: 'One actionable chess habit or rule of thumb for next time.' }
          }
        }
      }
    });

    const rawText = (response.text ?? '{}').trim();
    const parsed = JSON.parse(rawText) as Partial<MoveCoachExplanation>;
    res.json({
      headline: parsed.headline || localFallback.headline,
      whyMoveWorkedOrFailed: parsed.whyMoveWorkedOrFailed || localFallback.whyMoveWorkedOrFailed,
      bestMoveIdea: parsed.bestMoveIdea || localFallback.bestMoveIdea,
      coachTip: parsed.coachTip || localFallback.coachTip,
      source: 'gemini'
    });
  } catch {
    res.json(localFallback);
  }
});

// Vite middleware in dev or static files in production
async function startServer() {
  if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production') {
    app.use(express.static(path.resolve(__dirname, 'dist')));
    app.get('*', (_req, res) => {
      res.sendFile(path.resolve(__dirname, 'dist', 'index.html'));
    });
  } else {
    const { createServer } = await import('vite');
    const vite = await createServer({
      server: { middlewareMode: true },
      appType: 'spa',
    });
    app.use(vite.middlewares);
  }

  app.listen(PORT, '0.0.0.0', () => {
    console.log(`Server running at http://0.0.0.0:${PORT}`);
  });
}

startServer();
